306.name: Rainbow Wig

362.name: Angel Wings

364.name: Diaper

446.description: Just the thing to wear to the sock hop!

470.name: Cigar

500.name: Pastel Pants

504.name: Bunny Mask
504.description: You're not much of a bunny without big ears, but it's a start.

506.name: Bunny Ears

508.name: Wicker Basket

524.name: Bunny Tail
524.description: I'm concerned about how you're holding this in place.

530.name: Orange Beard

532.description: There's a four-leaf clover jammed in the band! But all the luck in it has been used up already.

534.name: Green Pants

536.description: You don't have to be a leprechaun to wear a green suit with gold trim - don't believe the hype!

674.name: Grey Hair Bun

678.name: Crimson Eagle Wings
678.description: Soar on the wings of a crimson eagle! Sponsored by Morphieus.

694.name: Worthless Rags
694.description: You look like a sad little muppet.

698.description: Super-special kitty ears, now yours to wear! Once only for a select few, meow yours to wear with pride!

700.name: Sombrero

702.name: Poncho

704.description: Good for twirling when you are tying somebody to a railroad.

730.name: Hammer Pants
730.description: Alternatively, harem girl pants.  Think of them however you like.

738.name: Lokster Hair
738.description: Slick n' greasy, and nobody but Lokster can wear it.

1018.description: It's possible this is actually a dalmation, but you can still ride it! It's faster than walking.

1022.name: Cowboy Hat

1072.description: These festival clothes are extra festive!

1074.description: These festival clothes are extra festive!

1078.description: These festival clothes are extra festive!

1084.description: These festival clothes are extra festive!

1086.description: These festival clothes are extra festive!

1090.name: Gat
1090.description: This style of hat is cleverly strapped to your head so it won't blow away.

1114.name: Dragon Tail
1114.description: We warned you to stay away from the toxic waste barrels.

1116.name: Clown Shoes
1116.description: You want respect, you gotta EARN it. Or wear these shoes. BAM, instant respect.

1118.name: Clown Pants
1118.description: They come complete with suspenders! Which is a good thing, since they're a BIT big.

1126.name: Foam Finger
1126.description: If you wear this, then YOU'RE #1! YOU'RE #1! YOU'RE #1!

1140.name: Astronaut Pack
1140.description: This contains all the essentials you need for a successful extravehicular activity trip, including a book of sudoku. It also makes you jump like you're on the moon.

1142.name: Space Suit
1142.description: Multiple layers offer protection against cold, vacuum, radiation, and parasitic alien infestation. Of course it's also sleeveless, so....?

1144.name: Space Pants
1144.description: A space suit isn't going to protect you very well if you don't put on the pants too.

1146.name: Moon Boots
1146.description: It's just one small step for a Growtopian, one giant leap for Growtopia.

1148.name: Astronaut Helmet
1148.description: Now you can be one of those creepy astronauts with a chrome-plated face, where nobody knows who you are and what you're up to.

1150.name: Zorbnik Leash
1150.description: ZYERBLRB! This little zorbnik will follow you everywhere you go! Mainly because it's tied to your wrist.

1166.name: Vampire Cape
1166.description: This cape imparts mystical powers upon its wearer.

1168.name: Slick Black Hair
1168.description: You must have a really greasy pillow.

1170.name: Vampire Fangs
1170.description: Wearing these impedes lip movement just enough to induce a Transylvanian accent.

1172.name: Vamp Vest
1172.description: Looks like you won the gold medal in bloodsucking!

1178.name: Skeletal Horsie
1178.description: Did you forget to feed your horse again?

1180.name: Spiritual Resonator
1180.description: This miraculous device allows you to commune with spirits from the Other Side.

1182.name: Hockey Mask
1182.description: Surely you're just a big sports fan... right?  Right?

1184.name: Mummy Mask
1184.description: It's hard to speak through these bandages!

1188.name: Wolfman Mask
1188.description: The fun bonus is that you can take this off, and then you're wearing your "daytime wolfman mask".  It's almost 2 masks in one!

1190.name: Black Cat Leash
1190.description: Mrow! The bad thing about wearing this leash is that you end up with a black cat constantly crossing your path.

1192.name: Creepy Hair
1192.description: Your hair's such a mess, you look like you just stepped out of a TV.

1204.name: Focused Eyes
1204.description: These eyes are a bit shocking.

1206.name: Devil Wings
1206.description: You don't jump higher than with normal wings, but man, you do look pretty cool.

1214.name: Familiar Leash
1214.description: Mrow HISS! This black cat contains the very essence of dark magic. Unfortunately, it's a cat, so you can't get it to use the magic for you.

1216.name: Cultist Hood
1216.description: You look a little shady in this thing...

1218.name: Cultist Robe
1218.description: Just the thing to worship Growganoth in!

1230.name: Frankenhair
1230.description: Did you stick your finger in a light socket?

1232.name: Sonar Bracelet
1232.description: Meep meep! This bracelet attracts bats. Well, A bat.

1242.name: Scrub Cap
1242.description: Keep your hair out of your eyes while performing surgery with this sterile cap.

1246.name: Scrub Top
1246.description: Special sterilized clothes, for chopping folks up!

1248.name: Scrub Pants
1248.description: Even your knees need to be kept sterile when you are operating.

1252.name: Magnifying Glass
1252.description: This has over 10,000,000x magnification, allowing you to clearly see the virus that is ... wait, is that virus following you around? RUN!

1254.name: Retro Magnifying Glass
1254.description: This has over 10,000,000x magnification, allowing you to clearly see the retrovirus that is totally grooving on your vibes.

1272.name: Ambulance
1272.description: For the sake of your fellow Growtopians, we limited the siren. But you can still enjoy the flashing lights!

1274.name: Edison Zoomster
1274.description: Only the chief of surgery can afford a speedy electric car like this!

1282.name: Candy Striper Cap
1282.description: Red wig included. And stapled on.

1284.name: Candy Striper Uniform
1284.description: I wonder where on earth this nurse's uniform gets its name from...

1286.name: Candy Striper Skirt
1286.description: This is also nice if you want to work at the kind of burger restaurant that requires Pieces of Flair from its wait staff.

1312.name: Bushy Beard
1312.description: You look like you should be in charge of magical animals with this beard.

1314.name: Ponytail
1314.description: Unlike an actual pony, your tail grows out of the back of your head.

1316.name: Happy Sun Shirt
1316.description: Take joy in the great glowing orb that provides energy for all those toilet trees to grow!

1318.name: Blue Sun Shirt
1318.description: "Well, what you plan and what takes place ain't ever exactly been similar."

1320.name: Riding Raptor
1320.description: I know, they're supposed to have feathers and stuff nowadays... Well, this is an old-school raptor!

1330.name: Caveman Club
1330.description: We've come a long way in methods of settling disputes, but this technique still works.

1332.name: Sabertooth-Skin Toga
1332.description: Clothing so stylish it'll make you shout "Rabble Dabble Goo!" - you know, to make sure you don't get sued.

1334.name: Caveman Hair
1334.description: The chicken grease helps the bone stay in, and it adds luster.

1338.name: Cavewoman Hair
1338.description: The chicken grease helps the bone stay in, and it adds luster.

1340.name: Fuzzy Bikini Top
1340.description: Is it for cold weather or warm weather? Who knows! It's the world's smallest parka.

1350.name: Mini Mammoth Leash
1350.description: The word "mammoth" has really lost all meaning at this point.

1376.name: Yeonnalligi
1376.description: Fly this colorful kite to ring in the new year!

1378.name: Ice Dragon Hand
1378.description: Another of the `4Dragons of Legend``! Please be aware the legends may have been a bit exaggerated.

1382.name: Antler Hat
1382.description: The red checkers alert other hunters not to shoot you, but the antlers make you a prime target. We've scientifically designed this hat to ensure that your odds of being shot remain precisely the same as if you weren't wearing it. Note: `4Wearing this also makes guns and bows kill you!``

1384.name: Glowing Nose
1384.description: Warning: wearing this could result in exclusion from reindeer games.

1386.name: Buckskin Hood
1386.description: So warm and toasty! It's like you sliced open a deer and crawled inside.

1388.name: Buckskin Jacket
1388.description: So warm and toasty! It's like you sliced open a deer and crawled inside.

1392.name: Buckskin Pants
1392.description: So warm and toasty! It's like you sliced open a deer and crawled inside.

1394.name: Polar Bear Leash
1394.description: If you look out your window and see this guy, you are looking south. Or at a zoo. Or at somebody playing Growtopia.

1400.name: Mini Growtopian
1400.description: Ah, he just wants to tag along!

1438.name: Golden Pickaxe
1438.description: This tool, made to honor Diichaan's service as a moderator, is worth more than the stuff you mine with it!

1440.name: Evil Space Helmet
1440.description: Found in a teeny-tiny spaceship, this helmet is surprisingly normal-sized. What brave star traveler could have worn this?

1444.name: Frosty Hair
1444.description: Brr! This shivering style is only for the coldest of the cold. Whoever created it must have been a chilly soul indeed - where could they be now?

1456.name: Gold Chain
1456.description: I pity the fool who doesn't wear a set of these.

1460.name: Golden Angel Wings
1460.description: Better than a Halo, these will actually let you double jump! Plus they're shiny!

1462.name: Golden Diaper
1462.description: If you find yourself lost in a world without any Toilet Seeds, you'll be glad you have this. Plus it's shiny!

1464.name: Golden Heartbow
1464.description: Once used by Cupid himself, this bow shoots golden hearts! You can yank other players toward you with it. Plus it's shiny!

1466.name: Golden Diamond Necklace
1466.description: Sparkles with the undying light of eternal love. Plus it's shiny!

1468.name: Emerald Necklace
1468.description: Emeralds are May's birthstone. This particular one is lab-created, which you'd think is less classy, but they're much prettier.

1470.name: Ruby Necklace
1470.description: It's a red rock on a metal string. But I guess people like that!

1484.name: Atomic Shadow Scythe
1484.description: So sharp it can slice atoms, this scythe is part shadow and all malice. The first person to wield it must have been very, very evil.

1496.name: Rushboard
1496.description: Just like they predicted, we finally have hoverboards in 2014! Well, virtual ones.

1502.name: Winter Scarf
1502.description: This scarf is made of fuzzy aquamarine yarn with little sparklies in it. It's tres chic.

1504.name: Old-Timey Hat
1504.description: If you're a grizzled old prospector, this is surely the hat for you. Also useful for hard-boiled reporters who always get their story.

1506.name: Medical Scarf
1506.description: These elaborate scarves may only be worn by medical professionals (or anyone else with the title "Doctor").

1512.name: Pet Leprechaun
1512.description: He's hidden a pot of gold somewhere... but you'll never find it!

1516.name: Black-Rimmed Glasses
1516.description: These stylish glasses can be custom matched to any prescription.

1518.name: Diving Bell
1518.description: Protect yourself from the crushing pressures of the great deep in this steel helmet. Of course, if you wear a normal wetsuit, you could end up sucked up into the helmet and crushed to death. So, you know, watch for that.

1524.name: Wetsuit Pants
1524.description: Lay off the donuts, because these things are skin-tight!

1526.name: Wetsuit Top
1526.description: Lay off the donuts, because this thing is skin-tight!

1534.name: Cuddly Piranha
1534.description: He just won't stay in his bowl because he LIKES YOU. This is one fish you'll never forget to feed!

1540.name: Mid-Pacific Owl
1540.description: This friendly pet owl will fall asleep on your head if you don't keep him entertained! Dedicated to the students of the Mid-Pacific Institute.

1542.name: Battle Trout
1542.description: Why, it's a dead fish. And you're holding it. Oooookayyyy.

1546.name: Green Pageboy
1546.description: This is NOT a helmet, don't call it a helmet! But if you want to use it as a helmet, go ahead. It's hair though.

1548.name: Easter Bonnet
1548.description: This fashionable accessory matches ANY outfit with style.

1550.name: Bubble Wings
1550.description: With a pair of wings, you can double-jump! With these wings, you can also bubble.

1552.name: Pet Bunny
1552.description: bunny bunny bunny bunny bunny bunny

1568.name: Lucky Pinata Hat
1568.description: Not only is this hat festive and suitable for formal occasions, but wearing it when you break an Ultra Pinata will reward you with a personal gift from The Great Burro!

1570.name: Mariachi Guitar
1570.description: When you /dance with this, you can perform for your friends!

1576.name: Fiesta Dragon
1576.description: This ferocious beast spews deadly PARTY at your enemies.

1582.name: Pink Cadillac
1582.description: There's nothing quite like cruising the Vegas strip in a pink Cadillac!

1586.name: Pet Burrito
1586.description: So fuzzy! This is not to be eaten.

1588.name: Clapboard
1588.description: The loud clacking sound this can produce is useful for syncing up audio with video. We've silenced this particular one for the sake of the other players.

1590.name: 3D Glasses
1590.description: It's like Growtopia is COMING RIGHT AT YOU!

1638.name: Unicorn Horn
1638.description: This pretty much rules out the possibility of hats, but it's so glowy!

1642.name: Horse Mask
1642.description: These things are just creepy. I don't get the appeal.

1644.name: Unicorn Jumper
1644.description: A gift from your friendly neighborhood unicorn!

1648.name: Unicorn Garland
1648.description: This magical garland from the mystic land of Unicornopianialandburg joins your soul with that of a unicorn. Great for you, but for the unicorn it's pretty much slavery. Not cool, dude.

1650.name: Pink Hair
1650.description: Oh, is that your natural color?

1652.name: Aqua Hair
1652.description: It takes a liberal dose of Aqua Net to make it look like this.

1666.name: Sea Monster Floatie
1666.description: Blow it up and take a swim!

1668.name: Water Wings
1668.description: Not a strong swimmer? Strap these on so at least your arms will stay above water as you drown.

1670.name: Summer Kite
1670.description: Fly this colorful kite to celebrate summertime!

1672.name: Rainbow Wings
1672.description: Somewhere over the rainbow is a Growtopian, flapping away. These let you double jump. Sponsored by Oricho and Oriche.

1674.name: Phoenix Wings
1674.description: Is it hot in here, or is it just you? These wings let you double jump, and there are only 500 of them in existence! Don't throw them away!

1676.name: Squirt Gun
1676.description: Squirt your friends with this usually harmless weapon! Or load it with hydrochloric acid and use it to dissolve metal, it works equally well. Longer range than normal punches, but less damage.

1688.name: Safari Jacket
1688.description: The comfortable fit you need to run away from giant rolling boulders.

1690.name: Jodhpurs
1690.description: Does these pants make my butt look fat?

1692.name: Adventuring Mustache
1692.description: Wot wot too right tally ho jolly good ermf ermf

1704.name: Explorer's Ponytail
1704.description: This sensible hairstyle minimizes the number of cobwebs that stick to you when exploring ancient tombs. The glasses also help you avoid them in the first place.

1708.name: Explorer's Shovel
1708.description: This is not a whole lot different from a garden shovel, but holding it makes you feel adventurous. It also lets you dig faster than you can by punching dirt. I still don't get why punching dirt works at all.

1710.name: Keytar
1710.description: You can't punch when holding this, you're too busy ROCKING! Punch anywhere to play music. If you punch to your left or right, you can bend the note higher or lower. Punch in your own column to play the same notes that Sheet Music: Piano Note plays.

1712.name: Bass Guitar
1712.description: You can't punch when holding this, you're too busy ROCKING! Punch anywhere to play music. If you punch to your left or right, you can bend the note higher or lower. Punch in your own column to play the same notes that Sheet Music: Bass Note plays.

1714.name: Tambourine
1714.description: You can't punch when holding this, you're too busy ROCKING! Punch anywhere to play drums. If you punch to your left or right, you can play different drums. Punch in your own column to play the same drums that Sheet Music: Drums plays.

1718.name: Starchild Makeup
1718.description: You came down from a distant planet, to conquer the Earth with the power of ROCK.

1720.name: Shredded T-Shirt
1720.description: This shirt isn't ruined, it's COOL.

1722.name: Leopard Leggings
1722.description: These are the easiest pants to do leaping splits in, if that happens to be important to you. I mean, you might as well jump. Go ahead and jump.

1732.name: Rockin' Headband
1732.description: When you rock, you sweat. Soak it up!

1736.name: Knight Helmet
1736.description: This helmet was forged by the awesome art god Hamumu. Sponsored by Knightmare.

1738.name: Crystal Cape
1738.description: Though less flexible than your average cape, this is a whole lot sparklier. Allows you to double jump off of an imaginary Crystal Block. Sponsored by Edvoid20, HemeTems, and Aboge.

1740.name: StarBoard
1740.description: Just like they predicted, we finally have hoverboards in 2014! Well, virtual ones. Sponsored by Miwsky, Chudy, and Dawid.

1742.name: Puppy Leash
1742.description: Berf! This little puppy is modeled after Hamumu's dog Mia, and can also be found in the fabulous smash hit Flash game Mia's Happy Day! Go play it!

1746.name: Fuel Pack
1746.description: This backpack contains volatile fuels you can use to power a flamethrower!

1748.name: Flamethrower
1748.description: The deadliest weapon in Growtopia! The downside is that you need to wear a Fuel Pack to use it, and it uses up 1 Fuel Pack for every single punch. KILL IT WITH FIRE!

1758.name: Growboard
1758.description: Just like they predicted, we finally have hoverboards in 2014! Well, virtual ones. This one spits fire. Sponsored by Coinman, iOliver, and Legomanz.

1760.name: Spiritfire Mask
1760.description: For the less technologically-inclined, this mask relies on black magic to raise an evil spirit.

1762.name: Soda Jetpack
1762.description: Use the power of carbonation to leap tall buildings in a single bound, and then drift gently to Earth. Comes with a lifetime supply of soda, connected via wormhole for continuous refueling.

1764.name: Dominatus Moderateus
1764.description: Could there be more than one cult in Growtopia? Sponsored by Moderate.

1780.name: Legendbot-009
1780.description: This legendary battle armor was the turning point in the war of Growtopia Valley.

1782.name: Dragon of Legend
1782.description: This blade calls forth the Ancient Dragon of Unexaggerated Legends and binds it to your command. It's a biggun'.

1784.name: Legendary Wings
1784.description: Turns out you had to do a lot more than ring a bell to get these suckers.

1804.name: Zeus' Lightning Bolt
1804.description: It's 1.21 gigawatts in the palm of your hand!  Sponsored by Dodoman11, Hercule, and the RTSoft Forumers.

1806.name: Chinese Dragon Head
1806.description: You're lucky, you get to be the head!

1808.name: Chinese Dragon Body
1808.description: This really adds a lot of body to your hair.

1810.name: Chinese Dragon Tail
1810.description: Looks like you got stuck with the tail end. Again.

1812.name: Ssireum Shorts - Red
1812.description: Wear these shorts when you are wrestling! If you play in a Game Pack game, your shorts will change color to match your team.

1814.name: Ssireum Shorts - Blue
1814.description: Wear these shorts when you are wrestling! If you play in a Game Pack game, your shorts will change color to match your team.

1822.description: These sporty shoes are coated with a layer of pure sparkling gold. Sponsored by Kubeti and Rooted.

1824.name: Autumn Wings
1824.description: A leaf falls on a still pond. These wings let you double jump, and contain an endless supply of dried leaves for some reason!

1830.name: Harvester
1830.description: This advanced harvesting machine will chop down trees as it runs them over. If you wear a Fuel Pack, it has a 10 chance of harvesting double fruit from each tree below rarity 100! This burns up one Fuel Pack.

1836.name: Diamond Flashaxe
1836.description: I'm not sure why you're bothering to mine stuff when you already have an entire pickaxe made of diamonds, but at least you know this is harder than whatever you want to mine! Sponsored by Kloe, PartyFrog, and xShaDo.

1840.name: Long Black Bangs
1840.description: This is the hair for people with flawed foreheads.

1842.name: Pink Pageboy
1842.description: This is NOT a helmet, don't call it a helmet! But if you want to use it as a helmet, go ahead. It's hair though.

1844.name: Long Blonde Bangs
1844.description: Cover your forehead and shoulders in one fell swoop!

1846.name: Messy Auburn Tresses
1846.description: It's messy and it's red, what more could you want from hair?

1848.name: Growbans
1848.description: These are some fierce designer sunglasses!

1850.name: Pink Hair Bow
1850.description: You're like Ms. Pac-Man without the eating disorder!

1852.name: Butterfly Hair Pin
1852.description: It looks like a real butterfly! A real robot butterfly.

1854.name: Bee Hair Pin
1854.description: Psst, I think there's a bee in your hair...

1858.name: Red Sun Dress
1858.description: It looks like a whole galaxy of suns.

1860.name: Blue Skirt
1860.description: This skirt is long, and thus classy.

1862.description: You are now the referee of fashion.

1868.description: Congratulations on completing all the holiday achievements!  Have a dragon!

1874.name: Ring Of Force

1876.name: Ring Of Winds
1876.description: This ring floats you on a cloud. Hold the jump button while falling to glide safely down to earth.

1892.description: This is a cruel way to get somebody to do what you want. Keep it in video games only!

1904.name: The One Ring

1936.description: It's shocking what they're doing with wings these days. Sponsored by Cukuzz, PikaPi and BigCream.

2998.description: This mask is usually kept in a glass case, with a tiny hammer and a sign that says "Break glass only in case of dire emergency!"

3008.name: E-Z Rod
3008.description: Equip this and then use bait on water next to you to go fishing! All you have to do is wait for a bite, and then punch the fish before it escapes! If you miss, your bait is wasted, so punch fast. This is a beginner's fishing rod - it keeps fish on the line twice as long as other rods, so it's easy as pie.

3010.name: Licorice Rod
3010.description: Equip this and then use bait on water next to you to go fishing! All you have to do is wait for a bite, and then punch the fish before it escapes! If you miss, your bait is wasted, so punch fast. This delicious fishing rod gets bites twice as often as other rods.

3040.name: Goldenrod
3040.description: Equip this and then use bait on water next to you to go fishing! All you have to do is wait for a bite, and then punch the fish before it escapes! If you miss, your bait is wasted, so punch fast. This enchanted rod will catch 25% bigger fish than normal.

3042.name: Fishing Hat
3042.description: Congratulations on winning the Fishing Frenzy Daily Challenge! With this hat on, there's a 5% chance to not use up your bait when you fish (I mean, there's a bunch of extra bait right there on the hat!).

3046.name: Firefighter Helmet - Red
3046.description: Protect your head from falling embers, or occasionally falling buildings!

3048.name: Firefighter Helmet - Yellow
3048.description: Protect your head from falling embers, or occasionally falling buildings!

3050.name: Oxygen Mask
3050.description: Strap this on when people start tossing rotten eggs. You'll be much happier.

3052.name: Firefighter Boots
3052.description: Finally, the technology exists to protect your feet from fire without exposing them to dangerous asbestos! Wear these for fire safety.

3054.name: Firefighter Pants - Red
3054.description: These pants are made of stylish rubber to ensure you are as overheated as possible while standing in a burning building.

3056.name: Firefighter Pants - Yellow
3056.description: These pants are made of stylish rubber to ensure you are as overheated as possible while standing in a burning building.

3058.name: Firefighter Jacket - Red
3058.description: Is it hot in here? Throw on a jacket!

3060.name: Firefighter Jacket - Yellow
3060.description: Is it hot in here? Throw on a jacket!

3066.name: Fire Hose
3066.description: Where is the other end of this hose plugged in? I don't know, but it has an infinite supply of water! This does no damage to blocks at all, but it puts out fires with great ease!

3068.name: Fire Truck
3068.description: For the sake of your fellow Growtopians, we limited the siren. But you can still enjoy the flashing lights!

3070.name: Fire Ax
3070.description: Chop your way into burning buildings to rescue puppies! This device is not licensed for any other use.

3074.name: Floating Leaf
3074.description: This magic leaf can float you around. Just cuz.

3086.name: Dried Leaf Crown
3086.description: Handle with care or you're gonna end up with potpourri instead of the Heralded Crown Of Autumn.

3100.name: Cursed Fishing Rod
3100.description: Equip this and then use bait on water next to you to go fishing! All you have to do is wait for a bite, and then punch the fish before it escapes! If you miss, your bait is wasted, so punch fast. You will suffer mysterious effects when catching fish with this rod. Beware the curse!

3104.name: Flaming Cape
3104.description: This cape burns eternally with eldritch fire. It's also lined with asbestos, so you're all good. Probably.

3106.name: Ghost Costume
3106.description: Nothing spookier than a bedsheet with two holes cut in it!

3108.name: Chainsaw Hand
3108.description: If you ever get a possessed hand and have to lop it off at the wrist, here's a handy replacement for it! Also good for ice sculpture.

3112.name: Inside-Out Vampire Cape
3112.description: You accidentally made your cape inside-out!

3114.name: Black Aura
3114.description: I'm pretty sure it's a bad sign when your aura is this color.

3118.name: Riding Demon Dog
3118.description: It's just like a horse... except PURE EVIL.

3120.name: Teeny Devil Wings
3120.description: Even as tiny as they are, these wings allow you to jump in mid-air!

3124.name: Soul Orb
3124.description: This orb devours the souls of anything it touches - Growtopians, blocks, trees, whatever!

3130.name: Stethoscope
3130.description: Congratulations on winning the Doctor's Duel Daily Challenge! With this Stethoscope on, you are half as likely to make mistakes in surgery!

3132.name: Super Logo - Crown
3132.description: Emblazon this logo on your super costume since you won the Card Clash Daily Challenge! With this logo on, you get +2 health during card battles!

3134.name: Wolf Spirit
3134.description: Congratulations on winning the War of Wolves Daily Challenge! With this spirit equipped (it is a back item, by the way), you can double jump, and the guidance of the Wolf Spirit will improve your Wolfworld rewards (usually).

3138.name: Challenge Crown
3138.description: Congratulations! You were #1 in a Daily Challenge! Show off with a shiny crown.

3140.name: Ring Of Savings
3140.description: Congratulations on winning the Carnie Contest Daily Challenge! With this ring equipped, you save 10% on Golden Ticket prices (pay 90 rarity per ticket, or get 33 per World Lock).

3144.name: Cosmic Cape
3144.description: This cape sparkles and very very rarely finds leftover Comet Dust in blocks you break when it's not The Night Of The Comet!

3160.name: Sword And Shield
3160.description: This is a classic warrior's combo - a nice cutlass for your main hand, and a shield in the other. The shield makes you harder to knock back!

3162.name: Twin Swords
3162.description: Why waste time with a shield? Just get two swords!

3164.name: Preppy Blonde Hair
3164.description: I think you've got just enough gel in there to go to the sock hop with Buffy!

3166.name: Pet Slime
3166.description: Nothing cuter than a sentient ball of slime that follows you around!

3168.name: Strawberry Slime
3168.description: So much tastier than the mucus flavor!

3172.name: Legal Briefs
3172.description: Not only are these comfortable undergarments for everyday use, they also have a legal use: put them on when you are in trouble for Malpractice, and you'll be freed from your punishment! This uses up the briefs.

3174.name: Ring Of Smithing
3174.description: To be honest, this ring doesn't really do anything. Well, that is unless you want to smith something. Then you're definitely gonna need to wear this!

3178.name: Blacksmith's Apron
3178.description: This apron is made of heavy leather, making it very effective for protecting you from stray sparks when forging things.

3206.name: Lumber Axe
3206.description: This axe is precisely balanced to chop down trees in just a single hit! Now, you might not be impressed since you can do that with your bare hands already. But wait - this axe can chop down the `2GROWCH'S`` trees! Of course, doing that will shatter it. They're very special trees.

3214.name: Axe Of Winter
3214.description: Mittens are recommended when wielding this icy monstrosity, which does extra damage to blocks.

3216.name: Moose Cap
3216.description: This beautifully styled hat, suitable for all formal occasions, has the unique property of attracting wild meese to follow you around.

3230.name: Toboggan
3230.description: This sled was called "Onion Bulb" by its original owner, but you can call it whatever you want. It comes with a free purple blanket to keep your legs warm!

3236.name: Winter Robe
3236.description: Be the King of Winter in this luxurious satiny robe! Note: this is a "chest item", like a necklace, so you can wear any shirts and back items you want underneath it.

3238.name: Magical Carrot
3238.description: With just a touch of winter magic, it's really not that hard to bring a snowman to life. I don't know why more people don't do it!

3250.name: Riding Winter Wolf
3250.description: It's just like a horse... except soft and fuzzy!

3254.name: Elf Stockings
3254.description: This is really just long underwear. You probably should wear pants over them, but hey, Growtopia doesn't support that, so you'll just have to be cold!

3272.name: Growtopia Fan Shirt
3272.description: This amazing psychic shirt can actually display your thoughts with spectacular new morphing ink technology. Note: yeah, it just says the one thing, but you know you're thinking it.

3274.name: T-Shirt Cannon
3274.description: Powered by a Fuel Pack on your back, this gun can launch free T-shirts at your fellow Growtopians! Don't waste shots at anything else, it still burns fuel!

3276.name: Ghost Fan Shirt
3276.description: You like ghosts? No? Sure looks like you do.

3288.name: Steampunk Corset
3288.description: Tired of always choosing the survival of your internal organs over looking skinny? The corset is the thing for you!

3290.name: Steampunk Skirt
3290.description: Multiple layers of petticoats keep you warm!

3292.name: Steampunk Top Hat
3292.description: Keep an extra pair of goggles up there. You never know when you'll need them.

3294.name: Steampunk Waistcoat
3294.description: The perfect garment for housing a pocketwatch, monocle, and perhaps taxidermy needles. Definitely some weird stuff in those pockets.

3296.name: Steampunk Leggings
3296.description: Works equally well for a steampunk or a pirate! Or maybe a dancer from the 80's.

3298.name: Steampunk Trenchcoat
3298.description: Keep warm on those frosty London evenings in this stylish piece by Grow Couture! Note: this is a "chest item", like a necklace, so you can wear any shirts and back items you want underneath it.

3300.name: Party Blaster
3300.description: Take the party with you every where you go!

3358.name: Patchwork Mess
3358.description: An experiment in sewing gone horribly wrong.  This is just a bunch of silk stitched together in random directions.

3360.name: Silk Vest - Red
3360.description: A snappy vest suitable for any occasion.

3362.name: Silk Vest - Green
3362.description: A snappy vest suitable for any occasion.

3364.name: Silk Vest - Blue
3364.description: A snappy vest suitable for any occasion.

3366.name: Silk Vest - Purple
3366.description: A snappy vest suitable for any occasion.

3368.name: Silk Vest - Grey
3368.description: A snappy vest suitable for any occasion.

3370.name: Silk Vest - Black
3370.description: A snappy vest suitable for any occasion.

3372.name: Silk Tie - Red
3372.description: You will command respect in this power tie!

3374.name: Silk Tie - Yellow
3374.description: You will command respect in this power tie!

3376.name: Silk Tie - Black
3376.description: You will command respect in this power tie!

3378.name: Silk Tie - Blue
3378.description: You will command respect in this power tie!

3380.name: Silk Tie - Grey
3380.description: You will command respect in this power tie!

3382.name: Silk Skirt - Red
3382.description: A classic look, available in a variety of colors.

3384.name: Silk Skirt - Blue
3384.description: A classic look, available in a variety of colors.

3386.name: Silk Skirt - Aqua
3386.description: A classic look, available in a variety of colors.

3388.name: Silk Skirt - Black
3388.description: A classic look, available in a variety of colors.

3390.name: Silk Skirt - White
3390.description: A classic look, available in a variety of colors.

3392.name: Silk Skirt - Purple
3392.description: A classic look, available in a variety of colors.

3396.name: Lovebird Pendant
3396.description: Pip pip! This little bird will follow you around forever, because it loves you. Or at least it loves that necklace, and possibly wants it back.

3416.name: Dark Cult Hood
3416.description: When you reach level 7 in the cult, like Jairrocket, your eyes get glowy.

3418.name: Serpent Staff
3418.description: St. Patrick wandered around Ireland with one of these. It scared away all the other snakes because they saw it and thought he was constantly strangling a snake.

3430.name: Lucky Pendant
3430.description: This pendant symbolizes two snakes eating themselves. Whatever that means, it also causes a luck dragon to follow you around! Note: it's the dragon that's lucky, not you. I guess you're just lucky to get to hang around with it!

3442.name: Riding Bumblebee
3442.description: You're too heavy for this bee to fly, but it can help you jump an extra time.

3444.name: Spring Crown
3444.description: Keep it watered or you'll end up with a crown of thorns instead of the Heralded Crown Of Spring.

3462.name: Brainflower
3462.description: Flower power! This flower's roots growing down into your brain make you smarter at finding Magic Eggs in an Egg-Hunting Basket. Who knows, you might even find two sometimes!

3464.name: Mermaid Tail
3464.description: You don't need to trade your voice for a pair of legs... just take this off and you're all set! But this tail does make you move faster in the water, and slower on land.

3466.name: Sushi Knife
3466.description: This razor-sharp blade has the unique ability to slice fish up into fresh chunks for sushi! Just drop a fish item on a Cutting Board, then attack it with the Sushi Knife!

3476.name: Spring Bouquet
3476.description: Aw, a lovely bunch of flowers to share!

3494.name: Paintbrush
3494.description: Paint the town a variety of delightful colors with this here brush! Paint not included.

3514.name: Raspberry Beret
3514.description: This is the kind you find at a second-hand store.

3516.name: Artist's Smock
3516.description: Looks like you spilled a little there. No, over there. And there. And the first place you thought I meant.

3518.name: Goatee
3518.description: You're either a hipster or an evil twin. Or perhaps ... a hipster's evil twin? How would you know which one was evil!?

3530.name: Orange Shirt
3530.description: I know you dreamed about this since Day 1 of Growtopia. It is finally here. For real. Yes - there is an Orange Shirt, and it's not just a block, you can WEAR IT.

3552.name: Battle Leash
3552.description: This amazing octohedron can actually contain two Battle Pets, primed and ready to strike. Unequip and re-equip to swap which pet is active. Wrench a Battle Pet Cage to load a pet into the Leash. Wrench another player with a Battle Leash to battle them! You must have 2 pets in the Battle Leash to battle.

3574.name: Spelunker's Headlamp
3574.description: This hardhat protects you from falling rocks, while the headlamp lights up dark caverns.

3576.name: Night Vision Goggles
3576.description: Equipping these lets you disregard darkness completely! If you're not in a world you own, they consume 1 D Battery for every minute you wear them. You can wear them without a battery if you just wanna look cool, though. `4Batteries not included.``

3578.name: Hand Torch
3578.description: British people would call a Flashlight this, but this is an actual torch, for your hand. As opposed to an Adventure Item or wall torch. Carrying this lights up dark caves. Torches burn out at unpredictable moments, so carry several!

3588.name: Climbing Picks
3588.description: These handy picks allow you to climb Climbing Walls. Just jump and hold the arrow towards the wall!

3590.name: Climbing Boots
3590.description: These handy boots allow you to climb Climbing Walls. Just jump and hold the arrow towards the wall!

3596.name: Pinata Pal
3596.description: When you are feeling down and lonely, nothing cheers you up like a rainbow-colored friendly burro filled with candy!

3602.name: Fiesta Dress
3602.description: Got a festive occasion to celebrate? Pop on this colorful number for a night on the town!

3624.name: Pineapple Hair
3624.description: This hair isn't made of pineapple, it's just been dyed and gelled to look like pineapple leaves.

3626.name: Pet Trainer Cap
3626.description: This hat says PT on it. You can wear it to show you're a Pet Trainer, but you could also use it to celebrate Physical Therapy, or Popcorn Time, or whatever you like!

3650.name: Riding Silkworm - Red
3650.description: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

3652.name: Riding Silkworm - Green
3652.description: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

3654.name: Riding Silkworm - Blue
3654.description: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

3656.name: Riding Silkworm - Black
3656.description: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

3658.name: Riding Silkworm - White
3658.description: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

3660.name: Riding Silkworm - Grey
3660.description: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

3662.name: Riding Silkworm - Purple
3662.description: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

3664.name: Riding Silkworm - Yellow
3664.description: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

3666.name: Riding Silkworm - Aqua
3666.description: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

3672.name: Pet Trainer Medal
3672.description: Congratulations! You have been awarded a medal for defeating a Pet Trainer!

3678.name: Thinking Cap
3678.description: They say two heads are better than one. We can't arrange that, but we can get you two of what's inside your head!

3680.name: Phlogiston
3680.description: This fantastical substance contains the very essence of living flame.

3686.name: Toy Lock-Bot
3686.description: It's just like Lock-Bot, only tiny! And he doesn't trade locks, he SHOOTS them.

3696.name: Riding Phoenix
3696.description: Whoa, you're really sitting in the hotseat now. There are only 500 of these in existence, so don't lose yours!

3698.name: Red Flip Flops
3698.description: Bright rubber to protect your feet from pointy shells on the beach!

3700.name: Green Flip Flops
3700.description: Bright rubber to protect your feet from pointy shells on the beach!

3702.name: Blue Flip Flops
3702.description: Bright rubber to protect your feet from pointy shells on the beach!

3706.name: B.O.O. Shirt
3706.description: The official uniform of B.O.O. - Battlers Of the Otherworldly. Join today!

3708.name: B.O.O. Pants
3708.description: The official uniform of B.O.O. - Battlers Of the Otherworldly. Join today!

3710.name: Spectral Goggles
3710.description: The spectrally polarized lenses of these goggles allow you to actually see paranormal activity. Be warned: it is very spooky! But it's there whether you can see it or not... wouldn't you rather know?

3712.name: B.O.O. Helmet
3712.description: The trouble with poltergeists is that they're always pushing things off of shelves (side note: cats pose the same problem). That's where the helmet comes in. Protect yourself from falling books and antiques!

3714.name: Neutron Pack
3714.description: This backpack contains a portable nuclear reactor. I know that sounds a bit unsafe, but... well, it is. It's a terrible idea. It has blinky lights, though. You'll need to wear a Neutron Pack to power a Neutron Gun.

3716.name: Neutron Gun
3716.description: This energy blaster looks impressive, but actually has no impact on our world. Rather, it creates a stream of neutrons that attracts spirits. Ghosts can't escape the beam. Which reminds me: Don't ever cross your beam with somebody else's! That would be bad.

3718.name: Rubber Boots
3718.description: These are tight-fitting boots made of a natural rubber that protects from slime while still allowing your feet to breathe.

3736.name: Demon Control Cap
3736.description: With this helmet, which is not a colander at all, you can control a demon dog from another dimension!

3738.name: Haunted Pants
3738.description: What's that eerie noise coming from in there? These pants must be haunted!

3744.name: Shark-Tooth Necklace
3744.description: I don't know if this is a tooth from every shark you've killed, or each one that's bitten you, but either way it's impressive.

3774.name: No-Face
3774.description: Embarrassed? Feel like hiding your face? How about just removing it instead?

3776.name: Purple Djellaba
3776.description: This long robe is suitable for male or female Growtopians, provided they want to look snazzy and colorful!

3778.name: Yellow Djellaba
3778.description: This long robe is suitable for male or female Growtopians, provided they want to look snazzy and colorful!

3780.name: Green Djellaba
3780.description: This long robe is suitable for male or female Growtopians, provided they want to look snazzy and colorful!

3788.name: Riding Broomstick
3788.description: Which magic makes this fly? Witch magic makes this fly!

3790.name: Techno Visor
3790.description: This is handy technology for people who are overwhelmed with modern life - it blocks one of your ears from hearing things, and one of your eyes from seeing things. Just relax and enjoy the left half of the world.

3792.name: Glowstick
3792.description: This plastic tube of lethal radioactive elements is the perfect thing to swing around at a party! It also provides light.

3800.name: Rhino Horn
3800.description: Aw, it thinks you're its mama!

3812.name: Octopus Head
3812.description: This is why aquariums have rules.

3844.name: Super Shirt - Autumn
3844.description: Fight crime in this mighty leafy leotard!

3846.name: Muscle Shirt - Autumn
3846.description: Flex your muscles in this mighty leafy leotard!

3848.name: Heroic Tights - Autumn
3848.description: To be a leafy superhero, you really need to wear tights of some sort.

3850.name: Super Tights - Autumn
3850.description: To be a leafy superhero, you really need to wear tights of some sort.

3852.name: Heroic Boots - Autumn
3852.description: These leafy boots add nothing to your crimefighting skills except to protect you from stray Legos.

3858.name: Super Cape - Autumn
3858.description: You're no Heroman, but it's still pretty swell.

3860.name: Superheroine Top - Autumn
3860.description: Flex your muscles in this mighty leafy leotard!

3862.name: Super Eye Mask - Autumn
3862.description: Protect your secret identity, by hiding the inch of skin around your eyes.  Who could possibly recognize you?

3864.name: Super Logo - Leaf
3864.description: Emblazon this logo on your super costume to fight crime as... Leaf Lord? Lady Leaf? The Fallen Avenger? It's up to you!

3866.name: Harvest Witch Mask
3866.description: Normally this mask is only worn during the most profane of dark rituals, beneath a blood red moon. But you can wear it for shopping, parties, whatever!

3872.name: Blue Hanbok Top
3872.description: These festival clothes are extra festive!

3874.name: Orange Hanbok Top
3874.description: These festival clothes are extra festive!

3876.name: Blue Hanbok Pants
3876.description: These festival clothes are extra festive!

3878.name: Orange Hanbok Pants
3878.description: These festival clothes are extra festive!

3880.name: Green Hanbok Skirt
3880.description: These festival clothes are extra festive!

3882.name: Yellow Hanbok Skirt
3882.description: These festival clothes are extra festive!

3884.name: Sunflower Hair Pin
3884.description: When sunflowers are out of season, stick this plastic replacement in your hair.

3886.name: Lil' Sheepers
3886.description: Baa. This little baby sheep will follow you everywhere you go! Mainly because it's tied to your wrist.

3894.name: Harvest Robinsons
3894.description: These special edition Air Robinsons are themed to celebrate the harvest, or just be bright crazy colors, like all basketball shoes.

3900.name: Wooden Sword
3900.description: They use these to train in Kendo. They won't cut much, but getting whacked with one certainly does hurt!

3912.name: Wool Scarf
3912.description: Your neck is toasty warm. Maybe you should put some pants on too.

3914.name: Sheep Shears
3914.description: This handy tool is a lot more effective at cutting wool than your fingers are, so you can get twice as much when you use it to shear a sheep!

3932.name: Rock Hammer
3932.description: A precision instrument for chipping fossils out of rocks. If you find a fossil, equip this hammer and start tapping - but do it *carefully!* If the fossil comes loose and you hit again, you'll break it!

3934.name: Rock Chisel
3934.description: So you've extracted a fossil from a rock, but the rock is still in your way. That's where the chisel comes in! It lets you chip away the rock without damaging the fossil.

3944.name: Dinosaur Mask
3944.description: This is how you would look if a dinosaur snuck up behind you and swallowed you, but you got stuck in his throat. It's really a bad situation for everyone involved.

3952.name: Red Pet Pteranodon
3952.description: You've brought a dinosaur back to life with genetic engineering! There's no way that this could go badly!

4110.name: Flowersaurus Rex
4110.description: You monster, what fresh horror have you wrought?!!? Has science gone too far?

4112.name: Blue Riding Raptor
4112.description: I know, they're supposed to have feathers and stuff nowadays... Well, this is an old-school raptor!

4114.name: Brown Riding Raptor
4114.description: I know, they're supposed to have feathers and stuff nowadays... Well, this is an old-school raptor!

4116.name: Red Riding Raptor
4116.description: I know, they're supposed to have feathers and stuff nowadays... Well, this is an old-school raptor!

4118.name: Golden Riding Raptor
4118.description: I think this raptor has more World Locks than you do.

4126.name: Stone Spear
4126.description: In ancient times, sticks and stones were about as good as it got. The upside is it's a magic stone - this spear will teleport back into your hand once thrown!

4128.name: Blue Hardhat
4128.description: Head protection is required in construction areas, and at some dig sites.

4130.name: Outback Hat
4130.description: G'day! Barbie! Shrimp! That's not a knife, it's a hat! These hats are popular among paleontologists and other desert dwellers.

4138.name: Doompunk Corset
4138.description: Internal organs rotted away? The corset should fit you fine!

4140.name: Doompunk Skirt
4140.description: Multiple layers of petticoats keep you warm when stalking your prey!

4142.name: Doompunk Top Hat
4142.description: Keep an extra pair of goggles up there. You never know when you'll need them for evil.

4144.name: Doompunk Waistcoat
4144.description: The perfect garment for housing a pocketwatch, monocle, and perhaps poison needles. Definitely some evil stuff in those pockets.

4146.name: Doompunk Leggings
4146.description: Works equally well for a doompunk or a pirate! Or maybe a serial killer from the 80's.

4148.name: Doompunk Trenchcoat
4148.description: Keep warm while stalking people on those frosty London evenings in this stylish piece by Grow Couture! Note: this is a "chest item", like a necklace, so you can wear any shirts and back items you want underneath it.

4150.name: Eye Of Growganoth
4150.description: This accursed necklace binds one of the eternal and innumerable Eyes of Growganoth to your service. Just make sure you don't take *your* eye off of it - at the first sign of weakness, it will devour your soul!

4152.name: Apocalypse Steed
4152.description: The four horsemen have updated to more modern steeds. They're probably gonna be pretty mad when they find out you swiped one.

4154.name: Jack o' Lantern Mask
4154.description: Luckily this is just latex and not actually a gooey carved-out pumpkin.

4166.name: Death's Scythe
4166.description: Careful where you swing that thing.

4168.name: Demon Chariot
4168.description: This thing goes pretty fast for a vehicle with only 2 horsepower.

4170.name: Logarithmic Wheel
4170.description: You know what a really good weapon is? A wagon wheel. Yeah, I mean... yeah.

4180.name: Spiked Collar
4180.description: Ah yeah, you look tough, like a junkyard dog.

4182.name: Malevolent Hair
4182.description: What are you up to under that mop-top? Seems like something a little sneaky...

4184.name: Riding Raven
4184.description: Only dark magic could breed a raven so massive. It's so powerful it allows you to double-jump!

4244.name: Non La
4244.description: This conical straw hat is useful for full sun protection, as well as carrying stuff!

4250.name: Penguin Mask
4250.description: Wanna be as COOL as Master Peng? Not gonna happen. But you can wear this mask and look like a dork.

4252.name: Mini-Peng
4252.description: Master Peng is so swift, he can appear to be in multiple places at once. But in the extra places, he looks very small.

4260.name: Present Goblin Disguise
4260.description: Disguises you as a Present Goblin, bringer of joy.

4274.name: Hideous Holiday Sweater
4274.description: Your grandma thinks you look adorable in this.

4276.name: Winter Turtleneck
4276.description: Celebrate Winterfest in cozy style, with no worries of chin-freeze.

4278.name: Yo-Yo
4278.description: It's a disc on a string. Try smacking stuff with it!

4282.name: Meh, Bunny Suit
4282.description: MrMehMeh stores the carrots he eats here.

4286.name: Stuff-4-Toys Shirt
4286.description: Stuff-4-Toys is offering these stylish t-shirts to all Silver level donators!

4288.name: Present Goblin Home Edition
4288.description: Dress up as a Present Goblin for fun! You won't automatically drop presents, but it's festive year-round! This costume overrides all other clothing, but if you don't like tossing tennis balls, try equipping other sportsballs with it!

4290.name: Solsascarf
4290.description: Solsagann is tossing out yesterday's baguettes! They are quite stale.

4292.name: Stuff-4-Toys Tote Bag
4292.description: Tote around your shopping with our fabulous tote bag. It lets everybody know you are serious about donating Stuff for Toys.

4294.name: Betty Bluetooth Doll
4294.description: This high-tech doll is the big craze this Winterfest! Everybody wants a remote-controlled doll that fires deadly lightning bolts!

4326.name: Plague Doctor Mask
4326.description: There was a time when actual medical professionals would go out on the streets wearing this. It was a creepy, creepy time.

4328.name: Plague Doctor Hat
4328.description: Rumpled and frumpy, really showing your dedication to your craft.

4330.name: Plague Doctor Robe
4330.description: This robe is intended to protect you from pestilence. Sadly, it was invented in pre-scientific times, so all it really protects you from is cold weather.

4332.name: Living Dead Remote
4332.description: You just couldn't accept your patients' deaths. And now you've created an abomination, haven't you? What has your foul science wrought?!

4350.name: Wolf Skull Shoulders
4350.description: Three heads are better than one, even if two of them are empty and skinless.

4360.name: Sales Shades
4360.description: Cover your eyes, the savings are simply too glorious to behold!

4362.name: Ghost Wolf Monocle
4362.description: This monocle is haunted by the spirit of an ancient wolf! That's more common than you'd expect among monocles.

4374.name: Party Fowl
4374.description: Whoa dude, major party fowl. You earned this for playing Growtopia for THREE YEARS, and over 300 hours, and reaching level 50! Wow, that's dedication.

4402.name: Pink Cat As A Hat
4402.description: Oh, the places you'll go wearing this hat! You can wear it on the train, or in the rain, or... well, actually don't wear it in the rain, it'll shrink.

4404.name: Blue Cat As A Hat
4404.description: Oh, the places you'll go wearing this hat! You can wear it on the train, or in the rain, or... well, actually don't wear it in the rain, it'll shrink.

4406.name: Grey Cat As A Hat
4406.description: Oh, the places you'll go wearing this hat! You can wear it on the train, or in the rain, or... well, actually don't wear it in the rain, it'll shrink.

4408.name: Orange Cat As A Hat
4408.description: Oh, the places you'll go wearing this hat! You can wear it on the train, or in the rain, or... well, actually don't wear it in the rain, it'll shrink.

4412.name: Pegasus
4412.description: If you were a pegasus, you'd spend all your time flying too. Why walk on those teeny legs? Those mighty wings allow you both to double jump, too.

4414.name: Golden Pegasus
4414.description: If you were a pegasus, you'd spend all your time flying too. Why walk on those teeny legs? Those mighty wings allow you both to double jump, too.

4416.name: Heart Glasses
4416.description: The world just looks like a lovelier place through these rose-colored glasses.

4420.name: Golden Heart Glasses
4420.description: The world just looks like a more expensive place through these gold-tinted glasses.

4456.name: Zombie Defense Force Helmet
4456.description: This helmet covers your vital brain region from zombie attack. Unfortunately, zombies only need to punch you to infect you, so it's not terribly useful.

4458.name: Zombie Defense Force Uniform
4458.description: This is the official uniform of the Zombie Defense Force! It has lots of pockets for your lip balm, candy, paper clips, and other key zombie-fighting tools.

4460.name: Zombie Defense Force Pants
4460.description: You could just wear any green pants and you probably wouldn't get in trouble, but these have a cool Z logo sewn into the inside waistband.

4462.name: Camouflage Facepaint
4462.description: They'll never see you coming. Unless they look anywhere other than your face. At least you might freak them out - "Ah, it's a guy with no face!!"

4464.name: AK-8087
4464.description: The ultimate zombie-slaying weapon. Or pumpkin-slaying.

4474.name: Skull Launcher
4474.description: The ultimate zombie weapon. Actually, the only zombie weapon - you can use this while you're a zombie! (Also usable by humans)

4476.name: Rainbow Kite
4476.description: The most colorful kite in all of Growtopia!

4478.name: Zombie Hound
4478.description: Braaainnss! This little puppy just wants to play! Or maybe he's hungry... hmmm...

4480.name: Crazy Zombie Hair
4480.description: The undead use a lot of hairspray.

4500.name: Chef's Whites
4500.description: Spotless! Until you actually start cooking.

4502.name: Chef's Cap
4502.description: A real chef doesn't wear the big poofy hat... this cap keeps your hair out of your eyes and out of the food without catching on fire regularly.

4504.name: Chef's Pants
4504.description: These are made of plastex polymer... all the sauce you spill on them just rolls right off! Onto your shoes.

4506.name: Butcher Knife
4506.description: This heavy blade is perfect for hacking through bones. Use it on a Cutting Board to chop up meat!

4508.name: Unearthly Synthoid
4508.description: It's completely synthetic life! Not of this Earth!

4510.name: Radioactive Synthoid
4510.description: It's completely synthetic life! Burning with radiation!

4512.name: Mysterious Synthoid
4512.description: It's completely synthetic life! How mysterious!

4514.name: Haunted Synthoid
4514.description: It's completely synthetic life! Possessed by synthetic unlife!

4518.name: Wobbly Dress
4518.description: It's difficult to tell whether Bungbi's dress is made of candy, or just styled to look like it...

4528.name: Ladybug Leaf
4528.description: Ladybugs are considered lucky, so consider yourself lucky that you found this sweet leaf that's making one follow you around!

4532.name: Shamrock Hair Pin
4532.description: Carry the luck of the Irish on your head! Only found in Blarney 6 and 8.

4534.name: Golden Razor Wings
4534.description: Slice through the air with the greatest of ease! And double jump.

4536.name: Cosmic Sky Horse
4536.description: This winged beast hails from a distant star system. Those mighty wings let you move fast, but they're not strong enough to double jump (living in space has atrophied its muscles).

4548.name: Spaceman Pants
4548.description: I don't know why, but most alien cultures insist on wearing clothes made of tin foil.

4550.name: Spaceman Suit
4550.description: I don't know why, but most alien cultures insist on wearing clothes made of tin foil.

4552.name: Synthetic Oculum
4552.description: The human eye sees a limited spectrum. Replace yours with these synthetic models! They transmit visual data direct to your central cortex. Unfortunately they also make you look cross-eyed.

4554.name: Cranial Lagomorph
4554.description: Don't be alarmed, but there may be a bunny on your head...

4590.name: Zraei's Dragoscarf
4590.description: When a normal scarf isn't enough... This dragon will assist you, granting Enhanced Digging, but only if you don't have it already. Sponsored by Bretz and Zraei - first to complete all epic quests!

4608.name: Mini Mallard
4608.description: Ducks instinctively follow their mothers around. This one just follows you because it's tied to your wrist, though.

4622.name: Chemist's Goggles
4622.description: The perfect eyewear for doing chemistry! Grants a 10% chance to not consume a chemical when you use a Chemsynth tool.

4626.name: TXMom's Crown
4626.description: Be honored to wear this beautiful crown. Sponsored by TXMom.

4628.name: Kudo's Carriage
4628.description: Your winged friends are happy to help you double jump! Sponsored by Kudobelle.

4644.name: Saxamaphone
4644.description: You can't punch when holding this, you're too busy ROCKING! Punch anywhere to play music. If you punch to your left or right, you can bend the note higher or lower. Punch in your own column to play the same notes that Sheet Music: Sax Note plays.

4646.name: Hazmat Boots
4646.description: In case of hazardous spills, you'll want a pair of these! Reduces Lava damage by 50%.

4648.name: Hazmat Pants
4648.description: Don't get a tear in these, or you'll be exposed to whatever lurks outside!

4650.name: Hazmat Suit
4650.description: This suit protects you from any sort of biochemical leaks. Or it would if you had zipped it up right. Yikes, good thing this was just a test!

4652.name: Hazmat Helmet
4652.description: Protects your precious face from exposure to harmful stuff.

4656.name: Uranium Necklace
4656.description: Wearing this will dramatically decrease your lifespan, but you'll be looking GOOD until it's over!

4660.name: Confetti Cannon
4660.description: Precision telescopic sights ensure you deliver the lethal payload directly to center mass.

4664.name: Hotpants
4664.description: You look hot in these. And so does your pet Jalapeño!

4676.name: Green Geiger V-Neck
4676.description: This shirt is made of... stuff.

4678.name: Blue Geiger V-Neck
4678.description: This shirt is made of... stuff.

4680.name: Purple Geiger V-Neck
4680.description: This shirt is made of... stuff.

4682.name: Orange Geiger V-Neck
4682.description: This shirt is made of... stuff.

4684.name: Xenoid Suit
4684.description: This skin-tight outfit really makes you look like a freaky alien.

4686.name: Xenoid Mask
4686.description: You seriously look like a freaky alien.

4688.name: Xenoid Claws
4688.description: These nasty claws make you look like a freaky alien.

4690.name: Xenoid Leggings
4690.description: These skin-tight leggings make you look like a freaky alien.

4692.name: Xenoid Shoes
4692.description: These awkward pointy heels make you look like a freaky alien.

4714.name: Minecart
4714.description: Nothing says adventure like riding around in a minecart! Tracks not included (But the wheels are modified to run on any surface).

4724.name: Mariachi Hat
4724.description: Not only does this fancy hat cover your head from the heat, it also makes you look amazing while you sing and dance.

4726.name: Mariachi Suit
4726.description: Look the part while playing your guitar like a true musician of Mexico.

4730.name: Seductive Rose
4730.description: Sticking a rose in your mouth seems to make your voice so much more attactive when you sing.

4732.name: Red Brimmed Hat
4732.description: A party hat for the most sophisticated.

4734.name: Red Formal Dress
4734.description: The finest dress for all your fancy dress parties.

4746.name: Diamond Horn
4746.description: This amazing horn transforms each time you unequip it. Try all 3 flavors! It also boosts your build range.

4748.name: Diamond Horns
4748.description: This amazing horn transforms each time you unequip it. Try all 3 flavors! It also boosts your build range.

4750.name: Diamond Devil Horns
4750.description: This amazing horn transforms each time you unequip it. Try all 3 flavors! It also boosts your build range.

4760.name: Pet Frog
4760.description: Ribbit ribbit. This little frog hops along everywhere you go!

4770.name: Pineapple Finger Ring
4770.description: This tasty pineapple ring is now stuck to your fingers. For some reason a creepy pineapple spider keeps following you around!

4772.name: Pineapple Glasses
4772.description: Pineapples in your eyes! Who wouldn't want that? Gives sticky vision which is suspiciously similar to normal vision but more sticky.

4778.name: Adventurer's Whip
4778.description: Only a true adventurer can swing this with such style.

4780.name: Adventurer's Sling Bag
4780.description: Look stylish while on all your greatest adventures. Who knows what you can hold in this. `4Doesn't actually give any more backpack space.``

4810.name: Floral Lei
4810.description: This particular one is lab-created, which you'd think is less classy, but they're much prettier.

4812.name: Zinc
4812.description: Protection from the sun. Well, at least your nose will be safe.

4814.name: Frangipani
4814.description: Put a flower in your hair. All the girls are doing it this summer! Just don't let Jim catch you stealing flowers from his garden... He's Crazy!

4816.name: Short Surfer Hair
4816.description: You've got that windblown chlorinated surfer look. It either makes you cool or a filthy beach bum. It's a fine line.

4818.name: Long Surfer Hair
4818.description: You've got that windblown chlorinated surfer look. It either makes you cool or a filthy beach bum. It's a fine line.

4820.name: Phoenix Crown
4820.description: Be honored to wear this beautiful crown. Light the way for all to see. No more than 500 of these exist in all of Growtopia.

4822.name: Surfboard
4822.description: Surf's up! This magical piece of fiberglass allows you to walk on water.

4824.name: Surfboard - Flame
4824.description: Surf's up! This magical piece of fiberglass allows you to walk on water. Now with Flames artwork!

4826.name: Surfboard - Wave
4826.description: Surf's up! This magical piece of fiberglass allows you to walk on water. Now with Wave artwork!

4828.name: Surfboard - Electric Green
4828.description: Surf's up! This magical piece of fiberglass allows you to walk on water. Now in Electric Green!

4840.name: Balloon Launcher
4840.description: With this launcher you can throw balloons farther. Not much good for anything else, though.

4860.name: Team Shorts - Punch
4860.description: Red with victory. Wear your team colors proudly.

4862.name: Team Shorts - Grow
4862.description: Green with glory. Wear your team colors proudly.

4864.name: Team Shorts - Build
4864.description: Blue with bravery. Wear your team colors proudly.

4866.name: Team Shirt - Punch
4866.description: Resplendent with redness. Wear your team colors proudly.

4868.name: Team Shirt - Grow
4868.description: Glorious with greenness. Wear your team colors proudly.

4870.name: Team Shirt - Build
4870.description: Beautiful with blueness. Wear your team colors proudly.

4880.name: Super Squirt Gun Jetpack
4880.description: Strap these to your back and get ready for the ride of your life. Use the power of pressurization to leap tall buildings in a single bound, then drift gently to Earth.

4924.name: Team Headband - Punch
4924.description: When there's a war on, sweat, water, and balloon fragments fly everywhere! This'll keep them all out of your eyes for more effective fighting!

4926.name: Team Headband - Grow
4926.description: When there's a war on, sweat, water, and balloon fragments fly everywhere! This'll keep them all out of your eyes for more effective fighting!

4928.name: Team Headband - Build
4928.description: When there's a war on, sweat, water, and balloon fragments fly everywhere! This'll keep them all out of your eyes for more effective fighting!

4930.name: Red Facepaint
4930.description: Looks like you've been punched in the face... or have you? Nope, it's just face paint and a whopping dose of team spirit.

4932.name: Green Facepaint
4932.description: Blend in with the trees for a surprise attack like a true Grow supporter.

4934.name: Blue Facepaint
4934.description: Even Sir William Wallace would be envious of your team spirit. FREEEEDDDOOOOMMMMM! Wait! This is just a balloon war...

4936.name: Red Floaty Balloon
4936.description: Hold on tight and hopefully you won't float up into the sky. There's a song with 99 red balloons, but sadly, this is only 1.

4938.name: Green Floaty Balloon
4938.description: Hold on tight and hopefully you won't float up into the sky. Make everyone green with envy when they see your beautiful balloon.

4940.name: Blue Floaty Balloon
4940.description: Hold on tight and hopefully you won't float up into the sky. The balloon might be blue, but you'll never be!

4946.name: Super Squirt Gun Jetpack Pants
4946.description: Strap these to your hips and get ready for the ride of your life. Use the power of pressurization to leap tall buildings in a single bound, then drift gently to Earth.

4948.name: Solar Chariot
4948.description: Run at the speed of, well... horses. On FIRE!

4950.name: Silk Corset
4950.description: Feeling fat? You could exercise... or you could just cram your gut into one of these! Oh sure, you may end up with spinal deformities, but beauty demands pain!

4952.name: Gothic Corset
4952.description: Feeling fat? You could exercise... or you could just cram your gut into one of these! Oh sure, you may end up with spinal deformities, but beauty demands pain!

4954.name: Unicorn Hair
4954.description: Like unicorns? Well, so does the rest of the internet, and now you can look like one, too!

4956.name: Emerald Pickaxe
4956.description: This tool is worth more than the stuff you mine with it!

4960.name: Megalodon
4960.description: Amazing! You have caught the incredibly rare and elusive Megalodon. The largest shark ever. Class: MEGA-SIZED! Along with a mega diet, it's incredibly powerful and deadly. See this shark in action in Hungry Shark World!

4964.name: Black Espadrille
4964.description: Perfect for kicking back - or kicking butt! - in the tropical sun.

4966.name: Checkered Espadrille
4966.description: Perfect for kicking back - or kicking butt! - in the tropical sun.

4968.name: Sports Bra
4968.description: Get running and show off your curves while you're at it!

4970.name: Pink Aura
4970.description: You are burning with lively energies! Also, double-jump power.

4972.name: Blue Aura
4972.description: You are burning with brilliant energy! Also, double-jump power.

4974.name: Wedding Headdress
4974.description: Everyone should look like a queen at their own wedding.

4976.name: Sarong
4976.description: Casual, comfortable, and affordable! What more could you want?

4978.name: Dress with Smock
4978.description: This light cotton dress is adorned with adorable stripes. Aww, how cute.

4980.name: Waistcoat and Jacket
4980.description: The perfect garment for housing a pocketwatch and monocle. Will also keep you warm during those long winter days.

4986.name: Inside-Out Devil Wings
4986.description: You don't jump higher than with normal devil wings, but man, you DO look pretty cool, like an inside-out devil. Wait... doesn't that make you an angel?!

4988.name: Speed Medallion
4988.description: This amulet bestows you with speed energy, making you run so fast that lightning trails behind you!

4990.name: Skateboard
4990.description: Skate or die! Alternatively you can live by doing other things, like eating and breathing. Actually, do those even if you ARE skating.

4996.name: Burning Hands
4996.description: Spew jets of flame from your hands!

4998.name: Riding Turtle
4998.description: It's not the fastest transportation around, but it is the bumpiest!

5002.name: Playful Fire Sprite
5002.description: Looks like a little blob of fire is following you! Makes sense.

5004.name: Playful Wind Sprite
5004.description: Looks like a little purple blob is following you! Doesn't make as much sense, but the air-colored ones didn't show up so well, so we dyed it!

5006.name: Playful Wood Sprite
5006.description: Looks like a little green blob is following you! Makes sense.

5008.name: Playful Water Sprite
5008.description: Looks like a little blob of water is following you! Makes sense.

5010.name: Plate Greaves
5010.description: Tired of being kicked in the shins? Aren't we all?

5012.name: Flaming Horsie
5012.description: There was a saddle on here, but it burned up. Eh, you can probably ride bareback.

5016.name: Newspaper
5016.description: Great for checking the daily gazette. Equip to read.

5018.name: Riding Chicken
5018.description: A feathered friend to carry you to and fro! Best part? He'll never peck you to death with hordes of his angry pals!

5020.name: Prismatic Aura
5020.description: A fantastic aura of prismatic energy pulses around you, turning heads and bending the laws of gravity to your will. The power to double jump - and look awesome - is yours!

5022.name: Chicken Plow
5022.description: Ancient magic has unlocked the secrets of advanced chicken farming! Now, for the first time, your chicken will PLANT seeds instead of eating them! (When equipped, will plant whatever seed you have selected as you move!)

5088.name: Ghastly Robe
5088.description: Clutching darkness whispers from the very essence of this dire robe. A mantle of unfathomable shadow, only the brave dare wear it, for it is marked by the haunting touch of the grave. We don't know where it came from - only that it must have been incredibly, deeply dark.

5118.name: Scarecrow Mask
5118.description: Act out your inner villain - or scare the bejeezus out of some birds - with this creepy harvest headgear. Who knew burlap and stitches could be so unsettling?

5120.name: Rake
5120.description: Tear up some topsoil with this handy home implement! Can anything really be better than punching, though?

5122.name: Cloud Rabbit
5122.description: Bunny bunny bunny cloud cloud cloud bunny cloud bunny cloud bunny bunny cloud cloud

5124.name: Dryad
5124.description: This pint-sized woodland sprite will defend the beauty of nature - and you - with all her adorable might! Just don't eat salads around  her - it's very insensitive.

5200.name: Harvest Scarf
5200.description: A whirling wisp of fabric to accent your perfect harvest style. Will also keep you warm with extra snuzzly fibers. Seriously, this thing is, like, TEN times snuzzlier than the next leading scarf.

5206.name: Cloak of Falling Waters
5206.description: Mystic whorls of water have been bound in shifting fabric to forge a cape fit for only the wettest, wildest Growtopians. Command one of the primeval elements through the Azure Gem of Waters pinned to this gorgeous cloak and use it to extinguish even the mightiest blazes. Or, y'know, spray people with it. It's your cape.

5208.name: Demon Megalodon
5208.description: Oh, what have you DONE?! This terrifying shark combines prehistoric predator power with the unholy corruption of Growganoth to create an unstoppable chomping machine! Class: DEMON-SIZED! See this shark in action in Hungry Shark World!

5210.name: El Pollo Diablo
5210.description: THE DEMON CHICKEN! A feathered fiend to scare and carry you to and fro! The best part? He'll absolutely peck you to death, just for fun! ...wait, that's bad.

5212.name: Doom Plow
5212.description: Are your crops not sufficiently terrified? Well, buckle up, because the power of Growganoth has overcharged the measely chicken plow into this fire-belching, flame-spewing monstrosity. Crazed chicken included. Do not operate while on prescription medication. Or for any other reason.

5214.name: Killer Doctor's Smock
5214.description: Calmly perform surgery in this horrific top. Your new and gruesome bedside manner will be an instant hit with those meat sack- uh, I mean, patients.

5216.name: Killer Doctor's Cap
5216.description: Terror is the new black! Nurse, pass me the scalpel!

5218.name: Killer Doctor's Face Mask
5218.description: Scare the bejeezus out of your patients with this deeply creepy surgeon's item. No unwanted surgery is complete without an evil mask to veil your villainous smile!

5220.name: Killer Doctor's Pants
5220.description: Hit the dance floor - or the nearest surgery suite - in these breezy, yet unsettling scrubs. Nothing says comfort like a two-legged memento of your latest surgery success (or failure)!

5222.name: Demon Clown Mask
5222.description: Hey, don't run away! IT really hurts my feelings when everyone flees my festive presence!

5224.name: Neon Voodoo Mask - Pure White
5224.description: Electric voodoo stylings to put the frighteners on your friends! Now in woeful white!

5226.name: Neon Voodoo Mask - Electric Blue
5226.description: Electric voodoo stylings to put the frighteners on your friends! Now in blazing blue!

5228.name: Neon Voodoo Mask - Shocking Pink
5228.description: Electric voodoo stylings to put the frighteners on your friends! Now in petrifying pink!

5230.name: Neon Voodoo Mask - Plasma Green
5230.description: Electric voodoo stylings to put the frighteners on your friends! Now in ghastly green!

5232.name: Fish Monster Mask
5232.description: Ew! This thing is frilly, wet, and slimy - most places won't want you around in it, except maybe those hipster fish restaurants. May I recommend the "Black Lagoon Risotto"?

5234.name: Demented Cowl
5234.description: Make friends with the shadows in this crazed - yet cool - cowl of darkness! Looming darkness may give those who wear this creepy cloth a pass...

5248.name: Headsman's Hood
5248.description: Heading to a Halloween party and don't want your beautiful face to take attention away from everyone else? Hide it behind this creepy hood and sneak about in secret!

5264.name: Neon Nerves
5264.description: Check it out, chummer! Slap this colour-shifting circuitry under your skin and dazzle those dataslaves with wired speed! The only thing they'll catch is a trail of arctic light as you leave them in the dust!

5266.name: Static Hair
5266.description: A shocking style, for sure, but there might be more to it than that! Maybe you should check to see if it reacts with any other electrical sources...

5268.name: Amethyst Choker
5268.description: Clasp your neck in this flawlessly cut piece of jewelwork, and be the envy of all.

5276.name: Celestial Lance
5276.description: Everyone's heard of crafting swords from fallen stars, but this incredible weapon is forged from the CONSTELLATIONS themselves, radiating with the might of the heavens. Vile corruption and ancient darkness are no match for the glory of this device, for it can banish them utterly.

5278.name: Celestial Halo
5278.description: Ripped from the heavens, stolen by demons, and now bequeathed to you. This miraculous crown will make you as light as the aether itself - a fitting gift for one who would stand against the darkness.

5286.name: Turkey Onesie Hood
5286.description: The crown of your turkey ensemble! Just don't lose your head over it! Gobble gobble gobble!

5288.name: Turkey Onesie Body
5288.description: No turkey is complete without a gobbly body, and this is the best you can find! Gobble gobble gobble!

5290.name: Turkey Onesie Legs
5290.description: Do the turkey trot with these gobble-tastic gams! Gobble gobble gobble!

5292.name: Turkey Onesie Feet
5292.description: Find your fall footing with these turkey toes! Gobble gobble gobble!

5294.name: Turkey Carving Set
5294.description: Reach out and get a handle on the holidays with a turkey touch! Gobble gobble gobble!

5296.name: Turkey Onesie Tail
5296.description: Look your Thanksgiving best with this wobbly tail! Gobble gobble gobble!

5298.name: Turkey Onesie Beak
5298.description: Peck your dinner to death - just like a real turkey! Gobble gobble gobble!

5322.name: Zephyr Helm
5322.description: We've captured mystic winds in gleaming gold and used super-complicated rituals to transform them into a helm fit for a king! Don't bother trying to figure out how we did it, though. We, uh, kinda lost the notes after someone left a window open.

5414.name: Gingerbread Man
5414.description: A deliciously dangerous Gingerbread Man. Watch out! He's full of anger - as well as sugar - and ready to defend you against all your holiday foes!

5418.name: Ice Skates of Winter
