5418.description: Glide across the ice like a pro in these dashing ice skates. No more sliding around like a jerk!

5420.name: Snowshoes
5420.description: Perfect for trekking through snow and doubles up as a nice pair of rackets, if you get the urge to play some tennis while you're out on the tundra.

5422.name: Sleigh of Winter
5422.description: Everyone will want a ride on this luxurious winter sleigh, especially with your trusty Reindeer leading the way! (We recommend charging competitive rates and hiring a marketing firm for any new sleigh-focused business models).

5424.name: Winter Frost Bow
5424.description: Tired of shooting boring old arrows from stupid normal bows? Well THIS holiday beast of a bow shoots freezing ice shards! How cool is that?!

5426.name: Ice Serpent Scarf
5426.description: You might think a frosty ice serpent wouldn't be useful in the cold, but think again! This elegant creature will wrap your neck in so much friendship, you'll stay toasty warm all winter. Um, just don't let it snuggle you TOO hard...

5428.name: Lumberjack Coat - Scarlet
5428.description: Everybody toss on this scarlet coat and say: "I'm a lumberjack and I'm okay, I chop down trees and I work all day..."

5430.name: Lumberjack Coat - Olive
5430.description: Everybody toss on this olive coat and say: "I'm a lumberjack and I'm okay, I chop down trees and I work all day..."

5432.name: Lumberjack Coat - Navy
5432.description: Everybody toss on this navy coat and say: "I'm a lumberjack and I'm okay, I chop down trees and I work all day..."

5434.name: Lumberjack Coat - Midnight
5434.description: Everybody toss on this midnight coat and say: "I'm a lumberjack and I'm okay, I chop down trees and I work all day..."

5436.name: Mountain Coat
5436.description: Toss this on to keep warm and become one with the wilderness. Maybe try to befriend a bear while you're at it? No, that's crazy...

5438.name: Mountain Cap
5438.description: Whatever critter became this cap, I hope it was proud to know it would be forever immortalized as a sweet accessory for the top of your head.

5440.name: Mountain Boots
5440.description: Trudge through trackless forests and raging mountain rivers in these old-timey boots.

5444.name: Parka Hood - Blue
5444.description: Prevent your face from freezing off and avoid the embarrassing outcome of having icicles dangling from your nose with the help of this cozy blue parka hood.

5446.name: Puffy Blue Jacket
5446.description: If you ever saw a jacket and thought, "That's not NEARLY puffy enough for me," then this poofed-up piece of apparel will be perfect for you. Get it now to stay warm AND awesome all winter long!

5454.name: Gross Golden Holiday Sweater
5454.description: Finally, the most luxuriously horrible holiday sweater you've been waiting for. Your super-wealthy, ultra-classy grandma would be proud.

5456.name: Silverstar Bow
5456.description: Forged from stardust, aether winds, and purest silver, this beautiful bow belongs amongst the heavens - you must have been incredibly fortunate to count it among your possessions. Well, that or you're just a really good trader. Either way, let's shoot some stuff!

5480.name: Rayman's Fist
5480.description: The perfect punch! Ever wanted to send a disembodied fist flying across the land like Rayman? Well, now you can! Land a blow like none other with this furious fist. It even comes with a friend: Globox!

5482.name: Rayman's Hair
5482.description: Halt your fall with this helicopter hair, courtesy of Rayman himself! How does it spin like that? And more importantly, how does it look so amazing?

5484.name: Rayman's Hoodie
5484.description: Stay warm and stylish with Rayman's personal hoodie. It even smells like him: waffles, vanilla, and determination!

5486.name: Rayman's Shoes
5486.description: Rayman's spectacular shoes are yours! These are a toe-tingling delight, with all kinds of padding and luxury features you'd expect from a platform-hopping pro like Rayman. Toss these on and enjoy comfortable - and stylish - foot-based movement from now on!

5488.name: Rayman's Nose
5488.description: Taking "Got your nose!" to a whole new level, aren't you? Somehow, some way, you've wound up with Rayman's nose! I hope he has a spare!

5490.name: Equalizer Tee
5490.description: Celebrate optimal sound balance and look great at the same time!

5492.name: Ultra Equalizer Tee
5492.description: This ultra version not only celebrates optimal sound balance, but it does it with mesmerizing movement! Ooh, the colors...

5496.name: Flame Tee
5496.description: Don't worry - no matter how realistic this t-shirt's flames may be, it won't light anything on fire! ...though you WILL look super hot!

5498.name: Ultra Flame Tee
5498.description: Don't let the flickering flames of this ultra version fool you - this shirt is NOT currently on fire! ...but your dance moves are!

5500.name: Party Light Wave Vest
5500.description: Be the light of the party with this bright and beautiful vest!

5502.name: Ultra Party Light Wave Vest
5502.description: Turn up the awesome with this ultra version - it'll really light up the night!

5504.name: Party Style Top Hat
5504.description: This isn't just a great party hat - it's the GREATEST party hat. Top the evening (and your noggin) with this finely-honed piece of wearable art!

5506.name: Ultra Party Glow Top Hat
5506.description: We've taken the greatest party hat known to science and given it an ultra upgrade. Okay, NOW this is clearly the best possible hat. How else could it be better?

5508.name: Party Style Shades
5508.description: Hypnotize your fellow Growtopians as they stare longingly into these dazzling shades!

5510.name: Ultra Party Glow Shades
5510.description: Take your party powers of shade-based hypnotism to the next level with this ultra version and never be friendless again!

5512.name: Party Glow Sneakers
5512.description: Light up the night - and the dance floor - by popping these hotly-glowing goodies over your toes!

5514.name: Party Style Scarf
5514.description: Wow, look at those colors! Ring your neck with the perfect party scarf.

5516.name: Ultra Party Glow Scarf
5516.description: Turn up the heat with this ultra version of the party scarf - just be careful the only thing you set on fire is the dance floor! Those bulbs get hot!

5540.name: Maidmare
5540.description: A terrifying creature forged by the awful effects of radiation! Your enemies will flee in terror from this creepy creature's mega fishy, slimetacular wet smooch attack!

5544.name: Riding Double-Headed Angel-Devil Fish
5544.description: Good heavens! This is one heck of a riding fish. Embodying the best (and worst) of the cosmos, this split-faced aberration loves giving good and bad advice while carrying you to and fro.

5546.name: Double-Headed Angel-Devil Fish Leash
5546.description: Good heavens! This is one heck of a pet. Embodying the best (and worst) of the cosmos, this split-faced aberration loves giving good and bad advice while floating at your side.

5550.name: Absolutely Real Elephant Fish Leash
5550.description: A genuine elephant fish pet that totally exists. Ha! Look at his silly nose! Will delight onlookers as it follows you around, dispensing wisdom and menacing peanut sellers.

5554.name: Riding Cuttlefish
5554.description: Writhing tentacles clear the way as you ride into town on this slimy beast! All shall tremble before your mighty fish- err... mollusc!

5556.name: Cuttlefish Leash
5556.description: You may think this is a fish, but you'd be wrong! Cuttlefish are molluscs - but "Cuttlemollusc," doesn't quite roll off the tongue does it? Either way, it'll be happy to follow you around, no matter what you call it.

5558.name: Riding Stonefish
5558.description: Through careful training, one of the most poisonous fish in the world can now be ridden without fear! Careful, though - they're still quite pointy.

5560.name: Stonefish Leash
5560.description: This is one of the most poisonous fish in the world... and you have it following you around?! You're crazy!

5562.name: Riding Sand Shark
5562.description: Out of the sand and happy on land, this sand shark has decided to let you ride it around. Isn't that nice of him?

5564.name: Sand Shark Leash
5564.description: Out of the sand and happy on land, this sand shark has decided to follow you around like a toothy balloon. Isn't that nice of him?

5566.name: Riding Seahorse
5566.description: Neither fish nor horse, but after careful feeding, it's still a trusty steed! Ride this undersea mount into battle and become a Knight of the Seahorse! It's a very prestigious order, you know.

5568.name: Seahorse Leash
5568.description: This rare fish is very hard to keep in an aquarium. Lucky for you, this is a videogame, and it's happy to float beside you and impress everyone who sees it!

5570.name: Battle Gar
5570.description: The snappiest, toothiest, chompin'est fish is out of the tank - and out for blood! This battle gar will chow down on your foes and bring you victory! ...just don't get too close to those snappy jaws!

5572.name: Battle Mutant Fish
5572.description: Strange mutations can make for the meanest fish, as this battling mutant will prove! Good thing it's on your side - with that extra eye, it can always keep a lookout while it takes down your foes!

5576.name: Riding Alpha Great White Shark
5576.description: How do you make the king predator of the sea even cooler? Toss a saddle on and ride them into the sunset, of course! Little-known fact: Great whites love Westerns, and secretly wish they could survive in the desert.

5578.name: Alpha Great White Shark Leash
5578.description: The king predator of the sea will follow you around and watch your back. Take him on dates for an extra-romantic companion. Nobody can resist the owner of a deep sea terror, and this is one of the deepest, most terrifying things you can get!

5582.name: Riding Weird Manta Ray
5582.description: This voracious beast can now be ridden across the land, striking fear (and awe) into all who gaze upon it. Perfect for those who always wanted to ride a carpet with teeth.

5584.name: Weird Manta Ray Leash
5584.description: Flapping wings curl through the air at your side, but this is no pet bird - it's a really creepy manta ray! Happy to be freed from toxic sludge, it floats beside you as a loyal friend.

5586.name: Goldfish Leash
5586.description: These aren't made of gold, which is actually a good thing - otherwise they'd be too heavy to float beside you, looking all fishy and cool!

5588.name: Catfish Leash
5588.description: Hey! It's not a real cat at all! It doesn't even purr! Well, at least it's friendly enough to follow you around. Here kitty!

5590.name: Sunfish Leash
5590.description: If there's one fish that can brighten your day as it follows you around, this is it. Warning: Not a real sun.

5592.name: Bass Leash
5592.description: Don't slap the bass - you'd just hurt it, and all it wants is to follow you around.

5594.name: Mahi Mahi Leash
5594.description: The fish so nice they named it twice - now it will follow you around, and thrice as nice!

5596.name: Dogfish Leash
5596.description: This adorable Dogfish will follow you around like a little lost puppy. They're so obedient!

5598.name: Whale Leash
5598.description: This giant of the ocean is a mammal and extremely heavy - so how the heck does it float whilst following you around?

5600.name: Picasso Triggerfish Leash
5600.description: Also known as Hawaii's state fish, the Humuhumunukunukuapua'a, which is probably the best name ever. Regardless of what you call it, it'll still follow you around with majestic grace.

5604.name: Goldfish Bowler Hat
5604.description: Who's to say you can't wear a goldfish on your head? Silly people, that's who. They just don't understand how great it is to rock a goldfish upstairs. Don't listen to them. They're not cool like you.

5606.name: Catfish Slippers
5606.description: The warmest, fluffiest fish-based slippers around, these are the cat's meow!

5608.name: Dogfish Slippers
5608.description: Arf! For times when your dogs are barkin', slide on a pair of these slippers and relax in fishy comfort.

5610.name: Picasso Face
5610.description: Someone's turned this triggerfish into a masterpiece for your face! Awesome!

5612.name: Tentacle Beard
5612.description: Arrrr, me hearties! Sail the seven seas with flailing tentacles on your face, and all will know your name and tremble before your rubbery glory.

5642.name: Cupid Leash
5642.description: This cherubic companion brings romance wherever he goes! With feathery wings and a love-laced bow, he's an unstoppable source of sweetness.

5644.name: Heart Shirt
5644.description: Forget wearing your heart on your sleeve - put it right out there on your shirt so everyone can see how lovable you are!

5646.name: Golden Heart Shirt
5646.description: True heartthrobs don't just assume people will realize how amazing they are - they wear awesome animated shirts like this to show off their romantic might for them!

5648.name: USMom's Talaria
5648.description: Made to the exacting specifications of its angelic sponsor, these winged wonders will get you where you need to be in a blur of flapping finery! Sponsored by USMom.

5650.name: Golden Talaria
5650.description: For times when ordinary winged shoes won't do, pop these shining masterpieces on and show the world you're not just faster and flightier than the average footwearer - you're also fancier.

5652.name: Heart Necklace
5652.description: A heart that's incomplete is a symbol of want, of the need to belong, and that means this necklace is looking for a match. Find your valentine out there and be whole again!

5712.name: Will of the Wild
5712.description: The powerful forces of the wild elements; fire, water and earth live in this ethereal hair - just don't mention the air element! The mage that tamed these wild forces could never control his wind, and he's already the butt of all jokes at mage parties!

5718.name: Drinks Hat
5718.description: Celebrate alllll day - *hic* - long with this hands-free, extra-*hic*-strong drinking device. Urp. 'Scuse me.

5720.name: Faerie Face Paint
5720.description: Bring out your natural beauty and turn yourself into a true spirit of nature. You won't get magic powers from it, though - unless you count looking lovely as a power!

5722.name: Irish Dance Dress
5722.description: You might fling your shoes off when the spirit of the dance takes over, but at least you can be confident this dress will stay firmly on your body.

5736.name: Rainbowfish Leash
5736.description: Nobody knows where the name of this fish came from - it's quite mysterious - but what we DO know is that it'll fill your world with happiness and glee as it follows you around.

5738.name: Rainbow Cape
5738.description: A mesmerizing rainbow ripple cape. Dazzle your friends!

5740.name: Magical Rainbow Fishing Rod
5740.description: Equip this and then use bait on water next to you to go fishing! All you have to do is wait for a bite, and then punch the fish before it escapes! If you miss, your bait is wasted, so punch fast. You will suffer mischievous effects when catching fish with this rod! Only found in Blarney 6 and 8.

5754.name: Draconic Wings
5754.description: Shimmering scales of pure power coat these marvelous wings, marking them as the sign of the truly fortunate. These give you the power to double jump... and look amazing. Fortune has smiled on you for possessing this! There are only 1300 in existence!

5756.name: Red Dragon Head
5756.description: The head of the dragon! What else could you add to this, I wonder...?

5758.name: Red Dragon Body
5758.description: The body of the dragon! See how long you can make it!

5760.name: Red Dragon Legs
5760.description: The legs of the dragon! See how long you can make it!

5762.name: Red Dragon Tail
5762.description: The tail of the dragon! An end, perhaps... or is it a new beginning?

5960.name: Bunny Toy
5960.description: You can never have enough cute bunnies! Carry this little guy with you wherever you go!

5962.name: Pastel Dress - Blue
5962.description: Spring fashion has arrived! 'Tis the seasons for brightening skies, growing seeds, and this blue pastel dress!

5964.name: Pastel Dress - Pink
5964.description: Spring fashion has arrived! 'Tis the seasons for brightening skies, growing seeds, and this pink pastel dress!

5966.name: Pastel Dress - Purple
5966.description: Spring fashion has arrived! 'Tis the seasons for brightening skies, growing seeds, and this purple pastel dress!

5968.name: Pastel Dress - Orange
5968.description: Spring fashion has arrived! 'Tis the seasons for brightening skies, growing seeds, and this orange pastel dress!

5970.name: Pastel Dress - Yellow
5970.description: Spring fashion has arrived! 'Tis the seasons for brightening skies, growing seeds, and this yellow pastel dress!

5972.name: Pastel Dress - Aqua
5972.description: Spring fashion has arrived! 'Tis the seasons for brightening skies, growing seeds, and this aqua pastel dress!

5974.name: Pastel Dress - Green
5974.description: Spring fashion has arrived! 'Tis the seasons for brightening skies, growing seeds, and this green pastel dress!

5976.name: Pastel Tie
5976.description: Show your business side this spring with a power pastel tie! That promotion is yours!

5986.name: Totally Legit Bunnyfish Leash
5986.description: Amazing! You have trained the incredibly rare, elusive, and completely real Bunnyfish! 100% cute, 0% fake!

5988.name: Totally Legit Bunny Ears
5988.description: These totally legit ears somehow allow you to have your actual ears too. Now that's bunny magic!

6004.name: Bear Spirit
6004.description: You are one with your spirit animal! The awesome guidance of the Bear Spirit has given you the gift of double jump! Which is something wild bears do. Don't look it up. Just trust us.

6006.name: Rainbow Hair
6006.description: Style your hair in shimmering rainbow light to amuse your friends and infuriate Leprechauns. Also works great for reading late at night.

6008.name: Intergalactic Warrior Hair
6008.description: YOUR HAIR IS NOW PURE POWER AND THAT POWER IS OVER NINE THOUSAAAAAAAAAAND! BELIEVE IN THIS HAIR, FOR THIS HAIR BELIEVES IN YOU!

6026.name: Whip of Truth
6026.description: Whirling with wisdom and knowledge long forgotten, the Whip of Truth can pull secrets from the very air - AND those you whap with it! Under its gleaming golden might, no falsehoods can survive...

6028.name: Ring Of Shrinking
6028.description: Become your very own Mini-You! Fool your friends with this amazing optical illusion, now with complete lack of particle emitters! Once again, we reiterate that this is an illusion - Growtech accepts no responsibility for users getting stuck in tight spaces (or inability to use auras convincingly).

6036.name: Axolotl Leash
6036.description: Kudos to you! You've trained a fish that's actually a salamander! Now that he's worldly and wise, this mighty little Mexican salamander is all too happy to follow you around!

6038.name: Riding Axolotl
6038.description: After some intensive training, this cute little Mexican critter can now be ridden across the land - and he's stronger than he looks. Ride through town and give a jaunty wave to jealous passersby from atop this majestic steed!

6040.name: Riding Fiesta Axolotl
6040.description: What's this now? The cute little Mexican critter is wearing a sombrero? Well, things just got a whole lot more adorable, didn't they?

6042.name: Feather Headdress
6042.description: If you're the slightest bit ticklish, stay away from this flamboyant, feather-adorned headgear. If not, then wear it with grace and become The Tickle Master!

6044.name: Fiesta Mariachi Guitar
6044.description: Bring the party everywhere you go. When you /dance with this, you can perform for your friends!

6056.name: Bandolier
6056.description: The favored garb of a legendary outlaw, this is the perfect gear for rustling cattle, robbing trains, and - surprisingly - afternoon tea. Who knew?

6058.name: Dual Six-Shooters
6058.description: Did you shoot 11 bullets... or 12? Trick question: These guns never run out! Sure, NONE of Growtopia's guns ever run out, but these come loaded with extra grit and vigor! Yahoo!

6064.name: Spirit Guide
6064.description: This little ghost will guide you on your travels, and he'll even reduce the chance of a Spirit Board breaking when summoning ghosts! Aww, isn't that nice of him?

6086.name: Neutron Power Glove
6086.description: Summons deadly spectral energies to give you the awesome power to punch ghosts dead! Well, again. Actually, we're not sure where they go... but they're not happy about it!

6092.name: Foil Hat
6092.description: Paranoid there's someone out there, inclined to meddle with your mind? Don this fancy little hat and fear no more! Its foily goodness will protect you from even the most powerful mind control!

6106.name: Pineapple Fish Leash
6106.description: This sweet (and slightly sour) fish has flopped out of the tropical waters it calls home and onto a leash! Take him out for your next luau!

6108.name: Pineapple Tiki Mask
6108.description: Show off your pineapple spirit with this leering mask! Looks just as great on a shelf as it does on your face! Wait... was this actually a fish at one point?

6110.name: Pineapple Spear
6110.description: Now you're playing with pine-power! Wield the true might of the pineapple and blast blocks into oblivion with this delicious spear!

6112.name: Pine-ch Buggy
6112.description: Part car, part pineapple, all style. There might be a lot of cars on the road, but none can compare to the four-wheeled fury of the Pine-ch Buggy!

6120.name: Super Pineapple Guardian Charm
6120.description: Pining for protection? Make the power of the pineapple guardian personal with this amazing necklace! When activated, grants immunity to thrown consumables for 5 seconds (starts as soon as you get hit), followed by a 5-minute cooldown.

6144.name: Aurora Wings
6144.description: Glowing with the majesty of the high heavens, these wings shift and shimmer with all the colors of a wild aurora. They also send out shimmering motes of light, which not only look amazing, but also make everything 200% more sparkly!

6188.name: Tunic - Royal Red
6188.description: Rocking the clothing world for thousands of years and still going strong, this tunic isn't just a medieval fashion statement: It's also red.

6190.name: Tunic - Royal Blue
6190.description: Rocking the clothing world for thousands of years and still going strong, this tunic isn't just a medieval fashion statement: It's also blue.

6192.name: Tunic - Royal Green
6192.description: Rocking the clothing world for thousands of years and still going strong, this tunic isn't just a medieval fashion statement: It's also green.

6194.name: Guild Steed
6194.description: A trusty steed for a trusted guildmate! Collect one for all your allies and have a parade! Or keep them all to yourself and taunt your friends. Either way, this horse is just happy to help.

6196.name: Guild Night Stallion
6196.description: A mighty steed for a mighty guild. This midnight mount has giant hooves and an even bigger attitude. Perfect for real leaders!

6216.name: Architect's Robes
6216.description: Keep warm long into the night with these well-tailored robes. Perfect for workaholic architects who want to jot down just a few more diagrams before bedtime!

6218.name: Architect's Compass
6218.description: Keep your finest tools close at hand by putting them around your neck on a chain! Looks pretty blingin' too, which, as any architect will tell you, is a must-have for neckwear.

6220.name: Architect's Beret
6220.description: Cover up your wispy architect hair with this classy beret, ensuring the whole world will know you're cultured, and making it less likely for them to guess you're bald.

6222.name: Architect's Beard
6222.description: No master of diagrams and charts can be trusted unless they also have a big, highly-educated beard to back them up. Now THAT'S the face of an architect!

6236.name: Anomalizing Reliable Hammer
6236.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks, and guaranteed to never break!

6238.name: Anomalizing Pristine Hammer
6238.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

6240.name: Exquisite Hammer
6240.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks!

6242.name: Anomalizing Reliable Scythe
6242.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected trees, and guaranteed to never break!

6244.name: Anomalizing Pristine Scythe
6244.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected trees! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

6246.name: Exquisite Scythe
6246.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected trees!

6248.name: Anomalizing Reliable Bone Saw
6248.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected patients, and guaranteed to never break!

6250.name: Anomalizing Pristine Bone Saw
6250.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected patients! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

6252.name: Exquisite Bone Saw
6252.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected patients!

6254.name: Reliable Anomarod
6254.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected fish, and guaranteed to never break!

6256.name: Pristine Anomarod
6256.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected fish! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

6258.name: Exquisite Anomarod
6258.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected fish! This exquisite rod will catch 10% bigger fish than normal.

6260.name: Amulet of Force
6260.description: The mystic Jewel of Might empowers this amulet, lending its supernatural strength to the wearer and giving them a little extra oomph when they want to break stuff!

6262.name: Glove of the Giants
6262.description: A big glove demands a big owner, but this glove takes it a step further - it'll MAKE you bigger! Slip the glove on and send the might of the giants coursing through your veins. You'll be towering over your friends and squashing your problems like bugs in no time!

6264.name: Summer Blaster Shirt
6264.description: Rock the season with the new Summer Blaster style! This shirt doesn't just say you're cool - it also says you're hot! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

6266.name: Ultra Summer Blaster Shirt
6266.description: Rock the season in ULTRA Summer Blaster style! This shirt doesn't just say you're ULTRA COOL - it also says you're ULTRA HOT! Try to find another line of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

6268.name: Summer Blaster Pants
6268.description: Rock the season with the new Summer Blaster style! These pants don't just say you're cool - they also say you're hot! Try to find another line of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

6270.name: Ultra Summer Blaster Pants
6270.description: Rock the season in ULTRA Summer Blaster style! These pants don't just say you're ULTRA COOL - they also say you're ULTRA HOT! Try to find another line of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

6284.name: Flaming Aura
6284.description: Strap on this awesome item and prepare to receive an aura of brilliant fire energy! Also, double-jump power. We're not sure how that part works.

6294.name: Raptor Legs
6294.description: Everybody do the dinosaur! Pop on these prehistoric legs and leap into the fray with all the speed of an angry raptor! Just be careful, or you might go out the same way - with a fiery meteor!

6298.name: Smoog the Great Dragon
6298.description: Ancient flames and armored scales await your command! Smoog is a proud and fearsome beast, but he's decided to allow you - yes, YOU - to have the honor of being his rider! Who needs horses or cars when you can sit astride a mighty DRAGON?

6300.name: Dancemaster's Crown
6300.description: Let's boogie! Nobody can resist the awesome beat of the DANCEMASTER - and when you wear this gleaming helm, that's you! Use its funky power to get everybody's groove on and start a dance party at the drop of a hat! This hat, specifically.

6302.name: Summer Blaster Glasses
6302.description: Rock the season with the new Summer Blaster style! These glasses don't just say you're cool - they also say you're hot! Try to find another kind of eyewear that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

6304.name: Ultra Summer Blaster Glasses
6304.description: Rock the season in ULTRA Summer Blaster style! These glasses don't just say you're ULTRA COOL - they also say you're ULTRA HOT! Try to find another kind of eyewear that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

6308.name: Beach Ball
6308.description: Inflated with extra summer fun! Bounce this onto the beach and relax in the sun and sand!

6310.name: Watermelon Slice
6310.description: Juicy and sweet, but definitely NOT seedless! Take a bite and get ready to blast the world with weaponized watermelon!

6312.name: Phoenix Sword
6312.description: Swirling flame and eternal glory are yours, for you possess the blade of emperors: The Phoenix Sword! Astonishingly rare, incredibly powerful, and explosively sharp, this weapon will proclaim its wielder as a force to be reckoned with! Wield it well, for you are worthy. There are only 500 of them in existence, in all of Growtopia!

6318.name: Firefin Leash
6318.description: This blazing fish is out of the water and at your side, happy to light your way with glowing gills and searing scales!

6320.name: Flaming Floaties
6320.description: Not a strong swimmer? Toss these fire-themed floaties on and keep your arms dry! At least they'll be okay! Not sure about the rest of you, though...

6334.name: Danieldd's Chimera Wings
6334.description: Forged from bladed feathers of flame and fury, these wings will let you tear through the skies with the might of the chimera! Sponsored by Danieldd!

6338.name: Mighty Tiger
6338.description: The terror of dark jungles and rustling fields has been tamed! This awesome beast comes to you from distant lands, willing to lend its primal might - and incredible stride - to your efforts! Rise up to the challenge of your rivals with your new feline friend!

6340.name: Startopian Empire - Uniform Pants
6340.description: Are you ready to travel the stars? To explore strange new worlds and fight for the glory of Startopia? Then you'll need to look the part! These pants are vacuum-pressed and ready for space - get the rest of your uniform together and enlist today!

6342.name: Startopian Empire - Uniform Mini-Skirt
6342.description: Are you ready to travel the stars? To explore strange new worlds and fight for the glory of Startopia? Then you'll need to look the part! This mini-skirt is expertly tailored and ready for space - get the rest of your uniform together and enlist today!

6344.name: Startopian Empire - Command Class Uniform
6344.description: Show everyone you're a ranked officer of Startopia! Those who bear the Command Class uniform have excellent leadership and political abilities. Wearing this also provides a slight boost to your ship rating for all Reputation-based skill checks!

6346.name: Startopian Empire - Engineer Class Uniform
6346.description: Show everyone you're a ranked officer of Startopia! Those who bear the Engineer Class uniform have excellent maintenance and systems abilities. Wearing this also provides a slight boost to your ship rating for all Ship Health-based skill checks!

6348.name: Startopian Empire - Medic Class Uniform
6348.description: Show everyone you're a ranked officer of Startopia! Those who bear the Medic Class uniform have excellent personnel and healing abilities. Wearing this also provides a slight boost to your ship rating for all Crew-based skill checks!

6350.name: Startopian Empire - Phase Blaster
6350.description: Cut down vile Xenoid raiders, defend yourself against Greezak hunters, and make pirates shake in their stolen boots with a blast of hot plasma from a Startopian blaster! For the Empire! Made on Proxima Centauri II. All space rights reserved.

6352.name: Startopian Empire - Combat Troop Mk.II Helmet
6352.description: This helm will keep your noggin safe from all kinds of extraterrestrial threats, like the brain-sucking mosquitorrasques of Vreebin VII! Show everyone you're a loyal soldier of Startopia with the official Mk.II Combat Troop outfit!

6354.name: Startopian Empire - Combat Troop Mk.II Body Armor
6354.description: This body armor will keep your torso safe from all kinds of extraterrestrial threats, like the heart-stealing shadowfiends of Xarhoom IX! Show everyone you're a loyal soldier of Startopia with the official Mk.II Combat Troop outfit!

6356.name: Startopian Empire - Combat Troop Mk.II Leg Armor
6356.description: These plated pants will keep your legs safe from all kinds of extraterrestrial threats, like the bone-melting lava worms of Multak VIII! Show everyone you're a loyal soldier of Startopia with the official Mk.II Combat Troop outfit!

6358.name: Startopian Empire - Combat Rifle
6358.description: This combat rifle will mow down alien hordes and toast a mean marshmallow, but only when fired in the name of the Emperor! All hail Startopia! Made on Gliese III. Firing upon giraffes will void warranty.

6360.name: Greezak Horde - Warrior Helmet
6360.description: The fearsome warriors of the Greezak Horde welcome you to the hunt! This helmet is styled in the traditional manner of the Greezak, with plenty of breathing room and a pocket for snacks.

6362.name: Greezak Horde - Warrior Armor
6362.description: The fearsome warriors of the Greezak Horde welcome you to the hunt! This armor has been retailored to fit your Growtopian body, as the Greezak have a few extra limbs. All the better to catch their prey, you see.

6364.name: Greezak Horde - Warrior Leg Armor
6364.description: The fearsome warriors of the Greezak Horde welcome you to the hunt! These leg plates are aerodynamic and whisper-quiet, perfect for a hunting party (or a late-night snack run).

6366.name: Greezak Horde - Skull Necklace
6366.description: The fearsome warriors of the Greezak Horde welcome you to the hunt! This necklace of trophies was taken from a veteran Greezak, and chronicles the results of his many successful (and delicious) hunts.

6368.name: Greezak Horde - Shoulder Cannon
6368.description: Lock onto your prey and fire! This incredibly deadly shoulder cannon is designed to leave a Greezak warrior's hands free so he can fight and fire at the same time! The plasma bolts it shoots are low-energy, so they don't ruin animal pelts.

6370.name: LordStar Environment Mask
6370.description: The mask of a daring outlaw king! Raid ancient alien treasures and splash your name across the cosmos from behind this fantastic mask! All will (probably) remember you!

6372.name: Space Thruster Boost Boots
6372.description: Zip through space and hover like a champ with these high-tech boost boots! Thanks to a HyperTech dynamo core, these can keep you off the ground forever, meaning you'll never have dirty shoes again! Now THAT'S progress!

6374.name: Alien Mind Protector
6374.description: Alien in your brain! Alien in your brain! Thankfully, this is one of the few times that's actually a good thing, because you're fortunate enough to have a Mind Protector along for the ride! This clever controller will keep your gray matter safe from those who might try to mess with your thoughts!

6376.name: MagTron LightCycle
6376.description: Flaring with HyperTech superluminal banding and an everlasting reactor, this bike is unstoppably cool AND eco-friendly. It'll never run out of juice, and as long as you're riding it, you'll never be out of style.

6378.name: Ferungi Ears
6378.description: A race of a galactic merchants and business dealers, the Ferungi love to chat. That's why their ears are so huge - they never want to miss a conversation (or a potential trade secret)!

6380.name: Volcanix Ears
6380.description: Very pointy! And the pointier the ears, the wiser the Volcanix, as they say. The founding race of the Stellarix Union, the Volcanix are a deeply pragmatic and calculating people with long lifespans. These factors have led them to become distant, even detached from galactic affairs, which is why it's up to the Startopian Empire to keep the peace!

6382.name: Startopian Empire - Force Shield & Phase Blaster
6382.description: The most advanced personal combat gear ever designed for Startopian Special Forces, this blaster/shield combination uses re-engineered HyperTech repulsors to deflect attacks and keep their wielder safe even as they unleash blazing lances of plasma on their foes! When activated, grants immunity to thrown consumables for 5 seconds (starts as soon as you get hit), followed by a 30-minute cooldown.

6384.name: Robot Legs
6384.description: Tired of using your boring human legs like a sucker? Well, fear not, because the advanced surgical teams of the Stellarix Union have crafted these incredible robot legs to take you to and fro without having to waste a single calorie! Powered by Stellithium X9 battery nodes and guaranteed to work for 2 billion steps or your buckazoids back, these legs will keep on walking long after you drop!

6670.name: World Cup Cleats
6670.description: Tap the ball into the goal and bask in the adoration of your fans with these eye-catching cleats!

6674.name: Ref's Jersey
6674.description: Foul! Make the call with this jersey - you have to be right, because you're striped!

6676.name: World Cup Winner's Jersey 2018
6676.description: To make this jersey, we had to steal a sports almanac from the distant future and used it to find the winners of this year's World Cup! Allez Les Bleus!

6678.name: Super Utility Helmet - Red
6678.description: Start seeing red with this superheroic helm!

6680.name: Super Utility Shirt - Red
6680.description: Stop crime and look great! It's a super shirt for a super Growtopian!

6682.name: Super Utility Tights - Red
6682.description: Toss on these tights for a beautiful - yet breathable - superhero style!

6684.name: Super Utility Belt
6684.description: Keep all your superheroing gadgets close at hand and well-organized with this helpful utility belt! Oh, and keep your pants up, too. That's important for fighting crime.

6686.name: Super Utility Boots - Red
6686.description: Give evil the boot with our newest line of fighting footwear! Now in rebellious red!

6688.name: Super Utility Helmet - Yellow
6688.description: Hide your identity with this yellow helmet - but not your might!

6690.name: Super Utility Shirt - Yellow
6690.description: It may be yellow, but you certainly aren't - show the world you care about looking great while fighting crime!

6692.name: Super Utility Tights - Yellow
6692.description: Your legs will look wonderful - and yellow - with these sparkling new tights!

6694.name: Super Utility Wings
6694.description: All-purpose utility wings to carry you onto the heads of your villainous foes from on high!

6696.name: Super Utility Boots - Yellow
6696.description: Give evil the boot with our newest line of fighting footwear! Now in youthful yellow!

6750.name: Summer Blaster Mohawk
6750.description: Rock the season with the new Summer Blaster style! This mohawk doesn't just say you're cool - it also says you're hot! Try to find another kind of hairstyle that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

6752.name: Ultra Summer Blaster Mohawk
6752.description: Rock the season in ULTRA Summer Blaster Style! This mohawk don't just say you're ULTRA COOL - it also says you're ULTRA HOT! Try to find another kind of hairstyle that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, i'll wait...

6754.name: Squirrel King
6754.description: All shall kneel before the nuttiest ruler of all: YOU! Wield the twitchy might of the squirrel empire with this wondrous tail. Acorns are your ammunition, the trees are your home, and the world is your kingdom. Go forth and chitter with pride!

6756.name: Scepter of the Honor Guard
6756.description: Guards! Guards! Assemble the troops with a wave of this lordly scepter! Your foes will run in terror before you and your gang of guardians!

6758.name: Cloak of Hoveration
6758.description: Say hello to the friendliest threads around! This cape will take you to and fro with style, and happily yank you high into the air whenever you desire! It's like a very loyal blanket, but with a touch of magic to make your day extra lofty!

6770.name: Rara Skirt
6770.description: You'll be a "rara" beauty when you don this skirt! Who can resist those colors?

6774.name: Little Red Hoodie
6774.description: My, what fine fashion you have! This hoodie will keep you warm and, more importantly, looking great in all kinds of weather!

6776.name: Big Bad Blue Hoodie
6776.description: Time to huff, puff, and blue your hood down! This hoodie will keep you warm and, more importantly, looking great in all kinds of weather!

6778.name: Punk Purple Hoodie
6778.description: Break out of the routine and set your own style (as long as it's purple)! This hoodie will keep you warm and, more importantly, looking great in all kinds of weather!

6780.name: Dabstep Low Top Sneakers
6780.description: Light up every footfall and move to a better beat with these dabulous shoes! When you're wearing these, the world is your dance floor!

6782.name: Horns of Infinity
6782.description: Ripped from the endless gulf between the stars, these twisted horns still carry a touch of hyperspace! They'll accelerate you into the great beyond, but just remember - when you stare into the void... the void stares back!

6784.name: Rhinestone Evening Dress
6784.description: All eyes will be on you when you stride into the ballroom in this vintage dress! It sparkles and shines like a constellation, setting you among the stars!

6786.name: Plaid Skirt
6786.description: Perfectly plaid for the budding lady lumberjack in you!

6788.name: Peplum Top
6788.description: A cute color for an even cuter Growtopian!

6790.name: Stripy Jumpsuit
6790.description: They say stripes are slimming, but nobody ever mentioned how good they look on you!

6792.name: French Maid's Dress
6792.description: Ooh la la! Grab your feather duster and put on your best French accent, because this dress is made to impress! Oui, mademoiselle!

6794.name: Twintail Hair
6794.description: When one tail o' hair just won't do, try doubling up with these twins! Your locks never looked so good!

6796.name: Braided Hair
6796.description: As bright, fresh, and braided as a fine pastry, this hair doesn't just look stylish - it also looks DELICIOUS.

6798.name: Growmoji Face Mask
6798.description: When you're tired of using all those crazy facial muscles, this mask is here to help! Hide your tired human face with this reliable, totally-not-creepy one instead!

6800.name: Pet Rock
6800.description: Brought to you by popular demand, meet the most playful, incredibly popular, and astonishingly amazing friend for all Growtopians... A ROCK! All sales final.

6804.name: Bubble Gun
6804.description: Pop! Pop! Bring a boatload of bubbles to any occasion with this poppin' fresh firearm!

6806.name: Oink-Oink Nose
6806.description: Got a nose for food? Or is it truffles? Either way, for those who need to show the world their piggy powers, this nose knows best!

6814.name: Bubblicious Hair
6814.description: Dying for that fresh-out-of-the-bubble-bath look? Well, die no more! Top your melon with these bodacious bubbles and LIVE! Whoever snagged this hairdo had to be quick so the bubbles wouldn't pop and super-chilly so they'd stay in place, all to bring it to you!

6816.name: Fire Punk Hair
6816.description: Are you fed up with the status quo? Want to burn the system and start anew? Then start with your hair! This sizzling style will show you're not just a thorn in the system - you're making anarchy look GOOD. Whoever snagged this hairdo had to be quick so the flames wouldn't go out and super-hot so they'd stay bright, all to bring it to you!

6818.name: Nightwings
6818.description: Wrap yourself in harrowing darkness and take to the skies! These wings are spun from midnight shadows, harvested from those with a touch of the starry void in their souls - dare you wear them?

6820.name: Crystal Shard Necklace
6820.description: Shimmering crystals and gems to adorn only the fanciest of necks! Strangely magnetic, these crystals must amplify the personal pull of those who wear them! Careful, though - these shards are sharp!

6826.name: Anomalizing Reliable Trowel
6826.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks, and guaranteed to never break!

6828.name: Anomalizing Pristine Trowel
6828.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

6830.name: Exquisite Trowel
6830.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks!

6832.name: Anomalizing Reliable Cultivator
6832.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected splices, and guaranteed to never break!

6834.name: Anomalizing Pristine Cultivator
6834.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected splices! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

6836.name: Exquisite Cultivator
6836.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected splices!

6840.name: Dreamcatcher Staff
6840.description: Empowered by bountiful spirits from the Other Side, this delicate dreamcatcher will grant its wielder clear skies... and 2% chance of getting extra blocks from harvesting trees!

6842.name: Raven Wings
6842.description: CAW! Feathers dropped by a dark valkyrie have been collected and reforged to make these gorgeous wings. Richly dark with velvet tips, they'll cut through the skies and tickle your hands!

6844.name: Amber Necklace
6844.description: The ancient magic of this necklace calls back to the creatures of a long-lost age, bringing them closer to your world! Gives you a 5% chance of getting double fossils when smashing Fossil Rocks!

6846.name: Ring of Nature
6846.description: The call of the wild... in the palm of your hand! Wear this ring and enjoy a special bond with all things that grow! Reduces the grow time of seeds by 2% when planting or splicing!

6848.name: Luminous Eyes
6848.description: My, what crazy eyes you have! Besides looking amazing, these pristine peepers give you a bonus 2.5% chance of finding crystals using a Geiger Counter!

6866.name: Raw Gauntlet of Elements
6866.description: This incredibly strong gauntlet was designed for a single purpose: To hold the six Elemental Stones. While each stone is very powerful individually, combining their might in this gauntlet will grant the wearer the ability to manipulate the very building blocks of reality! Be warned, however, for adding a stone to this gauntlet requires the sacrifice of a soul in similar form. Doing so will bind the Elemental Stone to the guantlet and focus its power!

6868.name: Gauntlet of Elements - Tier I
6868.description: This incredibly strong gauntlet was designed for a single purpose: To hold the six Elemental Stones. It currently holds the Earth Stone and can move any block with Earth Chi. This is only the beginning, though - there are more stones to be found! Be warned, however, for adding a stone to this gauntlet requires the sacrifice of a soul in similar form. Doing so will bind the Elemental Stone to the guantlet and focus its power!

6870.name: Gauntlet of Elements - Tier II
6870.description: This incredibly strong gauntlet was designed for a single purpose: To hold the six Elemental Stones. It currently holds the Earth and Wind Stones and can move any block with Earth or Wind Chi. This is only the beginning, though - there are more stones to be found! Be warned, however, for adding a stone to this gauntlet requires the sacrifice of a soul in similar form. Doing so will bind the Elemental Stone to the guantlet and focus its power!

6872.name: Gauntlet of Elements - Tier III
6872.description: This incredibly strong gauntlet was designed for a single purpose: To hold the six Elemental Stones. It currently holds the Earth, Wind, and Fire Stones and can move any block with Earth, Wind, or Fire Chi. Now we're getting somewhere! More stones await, however, and don't forget: Adding a stone to this gauntlet requires the sacrifice of a soul in similar form. Doing so will bind the Elemental Stone to the guantlet and focus its power!

6874.name: Gauntlet of Elements - Tier IV
6874.description: This incredibly strong gauntlet was designed for a single purpose: To hold the six Elemental Stones. It currently holds the Earth, Wind, Fire, and Death Stones and can move any block with Earth, Wind, or Fire Chi. It also now seals its bearer's fate, snatching them away from the mortal plane upon their demise! Now we're getting somewhere! More stones await, however, and don't forget: Adding a stone to this gauntlet requires the sacrifice of a soul in similar form. Doing so will bind the Elemental Stone to the guantlet and focus its power!

6876.name: Gauntlet of Elements - Tier V
6876.description: This incredibly strong gauntlet was designed for a single purpose: To hold the six Elemental Stones. It currently holds the Earth, Wind, Fire, Water, and Death Stones and can now move nearly any block! It also now seals its bearer's fate, snatching them away from the mortal plane upon their demise! It's nearly complete now! Only a single stone awaits, and don't forget: Adding a stone to this gauntlet requires the sacrifice of a soul in similar form. Doing so will bind the Elemental Stone to the guantlet and focus its power!

6878.name: Exquisite Gauntlet of Elements
6878.description: Behold: The completed Gauntlet of Elements! Empowered by the might of the Earth, Wind, Fire, Water, Life, and Death Stones, it allows its wielder to move nearly any block, seals their fate upon their demise, and with the Life Stone, brings them back through a resurrection rift! A truly awe-inspiring relic, this must have taken tremendous effort to create. Any who possess it are mighty, indeed. All hail!

6892.name: Sorcerer's Tunic of Mystery
6892.description: Capable of reflecting the true colors of the world around it, this rare tunic is made of captured starlight and aether. If you think knitting with thread is hard, just try doing it with moonbeams and magic! The result is worth it though, as these clothes won't just make you look amazing - you'll be able to channel their inherent power into blasts of cosmic energy!

6896.name: Yellow Hardhat
6896.description: Show off your builder bona fides and keep your noggin safe with this bright and beautiful hat!

6898.name: Munchin' Straw
6898.description: Show off your farmer flair and enjoy a long-lasting snack with this tasty wheat!

6900.name: EMT Jumpsuit
6900.description: Show off your surgery skills and dress for the next big emergency with this hypoallergenic coverall!

6902.name: Fishing Wader Boots
6902.description: Show off your fishing finesse and keep your toes nice and dry with these water-proof waders!

6904.name: Star Captain's Hat
6904.description: Show off your starship strengths and command the respect of your crew with this dashing cap!

6926.name: Anomalizing Elegant Hammer
6926.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break (with less of a chance than a Pristine version)! Use with care!

6928.name: Anomalizing Elegant Scythe
6928.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected trees! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break (with less of a chance than a Pristine version)! Use with care!

6930.name: Anomalizing Elegant Bone Saw
6930.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected patients! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break (with less of a chance than a Pristine version)! Use with care!

6932.name: Elegant Anomarod
6932.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected fish! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break (with less of a chance than a Pristine version)! Use with care!

6934.name: Anomalizing Elegant Trowel
6934.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break (with less of a chance than a Pristine version)! Use with care!

6936.name: Anomalizing Elegant Cultivator
6936.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected seeds! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break (with less of a chance than a Pristine version)! Use with care!

6938.name: Anomalizing Reliable Scanner
6938.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies discovered on Star Missions, and guaranteed to never break!

6940.name: Anomalizing Pristine Scanner
6940.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies discovered on Star Missions! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

6942.name: Exquisite Scanner
6942.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies discovered on Star Missions!

6944.name: Anomalizing Elegant Scanner
6944.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies discovered on Star Missions! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break (though with less of a chance than a Pristine version)! Use with care!

6966.name: Riding Bull
6966.description: YEEHAW! Saddle up this bucking bull and charge its horns for maximum fury! This beastly bovine is none too happy to have a rider, so make sure you take its fury out on your foes, instead!

6982.name: Wheelchair Speedster
6982.description: Tear up the streets with triple-wheeled power! This chair isn't just incredibly comfortable and supportive - it also features GrowTech-powered wheels to propel you wherever you need to go! Take a seat and get ready to roll!

6996.name: Fishing Dinghy
6996.description: A lovely personal watercraft, just for you! Perfect for a quiet day on the water, listening to waves lap gently against its hull as you wait for a nibble on your fishing line!

7020.name: Cupcake Apron
7020.description: Show off your cooking cleverness and keep your clothes stain-free with this cute and comfortable apron!

7022.name: Mengu Koi Samurai Facial Armor
7022.description: A traditional facemask obtained from an even more traditional fish! You can't help looking great (and traditional) while you're wearing this!

7024.name: Geta
7024.description: Geta pair of these traditional wooden slippers and you'll soon be standing head and shoulders above your style-impaired companions!

7026.name: Pink Kimono
7026.description: Sleeve your arms (and the rest of yourself) in shimmering silk. Dyed a passionate pink and hand-stitched by crafty artisans, it's the perfect look for your next tea ceremony or historical reenactment!

7028.name: Blue Kimono
7028.description: Sleeve your arms (and the rest of yourself) in shimmering silk. Dyed a beautiful blue and hand-stitched by crafty artisans, it's the perfect look for your next tea ceremony or historical reenactment!

7030.name: Orange Kimono
7030.description: Sleeve your arms (and the rest of yourself) in shimmering silk. Dyed an adorable orange and hand-stitched by crafty artisans, it's the perfect look for your next tea ceremony or historical reenactment!

7032.name: Ornamental Hair Fan & Chopsticks
7032.description: Style yourself with the perfect hair, and then keep it in place with these lovely lacquered chopsticks at no additional charge! Two-for-one deals are very traditional, you know.

7034.name: Oil-paper Umbrella
7034.description: Cut the scary part out of falls and look good while you're doing it with this delicate - yet supportive - paper umbrella. May not be the best in a storm, but it'll definitely keep gravity at bay!

7036.name: Geisha Makeup
7036.description: Applied with exacting precision and exquisite materials, this makeup is a statement to the world that its bearer is poised, beautiful, and probably displeased with shenanigans. ANY shenanigans.

7038.name: Panda Mask
7038.description: Aww, it's adorable! Don this mask (with associated suit) and you'll instantly look like the second-cutest type of panda (after red pandas) and second-most monochromatic bear (after polar bears) in the world! Just goes to show that you can be second-place in looks... and first in our hearts.

7040.name: Panda Suit
7040.description: Aww, it's adorable! Don this suit (with associated mask) and you'll instantly look like the second-cutest type of panda (after red pandas) and second-most monochromatic bear (after polar bears) in the world! Just goes to show that you can be second-place in looks... and first in our hearts.

7042.name: Master Sensei's White Eyebrows
7042.description: You! Your eyebrows are weak! SMALL! UNWISE! They are unworthy, and should be replaced by THESE eyebrows, which are the true mark of ancient arts and knowledge. Put these perfectly-sized, immaculately-groomed eyebrows on and become the font of skill and understanding you know in your heart you should be.

7044.name: Jade Crescent Axe
7044.description: Honed over centuries by very bored monks and layered with precious stones and runed filigrees, this axe is a masterwork of ancient magic and EVEN MORE ANCIENT weaponsmithing. Wield it and you'll tear through foes, blocks, and butter like... um... even softer butter!

7060.name: Koi Fish Leash
7060.description: The classiest of all fish (by at least 86%) has decided to join you on land! Now its classiness will follow you wherever you go! Thanks, classy koi.

7080.name: Ezio's Hood
7080.description: Conceal your features from the watchful eyes of the Templars with this iconic hood.

7082.name: Ezio's Vest
7082.description: Comes with hidden pockets for blades, potions, explosives, and snacks.

7084.name: Ezio's Cape
7084.description: Weighted just right to catch the winds, this cape will help you stick a death-defying landing and look cool the whole time.

7086.name: Ezio's Trousers
7086.description: Just loaded with knives. Like, there are more weapons in an Assassin's pants than fabric.

7088.name: Ezio's Armguards
7088.description: Complete with deadly Hidden Blades, these armguards will help you unleash swift justice on all who side with the Templars.

7090.name: Ezio's Beard
7090.description: Exactly the right amount of grizzled and wise.

7092.name: Ezio's Hair
7092.description: Full of all the roguish charm you need to make the ladies of the Renaissance swoon - even the Templar ones.

7094.name: Ezio's Boots
7094.description: Ready to climb the Leaning Tower of Pisa, leap from the parapets of the Vatican, and knock cruel Templars from their seats of power.

7098.name: Apocalypse Scythe
7098.description: Stolen from one of the four riders of the Apocalypse, this deadly blade is able to slice open the veil between life and death.

7100.name: Famine's Steed
7100.description: The undead steed of one of the four riders of the Apocalypse, FAMINE. This dark steed withers all that it passes.

7102.name: Conquest's Helm
7102.description: BEHOLD! The conqueror approaches. All who view this helm shall flee in terror before its bearer, and those who remain will find naught but ruin.

7104.name: Dark Aurora Wings
7104.description: The majesty of the skies has been corrupted by the dark powers of Growganoth! Once a symbol of beauty and grace, there is nothing left in these wings but wickedness and terror...

7106.name: Cat Eyes
7106.description: Wow, pawesome! These new eyes are the cat's meow, and the purrfect addition to any style.

7110.name: Evil Grin
7110.description: Makes you look way, WAY too happy...

7114.name: Nightmare Vampiress Dress
7114.description: The chosen garb for a dark baroness of the crypts, this coldly beautiful dress is made of the finest lace and all set for a night of revelry and ruin!

7118.name: Riding Skeletal Shark
7118.description: Deaaaaaadly SHARK doo doo, doo doo doo doo! Deadly shark doo doo, doo doo doo doo!

7120.name: Angler Mask
7120.description: Makes even the most beautiful Growtopians into terrifying creatures of the depths! Great if you want to skip out on a blind date or scare small children!

7122.name: Demon Plague Doctor Mask
7122.description: As if normal Plague Doctor formal wear wasn't terrifying enough, someone's imbued this mask with haunting spirits of darkness and evil! Was that even necessary?!

7124.name: Vampire Hunter Hat
7124.description: Stake your claim on the night and show the legions of the undead who's boss with this extra-sharp hat. Remember, only the pointiest of headgear for the most skilled vampire hunters.

7126.name: Tragicomic Mask
7126.description: Celebrating happiness, sadness, and all the little moments in between! This mask will show the world you believe the true drama and splendor of life is not in stability, but in its highs and lows!

7128.name: Creepy Baby Head Mask
7128.description: Tired of people treating you like a little kid? Toss this bad boy on and send THEM crying home to momma!

7132.name: Demon Angler Leash
7132.description: This is a demonic fish, not a fish that angles for demons. If you're ever unsure about which it is, just check for the gruesome teeth and eyes! Luckily, this particular specimen seems happy to join you on your adventures. Don't get your fingers near those chompers, though - even if it's loyal, it's still a demon!

7134.name: Skeletal Shark Leash
7134.description: This is what happens when you don't feed your fish, then bury it in unhallowed ground! Even worse, it looks like some foul magic has brought it back to float by your side once more!

7136.name: Ethereal Rainbow Dragon
7136.description: Fae energies from beyond the veil of life and space have flitted into our worlds! Sparkling with the prismatic glory of a light beyond mortal reckoning, this creature of mist and mystery will empower you with its knowledge of the realms beyond! Also, it'll look pretty.

7138.name: Heroic Tights of Prevention
7138.description: Amazing prismatic pants for a true hero of Growtopia! These glorious tights will keep you safe from villains AND prevent you from picking up floating items in the world! Nothing sticks to you, for you have the power of heroes!

7142.name: Tamed Looming Triffid
7142.description: Those terrifying tentacles have merged to create... a pet! It looks like this twitching monster is just grateful to be moving around on its own, and doesn't even want to eat your brains! Let's just hope it doesn't get any bigger!

7144.name: Magic Carpet
7144.description: More than just a rug! Step on and enter a whole new world! ...well, if you consider hovering slightly above the ground a "new world," that is.

7146.name: Mountain Dire Wolf
7146.description: AWOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO! Arctic lands shake with the terrifying howl of the monstrous dire wolf! If you find a way to ride this beast, its unnatural speed and deadly claws will be yours to command!

7148.name: Super Logo - Fist
7148.description: Emblazon this logo on your super costume to fight crime as... Knuckle Sandwich? Meat Hook? Mr. Fisticuffs? It's up to you!

7150.name: Stone Gargoyle Wings
7150.description: You wouldn't think stone wings could soar, but thanks to a thousand-year-old spell, these have the power to take you to the skies!

7152.name: Plasma Hair
7152.description: Set your hair afire with the energies of space and time! Inspired by HyperTech and made possible thanks to the mad science of Growtopia's test kitchens, this hair isn't just an electrifying fashion statement - it's also edible! WARNING: DO NOT EAT.

7192.name: Shadow Spirit of the Underworld
7192.description: A demon of the Shadow Plane, this dangerous creature obeys only you, its master, and lives to shred all others! Nobody knows how it came to be in your service, and it's probably best not to ask. For those who long for a darker world, this is definitely your spirit animal!

7196.name: Monarch Butterfly Wings
7196.description: These wings have the honor of being named after royalty! With a luscious color scheme, a wingspan of up to 10cm, these majestic wings offer action packed jumping capabilities.

7198.name: Winter Freezer Hood
7198.description: Celebrate the season with the new Winter Freezer style! This hood doesn't just keep you warm - it also makes you cool! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

7200.name: Ultra Winter Freezer Hood
7200.description: Celebrate the season in ULTRA Winter Freezer style! This hood don't just keep you ULTRA WARM - it also makes you ULTRA COOL! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

7204.name: Supplier's Cape
7204.description: The best Suppliers bring a wide assortment of goods for trade, and what better way to show them off than with this multicolored, ever-shifting cape? Don this garment and enjoy bonus points for any Supplier - that's Farmer, Surgeon, Fisher, and Star Captain, at the moment - Role quest you undertake!

7206.name: The Great Chameleon: Master of Disguise
7206.description: The hidden wonder of Growtopia has joined your side! Glekki, the Great Chameleon, has emerged from his hidden sanctuary and chosen YOU as his new apprentice. Keep him close at hand, and he'll teach you the ways of the chameleon, allowing you to blend in with ANY SURFACE as long as you stay verrrrry still. What an honor!

7208.name: Winter Freezer Robe
7208.description: Celebrate the season with the new Winter Freezer style! This robe doesn't just keep you warm - it also makes you cool! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

7210.name: Ultra Winter Freezer Robe
7210.description: Celebrate the season in ULTRA Winter Freezer style! This robe don't just keep you ULTRA WARM - it also makes you ULTRA COOL! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

7214.name: Crafter's Cape
7214.description: Loaded with all kinds of useful tools to make any construction project a breeze, this many-pocketed cape is a Crafter's best friend! Don this garment and enjoy bonus points for any Crafter - that's Builder and Cook, at the moment - Role quest you undertake!

7216.name: Mad Hatter
7216.description: Hats! Hats for all! AHAHAHAAA! Don the tallest, wobbliest, most majestic tower of hats Growtopia has ever seen and become one with madness! Hats for me! Hats for you! Hats for EVERYONE! WOOHOO!

7246.name: Lyre
7246.description: Perfect for a Renaissance Faire or your average medieval-themed garage band. Note that you can't punch when holding this lovely instrument, as we'll be too busy entertaining royalty! Punch anywhere to play music; if you punch to your left or right, you can bend the note higher or lower. Punch in your own column to play the same notes that Sheet Music: Lyre Note plays.

7250.name: Jack's Shoes
7250.description: The boots of a very skilled road warrior! Collect Jack's full outfit and you'll be able to draw on his incredibly varied experiences to improve your performance in all kinds of Roles!

7252.name: Jack's Jeans
7252.description: The jeans of a very skilled road warrior! Collect Jack's full outfit and you'll be able to draw on his incredibly varied experiences to improve your performance in all kinds of Roles!

7254.name: Jack's Vest
7254.description: The vest of a very skilled road warrior! Collect Jack's full outfit and you'll be able to draw on his incredibly varied experiences to improve your performance in all kinds of Roles!

7256.name: Jack's Hat
7256.description: The hat of a very skilled road warrior! Collect Jack's full outfit and you'll be able to draw on his incredibly varied experiences to improve your performance in all kinds of Roles!

7258.name: Future Perfect Chip
7258.description: A model 101 super-processor, the FPC will attach directly to your neural cortex and, from there, extend a web of nanofibers throughout your skin, transforming you into a cybernetic powerhouse!

7260.name: Swirling Rainbow Eyes
7260.description: Whoosh! See the world in a new light with these kaleidoscopic eyes! Their fantastic, ever-spiraling beauty will set a smile on the faces of all who greet you!

7262.name: Knight's Chainmail - Sun
7262.description: Turn aside the blades of your enemies and show your fealty to the illuminating power of the sun with this hand-tooled chainmail!

7264.name: Knight's Chainmail - Lion
7264.description: Turn aside the blades of your enemies and show your fealty to the inspiring courage of the lion with this hand-tooled chainmail!

7266.name: Knight's Chainmail - Crown
7266.description: Turn aside the blades of your enemies and show your fealty to the deep-rooted honor of the crown with this hand-tooled chainmail!

7276.name: Knight's Great Helm - Golden
7276.description: Show everyone you abide by the Code of Chivalry while keeping the sun - and any pesky arrows - out of your eyes at the same time! Now in glorious golden plate!

7278.name: Knight's Helm - Crusader
7278.description: Show everyone you abide by the Code of Chivalry while keeping the sun - and any pesky arrows - out of your eyes at the same time! Now in courageous crusader colors!

7280.name: Knight's Helm - Antlers
7280.description: Show everyone you abide by the Code of Chivalry while keeping the sun - and any pesky arrows - out of your eyes at the same time! Now with amazing antlered accents!

7296.name: Scavenger Wheels
7296.description: A rumbling engine beneath you, choking soot behind, and post-apocalyptic adventures ahead. The world may have ended, but the roads... they go on forever!

7298.name: Scavenger Lord's Wheels
7298.description: Shiny and chrome! Rule the wastelands from atop this diesel-powered monster! The scavengers and warriors of the apocalypse will bow when they see you tearing past on this mad machine!

7300.name: 2-Face
7300.description: Seems like there's two sides to everything - and with this face, that includes you! What will you show to the world?

7302.name: Golden Midas Masterpants
7302.description: Wrap yourself in glittering, gleaming GLORY! Don this, and every inch of skin, every nerve and fiber, everything will transform into that most malleable and marvelous of metals... GOLD!

7304.name: Tiger Spirit
7304.description: You are one with your spirit animal! The awesome guidance of the Tiger Spirit has given you the gift of double jump! Ever see a tiger leap and take down unsuspecting prey? Well, now you can too! Just don't get distracted by laser pointers - tigers might be big, but they're still kitties at heart!

7306.name: Anomalizing Reliable Rolling Pin
7306.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected food items, and guaranteed to never break!

7308.name: Anomalizing Pristine Rolling Pin
7308.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected food items! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

7310.name: Exquisite Rolling Pin
7310.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected food items!

7312.name: Anomalizing Elegant Rolling Pin
7312.description: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected food items! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break (though with less of a chance than a Pristine version)! Use with care!

7348.name: Riding Turkey
7348.description: Gobble gobble! He's off the dinner table and on the road! This adventurous turkey wants to see the world, and he's happy to take you along for the ride! Saddle up and get gobbling!

7350.name: Turkey Wings
7350.description: Don't let anyone tell you turkeys are lame! They are FANTASTIC flyers, and with their wings behind you, the skies are yours! Now go forth and gobble!

7352.name: Pilgrim's Hat
7352.description: There are all kinds of things to be thankful for during the holidays, but maybe one of the most important is just how dang awesome those pilgrims looked! Top your ensemble with this traditional hat and join the fun!

7354.name: Pilgrim's Coat
7354.description: There are all kinds of things to be thankful for during the holidays, but maybe one of the most important is just how dang awesome those pilgrims looked! Cover your ensemble with this traditional coat and join the fun!

7356.name: Pilgrim's Shoes
7356.description: There are all kinds of things to be thankful for during the holidays, but maybe one of the most important is just how dang awesome those pilgrims looked! Complete your ensemble with these traditional shoes and join the fun!

7358.name: Pilgrim's Bonnet
7358.description: There are all kinds of things to be thankful for during the holidays, but maybe one of the most important is just how dang awesome those pilgrims looked! Top your ensemble with this traditional bonnet and join the fun!

7360.name: Pilgrim's Dress
7360.description: There are all kinds of things to be thankful for during the holidays, but maybe one of the most important is just how dang awesome those pilgrims looked! Elevate your ensemble with this traditional dress and join the fun!

7384.name: Go-Go-Growformer!
7384.description: Zip through the streets on squealing wheels of steel, then transform and smash through walls and villains with the power of the Growformers! This incredible automaton has a mind of his own, but he's happy to be your wheels and shield as you tear through the many worlds of Growtopia! Push the pedal to the metal and you'll be saying 'GG!' in 0.5 seconds!

7386.name: Ultra Winter Freezer Teddy Suit
7386.description: Celebrate the season with the new ULTRA Winter Freezer style! This suit doesn't just turn you into an ULTRA warm and adorable teddy bear - it also turns you into an ULTRA cool one! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

7388.name: Winter Freezer Teddy Mask
7388.description: Celebrate the season with the new Winter Freezer style! This mask doesn't just turn you into a warm and adorable teddy bear - it also turns you into a cool one! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

7390.name: Crown of Duplication
7390.description: What's better than one pet? Why, TWO, of course! With the strange powers of this ancient relic, any pet that chooses to follow you will be joined by its own time-tossed duplicate from another reality! What strange adventures does this doppel-pet have while it's away? Probably best not to ask - what if it's from a better world than yours? You might get jealous!

7392.name: Mage's Orb
7392.description: Long before they built totally responsible and not-at-all dangerous techno-marvels, GrowTech used to be known as MagiGrow, and they turned out all kinds of crazy inventions like this ancient Mage's Orb! We're not sure how or where this relic was found, but it's still supercharged with mystic might! Ouch! Wield this and you'll find zapping things easier than ever! MagiGrow: Puttin' the "harm" in thaumaturgy since 740AD!

7396.name: Snowflake Eyes
7396.description: Forget those fools with stars in their eyes! This holiday season, it's snowflakes or nothin'! Show off your winter wizardry with these icy-cool eyes! You'll never lose a staring contest again!

7398.name: Rugged Winter Beard
7398.description: Beautiful and burly, just like you! This beard has been through snow, mud, rain, cougars, and falling trees, and only gotten mightier for it! Can you live up to its brawny power?

7400.name: Ice Queen Winter Makeup
7400.description: Crisp and cool, just like you! This makeup has been applied by frosty faeries using all-ice ingredients for a look that's fit for only the most wintry of royalty. Can you live up to its snowy majesty?

7402.name: Snowflake Eyes with Rugged Winter Beard
7402.description: Cement yourself as a king of winter with this one-two knockout combo of frosty eyes and burly beardery! Nobody will question your devotion to the season again!

7404.name: Snowflake Eyes with Ice Queen Winter Makeup
7404.description: Cement yourself as a queen of winter with this one-two stunner of icy-cool eyes and pristine snow-dappled makeup! Nobody will question your devotion to the season again!

7406.name: Super Snowball Launcher
7406.description: Using advanced frost-gauss technology, this launcher accelerates snowballs to dangerous velocities! Tired of being unable to pelt your friends in neighboring cities? Aim this baby at the sky and make it a white Christmas for them in seconds!

7408.name: Abominable Snowman Suit
7408.description: Rar! The body of a horrible, terrifying beast of the arctic wastes! All who see you will know your abominableness... but is that truly who you are on the inside? And who are they to judge, anyway?!

7410.name: Abominable Snowman Mask
