7410.description: Rar! The mask of a horrible, terrifying beast of the arctic wastes! All who see you will know your abominableness... but is that truly who you are on the inside? And who are they to judge, anyway?!

7412.name: Snowflake Wings of Winter
7412.description: Through the magic of snow and icy auroras, these wings keep you aloft by making you as light as a snowflake, and twice as special!

7414.name: Chipmunk
7414.description: Chittering, chattering, and tons of fun, this chipmunk is tired of hoarding nuts for winter and wants to spend all his time playing with you!

7416.name: Snow Leopard Tail
7416.description: Swooshing through the artic terrain, the mighty snow leopard stalks his prey - and now you can, too! This tail grants perfect pouncing balance, so look out, mice and rabbits!

7418.name: Snowfrost's Top Hat
7418.description: A cheery holiday hat to cap the costume of a most mischievous sprite! Snowfrost is here - and it's time to play!

7420.name: Snowfrost's Mask
7420.description: Get your warm face on with this frost-shielding mask! You may be a prince of winter, but you'll never be left in the cold with Snowfrost at your side!

7422.name: Snowfrost's Suit
7422.description: Threaded with frost, whorls of ice, and a hint of merriment, this suit feels surprisingly warm... and just a little bit mischievous!!

7424.name: Snowfrost's Candy Cane Blade
7424.description: Slice through those who'd dare to harm your holidays! ...or snack away to satisfy your sweet tooth! It's an all-in-one weaponized treat, hand-spun for you!

7426.name: The Horrible Holiday Hoodie
7426.description: And you thought the sweater was bad! This hoodie is sixteen flavors of terrible holiday glitz and glurge, all spun together by blind spiders with poor fashion sense. Spectacular!

7428.name: Slime Green Hoodie
7428.description: Hide your hair from snow and show your slimy side with this gloriously green hoodie!

7430.name: Snow Husky
7430.description: Arf! Even if you're not running a race across the ice, this husky is the perfect winter pet! He's warm, fuzzy, and happiest when he's helping you spread holiday cheer!

7432.name: Snow Husky Sledge
7432.description: Dashing through the snow, barking as we go, this sledge is pulled by dogs, and anything but slow!

7434.name: Poseidon's Digger's Trident
7434.description: Don't let the king of the deep know you've got this! He's been trying to cultivate the perfect coral garden, and he's going to be SO MAD when he finds out we stole his trident for you! This watery trident is very specifically designed for one purpose: to prick deep sand and ocean rock. It is pretty useless at digging anywhere else, but dang if it doesn't rip deep sand and ocean rock apart.

7468.name: Mr. Narwhal Leash
7468.description: The majestic narwhal, unicorn of the deep and expert poker of all things aquatic, has made the leap from the deep and landed at your side! Take him for a spin, but watch out for that horn!

7470.name: Narwhal Tusk Staff
7470.description: Perfect for summoning the powers of the seas as well as poking slow people in front of you at the store! Narwhals HATE waiting in line almost as much as they love the water, so they'd appreciate it you took the time to do both!

7488.name: SLaminator's Boomerang
7488.description: Show the sound barrier who's boss with this slammin' slapper of a boomerang! Thanks to its supporter, it travels extra-far and crazy-fast! If you ever see it coming back, though, watch out! It's not easy to catch something this unpredictable and keep all your fingers! Sponsored by JIRISTAR, ChiggaLam and SLaminator.

7490.name: Nutcracker Hat
7490.description: Extra tall for hiding a winter's worth of nuts! Just don't let any squirrels know - it's near-impossible to clear out a squirrel infestation without ruining the fabric.

7492.name: Nutcracker Mask
7492.description: Complete your seasonal fantasy look with the stoic face of elite nutcracker royalty! Warning: Do not try to crack nuts with your teeth just because you're wearing this - it WILL hurt!

7494.name: Nutcracker Coat
7494.description: Warm and cozy! This coat is perfect for keeping away the chill of any mystical winter-time journeys, as well as the claws of the evil Mouse King!

7496.name: Nutcracker Pants
7496.description: Well-sized for your average Growtopian (and nutcracker Lieutenant), these are made from GrowTech's patented nut-wicking material to ensure you won't have any stray almonds or walnuts sticking to your sides!

7498.name: Nutcracker Boots
7498.description: Polished so well you can see yourself in them, and carefully swept free of nut shells and dust!

7500.name: Nutcracker Saber
7500.description: Slash and parry at villainous mice (and particularly tough nuts) with this crackin' good blade!

7502.name: OVEROLL's Wings
7502.description: Hit the heights with these wicked-cool wings! Thanks to their sponsor, you won't just be doing barrel rolls - you'll be doing OVEROLLS! Sponsored by OVEROLL

7504.name: Super Squirt Rifle 500
7504.description: The terror of summer battlefields is now in your hands! Portable soaking technology has come a long way, so not only can you use this to douse your friends (and foes), but it'll go further than ever and even put out fires!

7506.name: Men's Board Shorts - Ocean Wave
7506.description: Hang ten in this bodacious beachwear! These are blue and cool, through and through. You'll be secure in your good looks on land and at sea with these waterproof and style-assured shorts!

7508.name: Men's Board Shorts - Checkered
7508.description: Hang ten in this bodacious beachwear! These are lined and fine, through and through. You'll be secure in your good looks on land and at sea with these waterproof and style-assured shorts!

7510.name: Women's Swimsuit - Deep Ocean Blue
7510.description: Look great in sun and surf alike! With a helpful UV lining, these smart-fabric swimsuits will not only make you look amazing, but they'll also protect you from harmful sunburns! Looking good never felt so safe!

7512.name: Women's Swimsuit - Coral Pink
7512.description: Look great in sun and surf alike! With a helpful UV lining, these smart-fabric swimsuits will not only make you look amazing, but they'll also protect you from harmful sunburns! Looking good never felt so safe!

7514.name: Wet Hair
7514.description: The sea was kind to you! Tide-tossed and kissed by the sun, this hair is perfectly wet and wild! Just don't go looking for a towel to dry off! It's amazing exactly the way it is - just like you.

7516.name: Unicorn Floatie
7516.description: Tired of having to choose between hanging out with a majestic creature of mystery and myth or an awesome pool accessory? Well, worry no more - now you can have both!

7518.name: Jet Ski
7518.description: Swimming is for suckers! In fact, traveling anywhere without a jet engine is for suckers, but nowhere is that more true than on open water! Crank this baby into overdrive and make friends with salt spray and the horizon, because you're king of the sea now! Vroom!

7530.name: Golden Jet Ski
7530.description: Strapping a jet engine to your feet and flying across the water is already a great idea, but you know what it's missing? SOLID GOLD JET POWER, BABY! What could go wrong?

7532.name: Balloon-Frosting War Glove
7532.description: Brr! This dangerous glove adds a thickened shell of frost to every balloon its wearer throws, tripling its points on a successful hit! Just be careful - its GrowTech freezing circuits are prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

7558.name: Plunger
7558.description: From the weird and wacky world of some crazy critters! Fixes toilets and makes a stylish fashion statement!

7560.name: The Brother Hood
7560.description: Conceal your features from the watchful eyes of the Templars with this iconic hood.

7562.name: Unicorn
7562.description: Once ridden by the legendary ninja kitty, this unicorn has stopped stabbing people and only wants to snuzzle you! Man, you're so much luckier than its previous 426 owners...

7564.name: Glowing Shirt
7564.description: This shirt was fished out of a pool of radioactive chemicals, giving it unnatural brightness (but no spider powers, unfortunately). Wearing it will turn every room around you into the hottest club in town!

7566.name: Foppy 4.0
7566.description: Forged in honor of the finest kitty in at least twenty worlds, this mask combines their stylish color scheme with even MORE stylish robotic technology! You might be cool, but are you robo-kitty cool? Wear this mask and find out! -- This is the subscriber item for February 2019, and was chosen by DanyRed.

7568.name: Hovernator Drone - White
7568.description: Gliding silently through the skies on carbon fiber blades, this drone is packed with dangerous GrowTech attack systems and an advanced logic engine preloaded with Amethyst-Generation AI! Luckily, it has to obey the holder of its remote - and that's you! Just don't, like, lose that thing. We've had to put down about eighty drone uprisings already...

7570.name: Hovernator Drone - Black
7570.description: Gliding silently through the skies on carbon fiber blades, this drone is packed with dangerous GrowTech attack systems and an advanced logic engine preloaded with Amethyst-Generation AI! Luckily, it has to obey the holder of its remote - and that's you! Just don't, like, lose that thing. We've had to put down about eighty drone uprisings already...

7572.name: Hovernator Drone - Red
7572.description: Gliding silently through the skies on carbon fiber blades, this drone is packed with dangerous GrowTech attack systems and an advanced logic engine preloaded with Amethyst-Generation AI! Luckily, it has to obey the holder of its remote - and that's you! Just don't, like, lose that thing. We've had to put down about eighty drone uprisings already...

7574.name: Hovernator Drone - Golden
7574.description: Gliding silently through the skies on carbon fiber blades, this drone is packed with dangerous GrowTech attack systems and an advanced logic engine preloaded with Amethyst-Generation AI! Luckily, it has to obey the holder of its remote - and that's you! Just don't, like, lose that thing. We've had to put down about eighty drone uprisings already...

7576.name: Winter Freezer Cuddly Fox Scarf
7576.description: Celebrate the season with a foxy new addition to the Winter Freezer style! This super-cuddly scarf doesn't just keep you warm - it also makes you cool! Try to find another adorable animal that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...!

7578.name: Ultra Winter Freezer Cuddly Fox Scarf
7578.description: Celebrate the season with an ULTRA-FOXY new addition to the Winter Freezer style! This super-cuddly scarf doesn't just keep you ULTRA WARM - it also makes you ULTRA COOL! Try to find another adorable animal that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...!

7582.name: Robotic MK.IV Wings
7582.description: After a great deal of experimentation and only, like, ten major accidents, GrowTech's engineers have worked out all the kinks and produced these fantastically fancy, almost certainly safe wings! Just... don't ask about Wings MK.I-III. They had... problems.

7584.name: Sprite's Robe
7584.description: Don this beautiful robe to summon the power of a playful sprite! Every jump will transform you into a Sprite for a time and take you bounding above the world!

7586.name: Sonic Buster Sword
7586.description: Smash the limits with this intensely powerful weapon! Oversized might for oversized heroics, this weapon swirls with spirit energy - a devastating weapon in the right hands, and a gorgeous conversation piece in just about any!

7592.name: Treasure Map
7592.description: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! They get a little easier to see when you're moving faster, though...

7594.name: Treasure Map
7594.description: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! They're hard to make out in the light of day, though...

7596.name: Treasure Map
7596.description: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! The paper seems incredibly dry, though...

7598.name: Treasure Map
7598.description: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! The paper seems quite damp, though...

7600.name: Treasure Map
7600.description: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! The language isn't like anything you've heard of on Earth, though...

7602.name: Treasure Map
7602.description: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! The runes have a dangerous sheen of gold, though...

7604.name: Map of Tyr
7604.description: This map's letters are hard to see in the light of day, and even those you CAN make out seem to change from moment to moment...

7606.name: Map of Odin
7606.description: This map's letters are hard to see in the light of day, and even those you CAN make out seem to change from moment to moment...

7608.name: Map of Thor
7608.description: This map's letters are hard to see in the light of day, and even those you CAN make out seem to change from moment to moment...

7610.name: Map of Frigg
7610.description: This map's letters are hard to see in the light of day, and even those you CAN make out seem to change from moment to moment...

7612.name: Legendary Map - Untouched
7612.description: Ooh! This is one heck of a map! Looks like there's a lot of scrambled text and hidden messages here - you'd need a powerful algorithm to make sense of it all...

7614.name: Legendary Map - Scanned
7614.description: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! They seem to change from moment to moment, and never in a form you can decipher!

7616.name: Legendary Map - Magnified
7616.description: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! They seem to change from moment to moment, and never in a form you can decipher!

7618.name: Legendary Map - Deciphered
7618.description: The runes of the frozen cliffs match certain ones all over your map! When you put them together, a final message becomes clear, but the letters seem strangely faded to you, as if your eyes just aren't quite evolved - or mutated - enough to make them out...

7634.name: Round Shield
7634.description: Circles are the superior defense setup! This baby deflects 7.8% more blows than all other shield shapes! Invest now!

7636.name: Frigg's Belt
7636.description: Spun from the finest gold and made with craftsmanship of such surpassing grace, the Aesir themselves will applaud its bearer. Good thing that's you, eh?

7640.name: Battle Boar
7640.description: Supercharged with porcine fury, its terrible oinks will be the last thing your foes ever hear!

7642.name: Golden Battle Boar
7642.description: Gleaming in the light of war, this gorgeous boar is the most beautiful - and deadly - of its kind!

7646.name: Tyr's Spear
7646.description: Justice and duty resonate in the heart of this godly weapon, propelling it far beyond its wielder's reach and into the very heart of evil!

7648.name: Huginn and Muninn - Odin's Ravens
7648.description: Thought and Memory, perfectly perched on each shoulder to whisper the world's secrets into your ears! Just make sure to feed them, or they might take a chunk out of you in return!

7650.name: Mjolnir
7650.description: The hammer of the gods! Wreathed in myth and forged with a core of living lightning, this legendary artifact was once lost in the gulf between the stars! Will you succeed on its former owner's cosmic quest? Are you... worthy?

7652.name: Eir's Healing Rune
7652.description: Infused with the medical might of Eir, a healing goddess, this rune will grant swift recovery and aid to any who hold it! Also grants minty fresh breath, which is an especially nice benefit when you consider the standard Viking diet.

7654.name: Thor's Chariot
7654.description: Looks like Thor misplaced his wheels! Fortunately, his feisty goats, Tanngrisnir and Tanngnjostr, have taken a liking to you and decided to forgo the standard BITE BITE BITE greeting they tend to use on new owners. Let's ride!

7660.name: Super Party Launcher
7660.description: Those other ravers laughed at you. They thought you didn't have the moves to dance with them. They thought your game was weak and your accessories were weaker. Well, joke's on them, because now you're ready to party the night away with the ultimate in confetti domination! Who's laughing NOW, foolish ravers?! Kinda hard to make fun of someone when you've got paper confetti and maybe a Mach 5 firework in your face, isn't it??

7668.name: Air Horn
7668.description: Little-known fact: All Growtopia air horns are actually the sound of a very angry camel screaming.

7670.name: Floating Speakers
7670.description: These aren't for pool parties - they're for you! Hit the air on waves of sound with these thumpin' good boomboxes!

7674.name: Goat Leash
7674.description: The leash to one of two very famous goats! Let's see... this particularly bitey boy is either named "Teeth-Barer" or "Teeth Grinder". I'm not sure how to find out which without getting bitten, however, so your guess is as good as mine!

7676.name: Dragon Warrior's Shield - Crimson
7676.description: An unyielding defense against claws, fangs, spiky tails, and the blazing breath of even the mightiest drakes! Comes in a variety of colors, all related to ancient customs and knightly orders! Looks like this one is red, for the Crimson Court!

7678.name: Dragon Warrior's Shield - Purple
7678.description: An unyielding defense against claws, fangs, spiky tails, and the blazing breath of even the mightiest drakes! Comes in a variety of colors, all related to ancient customs and knightly orders! Looks like this one is purple, for the Noble Bastion!

7680.name: Dragon Warrior's Shield - Silver
7680.description: An unyielding defense against claws, fangs, spiky tails, and the blazing breath of even the mightiest drakes! Comes in a variety of colors, all related to ancient customs and knightly orders! Looks like this one is silver, for the Silver Spire!

7682.name: Dragon Warrior's Shield - Diamond
7682.description: An unyielding defense against claws, fangs, spiky tails, and the blazing breath of even the mightiest drakes! Comes in a variety of colors, all related to ancient customs and knightly orders! Looks like this one is diamond, for the rarest of all: The Radiant Souls!

7696.name: Draconic Rocket Parasol
7696.description: To the heavens! In honor of the original creators of fireworks, this parasol has been loaded up with a dragon's worth! Use them to blast your way into the heavens, and then float gently down to Earth when you're done! There are only 1200 in existence!

7716.name: Toasted Villager Shirt
7716.description: Toasty! This top took a quick blast of flame from a dragon, and it shows!

7718.name: Toasted Villager Hat
7718.description: Toasty! Whoever wore this was pretty unlucky when a dragon came to town, though better this hat than its bearer's head, I suppose...

7720.name: Toasted Villager Pants
7720.description: Toasty! It's unclear whether these pants were present during a dragon's attack, or their owner simply told a TON of lies...

7722.name: Toasted Villager Shoes
7722.description: Toasty! Talk about a hotfoot! For a very brief run, these must've felt like the worst case of athelete's foot in history!

7724.name: Toasted Face Smudges
7724.description: Toasty! Just gotten blitzed by a firedrake with nothing to show for it? Not true! These toasty smudges are proof that you've faced the flame... and survived!

7726.name: Dragon Knight's Helm
7726.description: Forged in a master blacksmith's furnace and stamped with runes of protection, a Dragon Knight's suit of armor is their last and best line of defense against the horrid flames and claws of their scaly foes! This helm is but one link of many in that chain of defense, a perfect way to keep your noggin safe! Also doubles as a really cool motorcycle helmet.

7728.name: Dragon Knight's Chestplate
7728.description: Forged in a master blacksmith's furnace and stamped with runes of protection, a Dragon Knight's suit of armor is their last and best line of defense against the horrid flames and claws of their scaly foes! This chestplate is but one link of many in that chain of defense, a perfect way to keep your body safe! And hey, it's got great resale value - even if a dragon burns you out of it, this armor will still be left behind for the next intrepid knight!

7730.name: Dragon Knight's Greaves
7730.description: Forged in a master blacksmith's furnace and stamped with runes of protection, a Dragon Knight's suit of armor is their last and best line of defense against the horrid flames and claws of their scaly foes! These greaves are but one link of many in that chain of defense, a perfect way to keep your legs safe! Trust me, when you're dealing with dragons, preserving your ability to run away is critical.

7732.name: Dragon Knight's Sabatons
7732.description: Forged in a master blacksmith's furnace and stamped with runes of protection, a Dragon Knight's suit of armor is their last and best line of defense against the horrid flames and claws of their scaly foes! These shoes are but one link of many in that chain of defense, a perfect way to keep your feet safe! Keep these in mind the next time you want to try walking on coals at a luau, too - I mean, who would do that in bare feet??

7734.name: Legendary Dragon Knight's Wings
7734.description: Bestowed upon only the bravest, most prestigious, most skilled Dragon Knights, these wings are so rare that in all the centuries since the first Dragon Knights arose, barely a handful have been awarded. Will you be the next to bear their illustrious might? To take to the skies and soar like the very dragons you hunt? If you possess these wings, there's little question you've proven your worth - and dedication.

7736.name: Dragon Knight's Spear
7736.description: Capable of subduing the mightiest drake! Of course, you need to actually GET the pointy tip of the spear TO the drake, but that's where all the Dragon Knight armor comes in handy!

7746.name: Dragon Turtle Charm
7746.description: A snapping beast of the crushing deep! It's said that the oldest dragon turtles can grow so large, whole islands can grow on their backs! Fortunately, this one's still small and feisty, and seems happy to follow you on your adventures!

7748.name: Super-Dragon Mask
7748.description: Look! Up in the sky! It's a bird! It's a plane! It's... SUPER DRA- AIIEEE! RUN! THERE'S FIRE EVERYWHERE!

7750.name: Ghost Dragon Charm
7750.description: A dragon pulled from the Other Side! Top Dragonologists have been debating whether this creature is actually the ghost of a single dragon or a conjoined ectoplasmic hive composed of many smaller ghosts working together, but all of them can agree that it keeps eating anyone who asks about it, so it's best not to worry.

7752.name: Gourmet Dragon Claw
7752.description: A dragon who appreciates the finer things in life - as long as you can eat them.

7754.name: Emergency Dragon Claw
7754.description: Not all dragons are here to stomp and burn! Sure, this dragon still causes emergencies, but it also helps to patch people up afterward!

7756.name: Jormungandr
7756.description: A spiraling serpent of the fathomless deep, this colossal beast once circled all of Midgard with coils the size of warships! Now it's taking a break from causing maelstroms to join you in your adventures!

7758.name: Prehistoric Dragon Claw
7758.description: A dragon from a bygone time, what it lacks in modern refinements it more than makes up for in ancient biting power and unintelligible grunts!

7760.name: Star Dragon Claw
7760.description: A living constellation, this beautiful dragon was born in the heart of a brilliant nebula. It's come down to your world to explore, and it's very happy to have you as its guide!

7762.name: Chaos Dragon
7762.description: Don't look at it. Don't think about it. Don't. Even. Move. This... THING isn't a dragon. I don't know what it is - only that it's deadly dangerous and forged from the void itself. Beware, dear Growtopian, because I think it's noticed you...

7818.name: Heartking's Crown
7818.description: Love rules, and who better to embody that than the grandest nobility in all the Heartlands: the King and Queen of Heart! This crown is part of the King's personal wardrobe, and his warmth and affection for his subjects practically spill from it!

7820.name: Heartking's Robes
7820.description: Love rules, and who better to embody that than the grandest nobility in all the Heartlands: the King and Queen of Hearts! These robes are part of the King's personal wardrobe, and his warmth and affection for his subjects practically spill from them!

7822.name: Heartqueen's Crown
7822.description: Love rules, and who better to embody that than the grandest nobility in all the Heartlands: the King and Queen of Hearts! This crown is part of the Queen's personal wardrobe, and her delight and care for her subjects practically explode from it!

7824.name: Heartqueen's Robes
7824.description: Love rules, and who better to embody that than the grandest nobility in all the Heartlands: the King and Queen of Hearts! These robes are part of the Queen's personal wardrobe, and her delight and care for her subjects practically explode from them!

7826.name: Heartstaff
7826.description: Taken from the personal armory of the King and Queen of Heart, this staff is capable of batting away all but the saddest thoughts and mending even the most melancholy of hearts!

7828.name: Golden Heartstaff
7828.description: Infused with the golden light of romance, this heartstaff has been enhanced beyond its already-impressive start as a weapon of the heart to become a shining example of the power of love! Careful, though - for love can sometimes hit far harder than any edge!

7830.name: Heartsword
7830.description: Taken from the personal armory of the King and Queen of Heart, this sword is capable of slicing through all but the saddest thoughts and bringing joy to even the most melancholy of hearts!

7832.name: Golden Heartsword
7832.description: Infused with the golden light of romance, this heartsword has been enhanced beyond its already-impressive start as a weapon of the heart to become a shining example of the power of love! Careful, though - for love can sometimes cut far deeper than any blade!

7834.name: Stained Glass Heartwings
7834.description: Shining, radiant, wondrous. These wings aren't powered by magic or science or anything so mundane - they're infused with purest love, capable of uplifting all who wear them into the skies! Touch the heavens and smile, for by wearing these beauties, you have proclaimed yourself a true champions of the heart!

7836.name: Morty the Gray Elephant
7836.description: Have you ever forgotten how amazing you look? How cool your style is? Well an elephant NEVER forgets, so take a tour in Morty's fashionable gray ears and remember your awesomeness for all time! Wait - what's that? Your friends don't think it's all that great? Well, maybe a HAIL OF PEANUTS will make them reconsider! GET 'EM, MORTY!

7838.name: Morty the Orange Elephant
7838.description: Have you ever forgotten how amazing you look? How cool your style is? Well an elephant NEVER forgets, so take a tour in Morty's fashionable orange ears and remember your awesomeness for all time! Wait - what's that? Your friends don't think it's all that great? Well, maybe a HAIL OF PEANUTS will make them reconsider! GET 'EM, MORTY!

7840.name: Morty the Pink Elephant
7840.description: Have you ever forgotten how amazing you look? How cool your style is? Well an elephant NEVER forgets, so take a tour in Morty's fashionable pink ears and remember your awesomeness for all time! Wait - what's that? Your friends don't think it's all that great? Well, maybe a HAIL OF PEANUTS will make them reconsider! GET 'EM, MORTY!

7842.name: Morty the Diamond Elephant
7842.description: Have you ever forgotten how amazing you look? How cool your style is? Well an elephant NEVER forgets, so take a tour in Morty's incredibly rare and glorious diamond ears and remember your awesomeness for all time! Wait - what's that? Your friends don't think it's all that great? Well, maybe a HAIL OF PEANUTS will make them reconsider! GET 'EM, MORTY!

7890.name: Garden Shears
7890.description: Keep those unruly hedges in check with a dainty snip-snip from these shears!

7892.name: Country Tweed Waistcoat & Tie
7892.description: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes. With this fine waistcoat/tie combo, you'll be the last word in rural nobility!

7894.name: Country Tweed Open Jacket
7894.description: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes. This jacket will make you seem anything but closed - after all, a friend in tweed is a friend indeed!

7896.name: Country Tweed Trousers
7896.description: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes! These trousers are perfect for a stroll through your gardens or perhaps a vigorous game of croquet!

7898.name: Country Tweed Flat Cap
7898.description: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes! This cap will keep the sun out of your eyes as you walk your manor's grounds and make you look extra-jaunty as you tip it to your neighbors!

7900.name: Country Tweed Jacket & Yellow Tie
7900.description: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes! The touch of yellow in this jacket/tie combo would go marvelously with a spring festival - perhaps in your new manor's gardens?

7902.name: Country Riding Breeches
7902.description: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes! These bonzer breeches will keep you on horseback long after lesser riders have gone home! Try on a pair today - there's nothing wrong with being comfortable AND fashionable, after all.

7904.name: Country Riding Hat
7904.description: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes! This fine hat doesn't make you a better rider, but it DOES make you a more dashing one, and honestly, isn't that what riding animals is all about?

7906.name: Guild Show Horse
7906.description: Bred and groomed for competition, this flawless horse will have the judges saying anything but 'neigh'!

7908.name: Guild Noble's Carriage
7908.description: Sure, carriages like this look amazing on the outside, but what their owners won't tell you is that the interior is tricked out with a full surround sound system, flatscreen TVs, the latest gaming consoles, and a well-organized selection of candy!

7910.name: Eagle Spirit
7910.description: You are one with your spirit animal! The awesome guidance of the Eagle Spirit has given you the gift of double jump! Now go forth and clasp some crags with crooked hands!

7912.name: War Hammers of Darkness
7912.description: Seething with dark powers and intended for even darker designs, these weapons are for only the most tortured, brooding souls. You'd better have a tragic backstory all lined up before you even THINK of touching one!

7914.name: Condor Wings
7914.description: Condors are some of the largest flying birds in the world, which makes these wings fit for only the biggest and baddest Growtopians! Will you take on the condor's mantle and soar, or are you more of a... chicken?

7916.name: Airplane Wings
7916.description: Zoom! You don't need a silly engine, propeller, or any of that other mechanical garbage - not when you have THESE wings! Take to the skies just like the airplanes of old! Note: You may need to drink one or two liters of oil per day to keep them properly flappy.

7918.name: Sturdy Crackfire Fighter
7918.description: Pkow! Pkow! Stake your claim on the skies and do battle with old-fashioned flair in this crackfire fighter! Just make sure you're home in time for tea and toast!

7920.name: Cardboard Sky Starter
7920.description: You don't need a roaring engine or a blazing gun to claim the skies - just a bit of cardboard and a strong imagination! This Sky Starter will get you going, but it's up to you to make it soar!

7922.name: Aviator Scarf
7922.description: There's no point in flying around heroically if you don't have a flappy scarf to keep yourself warm! Nobody trusts a shivering hero, after all.

7924.name: Aviator Jacket
7924.description: Keeps you warm as you dance with the clouds and comes with all kinds of cool patches to show off your many marvelous accomplishments!

7926.name: Aviator Glasses
7926.description: Carefully sculpted to shine with a heroic glint as you pilot your battered-but-victorious plane home from battle!

7928.name: Aviator Fighter Pilot Hat
7928.description: No self-respecting hero of the skies would go out without a dashing hat! Keep your perfectly-slicked hair and brilliant brain warm in even the chilliest clouds with this!

7930.name: Air Force Flight Suit
7930.description: Time to show everyone you've got the right stuff! Commandeer the fastest jets and set the most dangerous records in this super-sleek flight suit!

7934.name: Spring Flinger Frog Mask
7934.description: Celebrate the season with the new Spring Flinger Style! This mask doesn't just give you the face of a swift and hoppy frog - it also gives you a new style that stays fresh on water AND land! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

7936.name: Ultra Spring Flinger Frog Mask
7936.description: Celebrate the season with the new ULTRA Spring Flinger Style! This mask doesn't just give you the face of an ULTRA swift and hoppy frog - it also gives you a new style that stays ULTRA fresh on water AND land! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

7938.name: Paintball Power Popper
7938.description: Got tons of paint on your hands but feeling tired of walking ALL THE WAY over to a wall, or friend, or inanimate object to cover them in it? Well, whine no more! This high-powered paintball popper will plaster your pals in premium paint without pause (phew)!

7940.name: Flaming Boxing Gloves
7940.description: These gloves aren't aflame with basic fire - they're alight with the burning heart of BATTLE! Furious ringside magic has been embedded in these gloves, wrapping them in an eternal halo of blazing punch-power! And no, they are very definitely NOT regulation...

7944.name: Spring Flinger Frog Suit
7944.description: Celebrate the season with the new Spring Flinger Style! This suit doesn't just turn you into a swift and hoppy frog - it also turns you into an amphibiously cool one! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

7946.name: Ultra Spring Flinger Frog Suit
7946.description: Celebrate the season with the new ULTRA Spring Flinger Style! This suit doesn't just turn you into an ULTRA swift and hoppy frog - it also gives you a new style that stays ULTRA fresh on water AND land! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

7948.name: Forged Iron Skin
7948.description: A gift of the gods, shaped by magic and fused by cosmic heat, this skin makes for the perfect armor. You'll never tire, never fall, never take one step back! ...though you may have to deal with a spot of rust now and then.

7950.name: Ionic Pulse Cannon Tank
7950.description: The titanium treads, super-heavy armor, and GrowTech hyperfusion reactor alone would make this the most expensive tank in history, and that's before you add an Ionic Pulse Devastator 7777 turret on top! Truly a tank for the most powerful nations - or richest collectors - in all the realms!

7956.name: Burnished Sword
7956.description: Shining with the help of GrowTech's extra-strength Sword Wax ("Wax on, slice off!"), this burnished blade is ready to chop your foes! Chosen by GusBhas, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for July, 2019!

7976.name: Kairos' Apollo
7976.description: In loving memory of Apollo. Kairos' loyal, loving companion. A special creature that will always be by her side and in her heart.

7994.name: Kelpie
7994.description: A shape-shifting water spirit, this creature normally hangs out in the lochs of Scotland, but it's decided to make an exception to adventure with you! Only found in Blarney 2 and 3.

7996.name: Bagpipes
7996.description: Ahh, the most calming and gentle of musical instruments. Just listen... *FREEOOOOOOOWWWWWWW HEORRRRRRNNNNNN EEEEEEEEEEEEE HOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!*

7998.name: Fairy
7998.description: A mighty magical sprite! You might think it's odd that it took over six years for an actual fairy to show up in Growtopia, but just remember, Fairy Wings were the VERY FIRST wing to be added to the game, and it took the Fairy Union a long time to get over it! Only found in Blarney 1 and 4.

8000.name: Lucky Broach
8000.description: Absolutely guaranteed to be maybe sorta kinda luckier than the average broach! ...possibly. A little. ... ... ...okay, not really.

8002.name: Money Gun
8002.description: Ka-ching! This doesn't just make it rain - it's an instant MONEY FLOOD! WOOHOO!

8006.name: Hellfire Horns - Black
8006.description: Searing bright with the infernal black blaze of the Underworld, these horns are stronger than tempered growmantium, sharper than a honed growlecular sabre, and more stylish than even the greatest GrowTech tailors could imagine!

8008.name: Hellfire Horns - Blue
8008.description: Searing bright with the infernal blue blaze of the Underworld, these horns are stronger than tempered growmantium, sharper than a honed growlecular sabre, and more stylish than even the greatest GrowTech tailors could imagine!

8010.name: Hellfire Horns - Orange
8010.description: Searing bright with the infernal orange blaze of the Underworld, these horns are stronger than tempered growmantium, sharper than a honed growlecular sabre, and more stylish than even the greatest GrowTech tailors could imagine!

8012.name: Hellfire Horns - Ruby
8012.description: Searing bright with the infernal ruby blaze of the Underworld, these horns are stronger than tempered growmantium, sharper than a honed growlecular sabre, and more stylish than even the greatest GrowTech tailors could imagine!

8014.name: Spring Flinger Shoes
8014.description: Celebrate the season with the new Spring Flinger Style! These shoes won't just put a smile on your face and a spring in your step - they'll also give you a new style that works wonders in both boring boardrooms AND beautiful beaches! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

8016.name: Ultra Spring Flinger Shoes
8016.description: Celebrate the season with the new ULTRA Spring Flinger Style! These shoes won't just put an ULTRA-happy smile on your face and an ULTRA-swift spring in your step - they'll also give you a new style that works wonders in both boring boardrooms AND beautiful beaches! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

8018.name: S.P.I.D.E.R. Legs
8018.description: At last! The Speedy Palpating Incredibly Deadly Electronic Roamers are the perfect replacement for those pesky human legs everyone seems to have. Seriously, have you noticed how many people have those weak, totally non-metallic and uninteresting NORMAL legs? Why would you want something so... overdone? Use the S.P.I.D.E.R., and get going in wonderfully horrible style!

8022.name: Junk Cannon
8022.description: No block stays awesome forever, even if you're firing it out of a recoilless GrowTech-certified gauss chamber with 1.21 growgajoules of force... which is why the Junk Cannon is leagues ahead of all other block-blasting battlegear! What CAN'T it fire? Where does it get all those blocks from? How can it never run out of ammunition? Sorry, the answers to those questions can only be provided if you have GrowTech Security Clearance Level Indigo or higher, but hey - you can still shoot the gun as much as you want! Woohoo!

8024.name: Purple Aura
8024.description: You are burning with magical, octarine energies!

8026.name: Green Aura
8026.description: You are burning with earthly, verdant energies!

8036.name: Balloon Bunny
8036.description: Bunny bunny bunny balloon balloon balloon bunny balloon bunny balloon bunny bunny balloon balloon.

8038.name: Pet Egg
8038.description: This creature is so friendly, it hasn't even hatched and it already wants to be your friend!

8040.name: Big Goofy Teeth
8040.description: Do you ever feel like you can never show enough teeth? Well, toss these on and give yourself a grin that'll rival even the rarest rabbits!

8042.name: Claws of Barko
8042.description: Honed in lightless caves where only the most devious rabbits dare to hop, these claws are used for far deadlier things than digging cute bunny burrows!

8044.name: Bowler Bunny Hat
8044.description: Perfect for when you need to attend a very stylish event that happens to be hosted by rabbits.

8046.name: Drabbit's Foot
8046.description: Once upon a time, a dragon and a rabbit loved each other very much. Even the wisest sages aren't sure how this happened, and nobody likes to think about how it worked, but the wondrous drabbit was the result, and now with this talisman, a touch of its provider-enhancing wisdom can be yours!

8052.name: Psychotic Bunny Mask
8052.description: Styled after Hannibun Lopter, the notorious psycho-rabbit!

8054.name: Riding Bunny
8054.description: Takes you to and fro with little hops and a lot of love! There's no cuter way to travel - just look at that cute bunny face and twitchy nose!

8056.name: Easter Egg Cannon
8056.description: Powered by a Fuel Pack on your back, this gun can launch free easter egg blocks at your fellow Growtopians! Don't waste shots at anything else, though, because they still burn fuel!

8184.name: Mah-Kah-Ron Hat
8184.description: The subscriber item for March 2019, chosen by EloraFaline! So good-looking, you'd swear it's a deliciously crispy treat instead of a lovely hat - but don't eat it, because then you wouldn't have a hat, and you'd also have eaten a bunch of fabric, which would probably be bad.

8190.name: Holy Jeans
8190.description: Jam-packed with so much holy might, they're, uh... wait, are these just jeans with lots of holes in them? But... how'd they get so dang POWERFUL, then?

8192.name: Buddy's Block Head
8192.description: The nicest block around - it's not just your friend... it's your buddy! Equip it and watch your hoard grow... Gives you a chance of dropping an additional block when breaking blocks!

8194.name: Glowy Cape
8194.description: Bringing light to even the darkest places and dimmest worlds, this cape will surround its bearer with an astonishingly pure light!

8286.name: Da Vinci Wings
8286.description: Da Vinci actually thought he could fly with these. He was totally wrong - they only let you double jump and glide.

8288.name: Genie's Lamp - Green
8288.description: Who needs wishes when you can GRANT them? This lamp will transform you into a glorious green genie of magic and mirth. Phenomenal cosmic power awaits!

8290.name: Genie's Lamp - Yellow
8290.description: Who needs wishes when you can GRANT them? This lamp will transform you into a youthful yellow genie of magic and mirth. Phenomenal cosmic power awaits!

8292.name: Genie's Lamp - Red
8292.description: Who needs wishes when you can GRANT them? This lamp will transform you into a resplendent red genie of magic and mirth. Phenomenal cosmic power awaits!

8294.name: Genie's Lamp - Blue
8294.description: Who needs wishes when you can GRANT them? This lamp will transform you into a brilliant blue genie of magic and mirth. Phenomenal cosmic power awaits!

8296.name: Spring Flinger Squirrel Mask
8296.description: Celebrate the season with the new Spring Flinger Style! This mask doesn't just give you the face of a cheeky squirrel - it also helps you stay twitchy on land AND tree alike! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...!

8298.name: Ultra Spring Flinger Squirrel Suit
8298.description: Celebrate the season with the new ULTRA Spring Flinger Style! This suit doesn't just turn you into an ULTRA cheeky squirrel - it also gives you a new style that stays ULTRA twitchy on land AND tree alike! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both, and in such an ULTRA way! Go on, I'll wait...!

8302.name: Steampunk Wings
8302.description: Clattering gears and finely-tuned cogs whir and whiz as you don these brass and copper beauties! Thanks to the meticulous magic of steam and jewel precision of luxury mechanists, these wings are at home in the soot-streaked skies of any steampunk world!

8304.name: Magic Magnet
8304.description: Tired of wading through clouds of items and loading up your inventory with random junk when all you want is a single thing? Just tune this magnet to the proper frequencies and it'll nab exactly what you're missing as you move past!

8306.name: Legendary Comet Hair
8306.description: The Night of the Comet is alive... in your HAIR! Roiling with color, every follicle of this otherworldly hair was chipped out of the cosmos, flowing and bubbling with all the energy of the great beyond!

8308.name: Reg4shi's Archangel Wings
8308.description: He has intervened for the sake of Growtopians time and again, for he sees the potential for heroism, creativity and selflessness in each of us. He has even sacrificed his weekends to fight on our behalf. For that alone, we always have and always will believe in him.

8310.name: Coati Scarf
8310.description: This little South American raccoon is full of mischief and curiosity, but right now, he needs a soft place to snuzzle up! Will you let him hop onto your shoulders and share some adorable warmth?

8312.name: Fiesta Coati Scarf
8312.description: This little guy knows how to party! Full of spicy style and fearsome curiosity, there's nothing more rambunctious than a coati out on the town - and around your neck!

8314.name: Riding Llama
8314.description: Careful! They may look fluffy and weird, but these guys spit. And bite. And talk about you behind your back. Llamas, right?

8328.name: Scarfy-Scarf
8328.description: Whether you're rocketing down city streets on an apocalyptic adventure or simply trying to keep warm while looking good, this scarf won't let you down! Chosen by TraxyGT, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for April, 2019!

8352.name: Hairy Legs
8352.description: Who needs pants when you have all-natural heating for your legs?

8354.name: Eyes on Stalks
8354.description: Alien eyes for your alien face, with alien lasers to destroy the human race!

8356.name: Riding Poop
8356.description: Yes, it's real, and it moves just as quickly as you do after one too many fast food meals!

8358.name: The Beast with a Thousand Eyes Mask
8358.description: Keep your eye on the prize - literally every prize - with this horrific headful of staring alien eyeballs!

8360.name: Puggly
8360.description: This dogbomination eats everything when your back is turned, and then horks it right back up when it has your attention! How cute! Wait, did I say cute? I meant BLEARGHGHGHGH!

8362.name: The Fly
8362.description: A buzzing beast, engorged by science and merged with your poor head! How will you ever date again?

8364.name: Horrid Snotty Face
8364.description: Just dripping with happiness, this is truly a face only a mother could love!

8366.name: Extra Undead Arms
8366.description: Since when was two arms enough for you to get anything done? Let's stack on a few more and get this party started!

8368.name: Riding 'roach
8368.description: Just a friendly cockroach you decided to befriend instead of squish! It'll take you wherever you like, provided there's some delicious rotting food for it to snack on along the way!

8370.name: Undead Slippers
8370.description: Technically, all your shoes are dead. These just happen to be particularly obvious about it.

8372.name: Giant Eye Head
8372.description: Give your friends an eyeful with this baleful, beady-eyed orb! As an added bonus, you can probably win every last staring contest now!

8374.name: Bob The Gross Blob
8374.description: Not to be confused with Bob the Handsome Blob!

8420.name: Blob of Goop
8420.description: A blob of goop for Spaced-Faced!

8422.name: Inflamed Nose
8422.description: Don't get too excited by the name - this nose doesn't shoot fire, unfortunately. It's just the sign of a sick Growtopian!

8424.name: Dirt Grass Hair
8424.description: Wow, your hair looks like the grass on top of dirt!

8432.name: Galactic Destructor - Green
8432.description: Stolen from an Imperial shipment and bearing Galactic Danger Code THX1136, this super-weapon has but one purpose: Total destruction! A galactic menace in giga-green, this monster of a weapon will take all of your strength to lift, and all of your courage to fire.

8434.name: Galactic Destructor - Purple
8434.description: Stolen from an Imperial shipment and bearing Galactic Danger Code THX1136, this super-weapon has but one purpose: Total destruction! A galactic menace in pew-pew-purple, this monster of a weapon will take all of your strength to lift, and all of your courage to fire.

8436.name: Galactic Destructor - Red
8436.description: Stolen from an Imperial shipment and bearing Galactic Danger Code THX1136, this super-weapon has but one purpose: Total destruction! A galactic menace in red-alert-red, this monster of a weapon will take all of your strength to lift, and all of your courage to fire.

8438.name: Galactic Destructor - Blue
8438.description: Stolen from an Imperial shipment and bearing Galactic Danger Code THX1136, this super-weapon has but one purpose: Total destruction! A galactic menace in blaster-blue, this monster of a weapon will take all of your strength to lift, and all of your courage to fire.

8442.name: Doctor's Blingin' Cross
8442.description: Gleaming gold to mark its bearer as the finest - and most stylish - doctor in all the worlds! It's said that those who wear the Cross of Bling will experience dramatically shorter lives, but they'll be full of adventure, right up to the end!

8444.name: Doctor's Blingin' Cap
8444.description: Gleaming gold to mark its bearer as the finest - and most stylish - doctor in all the worlds! The Cap of Bling is a treasured hallmark of doctorhood, as it protects patients from seeing your mussy bedhead and dandruff! They'll never know!

8446.name: Doctor's Blingin' Mask
8446.description: Gleaming gold to mark its bearer as the finest - and most stylish - doctor in all the worlds! Because doctors encounter all manner of diseases, it's imperative that they keep from infecting their patients. The Mask of Bling is said to reduce the chances of contagion by 110%! Nobody is sure how that's mathematically possible, but they won't question it, either!

8448.name: Doctor's Blingin' Top
8448.description: Gleaming gold to mark its bearer as the finest - and most stylish - doctor in all the worlds! The Top of Bling is specially-woven to protect its bearer from the slices and dices of errant scalpels and thrashing patients! You can never be too careful when battling the slow creep of entropy!

8450.name: Doctor's Blingin' Pants
8450.description: Gleaming gold to mark its bearer as the finest - and most stylish - doctor in all the worlds! Fun fact: At least 83% of all infections start from dirty knees! Wearing pants as well-made and sterile as these drops that rate down to NOTHING, which just goes to show that you can be professional and look amazing at the same time.

8452.name: Hands of the Void
8452.description: Deadly claws of chaos and rage, spun from the essence of haunted realms beyond the stars. Sometimes the void touches you, but with these, yours will be the touch of that strange darkness.

8454.name: Feet of the Void
8454.description: Dire darkness wraps your feet, turning every step into a footfall of doom. Flowers wither in your wake, small animals run screeching, and your shoes very definitely will not fit anymore.

8456.name: Gut Buster
8456.description: Looks terrifying, but this mess of guts is actually just the results of a stolen medical Train-E, some creative arts and crafts, and a whole lot of duct tape to stick it to your torso!

8458.name: Stitchlips
8458.description: Tired of all that talking? Take matters into your own hands and slap some stitches on those loquacious lips! You'll be silenced in seconds!

8462.name: Clockwork Fish Leash
8462.description: This well-oiled fish has decided its grumpy days are behind it - it's decided to follow you around in all its clankering, over-geared beauty!

8464.name: Clockwork Eyes
8464.description: Gear yourself up for success and stare down your rivals with these superb spinners! The only downside? They need a lot of oil to keep spinning!

8468.name: Howly Hat
8468.description: Awooo! Tired or turning your head to the skies to howl at the moon on your own? Now this hat will do all your howling for you! Think of all the time you'll save!

8474.name: Cupcake Hat
8474.description: Show everyone your love of baked delights by topping yourself with a giant treat of your very own! Looks good enough to eat!

8476.name: Big Belly
8476.description: Looks like all that fine food has gotten the best of you! You should try to cut down on the caloric blocks and start punching more of them for exercise, but until then, this big 'ol belly is a sign of your sins.

8480.name: Gem Hair
8480.description: Hair spun from twinkling crystals and concentrated gems! Its worth? Incalculable. Its beauty? Inconceivable. Your look? Incredible.

8482.name: Chicken Feet
8482.description: Ba-kaw! You've been afflicted by the infectious chickenfoot virus! Fortunately, the only real symptoms are having sweet chicken feet and an occasional taste for bugs.

8484.name: Terrifying Toothface
8484.description: Yikes! This toothy maw has one too many chompers! Can you imagine the dentist bills? And all the toothpaste? Sheesh, this thing is scary in more ways than one!

8486.name: Loving Halo
8486.description: A sign of a truly gracious and adoring soul. This halo marks you with love and adoration, healing you quickly with the power of the heart! Aww!

8488.name: Chaos Corruption
8488.description: Racing lines of chaos have consumed your blood, filling you with fiendish energy. While the corruption feeds on your spirit, you'll be faster, but at what cost?

8492.name: Wormtouch
8492.description: Wiggly worms are the best diggers, so it makes perfect sense that replacing your arms with GIANT WORMS would give you impressive digging skills. 100% perfect, unquestionable sense...

8494.name: Snakewolf
8494.description: Slithering with serpent speed, howling at the moon, and looking like a million world locks, this mythical snakewolf is your newest friend! Notes for care: Snakewolf likes rare steaks, lots of head scratches, and destroying your enemies.

8496.name: Ghostking's Glory
8496.description: All ghosts flock to the holder of the Ghostking's crown. Stolen from his empty throne on the Other Side, this spectral crown proclaims you the true ruler of all ghostkind! Unfortunately, that means you're about to make a lot of booful buddies! At least... until the Ghostking finds you...

8498.name: The Fattenator
8498.description: Dang, you are HUGE. With thickness like this, nobody's going to have much luck pushing YOU around.

8506.name: Darkening Hood
8506.description: Shrouding its bearer in stylish shadows, this hood is the perfect way to stay awesomely anonymous! Chosen by Placental, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for May, 2019!

8510.name: Grumpy Pet Pineapple
8510.description: This tiny terror hates feeling like the runt of the pineapple litter. He'll follow you around, but don't make jokes about his size! He's very upset about... well... everything!

8512.name: Slippery Pineapple Squishers
8512.description: As everyone knows, pineapples are the fastest of the fruits. Now, thanks to advanced GrowTech Squishscience, we've managed to imbue the speedy juice of the pineapple into these hyper-advanced shoes. What? You say they're just hollowed-out pineapples? Don't be silly - if that were true, how could they make you move so quickly?

8514.name: Pineapple Skin Shirt
8514.description: A tough skin for a tough Growtopian, both hiding a sweet, wonderful interior!

8516.name: Howling Pineapple Crown
8516.description: YEAAAAAAAAAAAAH! This pineapple is down to terrorize the town! Perched on your head, it will scream its fruity head off at anyone who comes near! Why, you ask? What, do pineapples suddenly need REASONS to start yelling at people?

8518.name: Dangerous Pineapple Juice Backpack
8518.description: This backpack is filled with swirling, deadly dangerous juice from only the most malicious of pineapples! With such feisty energy, you could certainly power something huge... like a Harvester!

8536.name: UV Vaccine
8536.description: This wonder of modern medicine is the Universal Vicious Vaccine, and your only hope against the most dangerous of maladies! Hold onto this as you operate, and be careful, because it'll get used whether you're successful or not!

8550.name: Doctor's Blingin' Booties
8550.description: Gleaming gold to mark its bearer as the finest - and most stylish - doctor in all the worlds! Set with nonslip treads of solid gold, these blingtastic booties will help you keep your footing in even the most slippery of surgical scenarios!

8552.name: Angel of Mercy's Wings
8552.description: You bear the wings of a true savior, a surgeon without peer who has saved countless lives in their pursuit of the greater good. All who can hear the beat of these magnificently medicinal wings will know that their salvation has arrived.

8554.name: Caduceaxe
8554.description: Capable of extracting pure medical might from blocks, this caduceaxe is your ticket to vaccination victory! There's a chance it may break on vaccine extraction, but hey - it also has a chance of getting you more than a few fragments!

8574.name: Dangerous Pineapple Fan Shirt
8574.description: Who doesn't pineapple GT even when it's dangerous to do so?

8576.name: Nightking's Cape - Dark Red
8576.description: To defend the streets of a dark city, you'll need more than wits and skill - criminals need a symbol to fear, a sign of justice and vengeance alike, and without a righteously red cape like this, even the most amazing hero can't look the part. That, and its spring-loaded fabrics provide double-jump, because there's no harm in being practical while building your image!

8578.name: Nightking's Cape - Dark Purple
8578.description: To defend the streets of a dark city, you'll need more than wits and skill - criminals need a symbol to fear, a sign of justice and vengeance alike, and without a powerfully purple cape like this, even the most amazing hero can't look the part. That, and its spring-loaded fabrics provide double-jump, because there's no harm in being practical while building your image!

8580.name: Nightking's Cape - Black
8580.description: To defend the streets of a dark city, you'll need more than wits and skill - criminals need a symbol to fear, a sign of justice and vengeance alike, and without a brooding black cape like this, even the most amazing hero can't look the part. That, and its spring-loaded fabrics provide double-jump, because there's no harm in being practical while building your image!

8582.name: Nightking's Cape - Midnight Blue
8582.description: To defend the streets of a dark city, you'll need more than wits and skill - criminals need a symbol to fear, a sign of justice and vengeance alike, and without a beautifully blue cape like this, even the most amazing hero can't look the part. That, and its spring-loaded fabrics provide double-jump, because there's no harm in being practical while building your image!

8584.name: Executioner's Axe
8584.description: Finely honed for the perfect chop! Its blade might not go snicker-snack, but all the same, heads will roll! Chosen by rsrssh, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for June, 2019!

8586.name: EzCookOven's Robotic Tentacles
8586.description: Robotic allies to launch you to and fro! These high-tech tentacles were first developed to handle hazardous GrowTech waste, but their engineers discovered it was WAY more fun to use them to jump around instead (they can also play a mean game of chess, but most owners are too busy jumping to try)! Sponsored by EzCookOven for completing all epic quests!

8588.name: Phoenix Hair
8588.description: Infused with the powers of the Emperor Phoenix, this staggeringly rare hair will astonish all who view it as it takes you to the skies! There are many beautiful hairs in the worlds of Growtopia, but none are quite so impressively enflamed!

8590.name: Pet Toucan
8590.description: Caw! This adorable avian ally likes tropical fruits, crunchy nuts, and keeping its beautiful beak sharp!

8592.name: Polo Shirt - Blue
8592.description: It's summer time, so toss on a shirt that helps you beat the heat while looking neat and fit! Now in burning sky blue!

8594.name: Polo Shirt - Pink
8594.description: It's summer time, so toss on a shirt that helps you beat the heat while looking neat and fit! Now in poppin' iced drink pink!

8596.name: Aloha Floral Shirt
8596.description: A Hawaiian style shirt straight out of the tropics to keep you cool and fantastically floral!

8598.name: Aloha Floral Blouse
8598.description: A Hawaiian style blouse designed with a tropical touch to keep you cool and fantastically floral!

8600.name: Chinos - Pastel Orange
8600.description: Summery pants that let you hit the streets with a breezy step and a touch of low-key class! Now in outrageous vacation orange!

8602.name: Chinos - Pastel Blue
8602.description: Summery pants that let you hit the streets with a breezy step and a touch of low-key class! Now in beautiful sunshine blue!

8604.name: Crab Claw & Shield
8604.description: Somewhere, there's a very sad, very unarmed crab out there. Don't feel bad, though - these were better off in your hands.

8606.name: Dungeonist Crab Leash
8606.description: Once a many-limbed delver of dungeons, now a happy follower for you! Just... don't tell him how tasty he looks, okay? It makes him crabby.

8608.name: Riding Flamingo
8608.description: This pink pal got tired of standing around and decided to leg it over to you! Fancy a flamingotastic ride?

8610.name: Straw Fedora
8610.description: When you know you can rock a fedora like nobody's business but really want to hit the beach, it's time to embrace the ways of the straw hats!

8612.name: Floppy Straw Sun Hat
8612.description: Too much sun eating away at your beachtime fun? Flop on a hat like this and you'll not only be cool and shady, but look good doing it!

8614.name: Pet Turtle
8614.description: Are you turtley enough to join the Turtle Club? Maybe not, but with this guy at your side, they'll probably let you in anyway. It's all about who you know!

8616.name: Shark Suit
8616.description: Ace any job interview in seconds with this swimmingly sharp ensemble! If I were hiring, I know I'd appreciate any candidates to come dressed in their sharky best!

8618.name: Shark Head
8618.description: This piece of clothing really bites! But, like, in a good way. It's complicated. But also a shark, which is the more important part, really.

8620.name: Muninn's Unity Wings
8620.description: A raven's resplendent wings for a resplendently regal individual! The skies are yours, wise one.

8718.name: Porcelain Doll's Head
8718.description: So pristine and perfect, it's practically an antique! For proper use, make sure to stockpile several hundred of these in identical rows and then leave them in your attic for guests to find years later. They'll love it.

8720.name: Bamboo Pipe
8720.description: Maybe not so fancy as those hoity-toity hardwoods, but bamboo has a kind of class all its own, wouldn't you say?

8722.name: Flower Headband
8722.description: Flowers brighten up more than just rooms - they also look great in your hair. YOUR hair, specifically, I mean. They look like garbage in everyone else's.

8724.name: Lattice Dress
8724.description: Think of how long the tireless seamstresses of GrowTech's fabric division had to spend sewing this dress! No wonder it looks so chic!

8726.name: Serpent Headdress
8726.description: Feeling envious of Medusa? Top yourself with this headdress and get at least a little closer to her hissy hair!

8728.name: Monk's Hood
8728.description: Pie Jesu Domine, dona eis requiem.

8730.name: Bamboo Armor
8730.description: You might think it's funny, seeing a warrior come at you in clattering bamboo plate, but you won't be laughing when you get whacked by a bamboo sword!

8732.name: Bamboo Sword
8732.description: Hollow, yet honed! Listen to the air howl as this blade whirls toward your foes!

8734.name: Temple Robes
8734.description: Look, if you're going keep attending temple in a frog outfit, nobody's going to want to sit next to you. At least wear these so you can look the part!

8736.name: Obsidian Axe
8736.description: Sure, obsidian is just volcanic glass, but cleave it just right, and you can get an edge that's sharper than any scalpel! Ouch!

8810.name: Cute Bulb Mask
8810.description: Aww! We're not sure what the heck this thing actually is, but it LOOKS adorable. I mean, at least until it starts firing lasers at you. Not sure how that works, either...

8812.name: Riding Firefly
8812.description: Zips around with a glorious glow! Note: Rides on this buddy bug should be free, so if he asks you to pay, it's probably a farefly!

8814.name: Slithering Serpent Hair
8814.description: Everyone thinks it's GREAT to have hair made of snakes, but nobody ever thinks about how many mice you have to feed them...

8816.name: Astro Shades - Red
8816.description: Firing blasts of radical red light, these celestial-enhanced shades will light up your life, and like, anything else you look at with them! So try not to stare too long at valuable objects (or like, people)!

8818.name: Astro Shades - Orange
8818.description: Firing blasts of orangey orange light, these celestial-enhanced shades will light up your life, and like, anything else you look at with them! So try not to stare too long at valuable objects (or like, people)!

8820.name: Astro Shades - Purple
8820.description: Firing blasts of potent purple light, these celestial-enhanced shades will light up your life, and like, anything else you look at with them! So try not to stare too long at valuable objects (or like, people)!

8822.name: Astro Shades - Green
8822.description: Firing blasts of mean green light, these celestial-enhanced shades will light up your life, and like, anything else you look at with them! So try not to stare too long at valuable objects (or like, people)!

8830.name: Black Shoes
8830.description: From the most formal of occasions to the swankiest of clubs (on the darkest of nights, of course), everyone needs a pair of black shoes! These are extra-special, however, because they're YOURS.

8834.name: TK69's Mystical Etherboard
8834.description: Crush the skies between dimensions and surf the riptides of eternity with this mystical - and highly mobile - etherboard! Unfortunately, it looks like its GrowTech Time Circuits have shortcircuited (their warranty is only good for 5,000 years or parsecs, whichever comes first), so while this'll give you a boost of speed, it won't take you through time anymore... Sponsored by TK69 for completing all epic quests!

8838.name: Rainbow Scarf
8838.description: A wonderful mix of colors for a wonderful neck!

8840.name: Black Cat Ears
8840.description: They're so fuzzy! Top-tier scratchability and style, all in one double-pointed package.

8842.name: Toucan's Bill
8842.description: Ever see a bird with a colorful nut-crackin' beak and get jealous you don't have one? Well now, toucan play at that game!

8844.name: Chic White Dress
8844.description: Not just any white dress! If you couldn't already tell by how pretty this looks, we've carefully added the word 'chic' in the title to let everyone know the style here is off the charts!

8846.name: Lace A-Line Dress
8846.description: Absolutely stunning! Oh, and MUCH nicer than those B- and C-Line dresses! Don't even get me started on the D-Lines... sheesh!

8848.name: White Tuxedo
8848.description: When you want to stand out in a crowd of penguins (or investment bankers) without ruining the super-classy mood, try on this bright and beautiful tux!

8850.name: Blue and Black Tuxedo
8850.description: Class up the joint with the best kind of black-and-blue to get!

8852.name: Samurai's Do Armor
8852.description: Carefully-crafted overlapping pieces of protection for an honor-bound warrior. Do or Do not - there is no try.

8854.name: Samurai's Kabuto
8854.description: A stylized helm for an honor-bound warrior.

8856.name: Samurai's Waraji
8856.description: Flexible footwear for an honor-bound warrior.

8858.name: Samurai's Suneate & Leggings
8858.description: Protective leggings for an honor-bound warrior.

8860.name: Valkyrie's Cuirass
8860.description: A plate of unbreakable steel fit for the unbreakable will of the valkyrie!

8862.name: Valkyrie's Wings
8862.description: Flawless warrior wings for an unstoppable Chooser of the Slain!

8864.name: Valkyrie's Helm
8864.description: A helm of unbreakable steel fit for the unbreakable will (and beautiful face) of the valkyrie!

8866.name: Valkyrie's Sandals
8866.description: Nimble footwear for an agile Chooser of the Slain!

8868.name: Map of Loki
8868.description: This map's shifting letters seem to sizzle with doom and destruction, as if they're waiting for something - or somewhere - terrible...

8870.name: Boy's School Uniform Shirt
8870.description: A nicely-starched shirt! Clean, sharp, and ready for an education (or general misbehavior, depending on the day)!

8872.name: Boy's School Uniform Pants
8872.description: Carefully-creased pants! Clean, sharp, and ready for an education (or general misbehavior, depending on the day)!

8874.name: Girls's School Uniform Shirt
8874.description: A nicely-starched shirt! Clean, sharp, and ready for an education (or general misbehavior, depending on the day)!

8876.name: Girls's School Uniform Skirt
8876.description: A freshly-laundered skirt! Clean, sharp, and ready for an education (or general misbehavior, depending on the day)!

8880.name: Messy Braid
8880.description: You didn't have time to put this braid together, but who cares? You've got blocks to break and economies to alter!

8882.name: Messy Bun
8882.description: You didn't have time to put this bun together, but who cares? You've got seeds to splice and economies to alter!

8884.name: Long Full Bangs
8884.description: Way better than those Short Empty Bangs offered by other, lesser hairstylists.

8886.name: Hipster Beard
8886.description: Embrace the hipster life! With this fancy facial hair, you won't be able to stop asking for artisanal coffee and single-origin beans!

8888.name: Man Bun
8888.description: A bun of hair, but with an extra swirl of testosterone to make it extra-manly!

8890.name: Bed Head
8890.description: WAKE UP! GET HARVESTING! START TRADING! What? NO, you don't have time to do your hair! Just GO GO GO! Growtopia waits for no-one, and certainly no hair!

8892.name: Raccoon Leash
8892.description: Super-sneaky trash panda pet! Chitters and squeaks and loves treats (also, making a mess)!

8894.name: Panda Leash
8894.description: A much more official panda than the raccoon, this stoic plant-muncher has just two requests: More bamboo, and MORE BAMBOO!

8898.name: Riding World Lock - Green Light
8898.description: Yahoo! Forget cars and dragons and sneakers and starships - when you want to see the worlds of Growtopia, only the world lock can take you anywhere! Hit the gas on this speedy security device and leave your friends in its glowing green wake!

8900.name: Riding World Lock - Purple Light
8900.description: Yahoo! Forget cars and dragons and sneakers and starships - when you want to see the worlds of Growtopia, only the world lock can take you anywhere! Hit the gas on this speedy security device and leave your friends in its pulsing purple wake!

8902.name: Riding World Lock - White Light
8902.description: Yahoo! Forget cars and dragons and sneakers and starships - when you want to see the worlds of Growtopia, only the world lock can take you anywhere! Hit the gas on this speedy security device and leave your friends in its blazing white wake!

8904.name: Riding World Lock - Yellow Light
8904.description: Yahoo! Forget cars and dragons and sneakers and starships - when you want to see the worlds of Growtopia, only the world lock can take you anywhere! Hit the gas on this speedy security device and leave your friends in its yummy yellow wake!

8906.name: Masquerade Ball Mask
8906.description: With this decorative mask, even the most average growtopian can be the Belle of the Ball! Chosen by Ch4knuGT, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for August, 2019!

8908.name: Tea Basket
8908.description: Toss this on and any items you collect from a fully-grown tree will fall directly into your inventory! A little flimsy, so it's likely to break after you've collected a lot of stuff, but no less useful for it!

8910.name: Leaf Blower
8910.description: Tired of dealing with people? Wish they'd all just leaf you alone? Well, fire up this blower's GrowTech turbine and a storm of wind and fallen foliage will blast them into next year!

8912.name: Scarecrow Pet
8912.description: This little guy's tired of frightening birds (that time a flock of ravens stole his hat was the last straw), so he's decided to join up with you and see if your adventures are his kind of field!

8914.name: Mosquito King's Wings
8914.description: On one hand, these wings will make you royalty and you'll constantly be surrounded by your adoring subjects. On the other, those subjects will be mosquitoes, and mosquitoes are the worst.

8916.name: Ladakh Mask
8916.description: Part of a cultural celebration of life, this mask isn't just a good-looking potential piece of your outfit! It's also used in a major dance festival in the Indian region of - you guessed it - Ladakh!

8918.name: Ladakh Shirt
8918.description: Part of a cultural celebration of life, this shirt isn't just a good-looking potential piece of your outfit! It's also used in a major dance festival in the Indian region of - you guessed it - Ladakh!

8920.name: Ladakh Pants
8920.description: Part of a cultural celebration of life, these pants aren't just a good-looking potential piece of your outfit! They're also used in a major dance festival in the Indian region of - you guessed it - Ladakh!

8922.name: Ladakh Shoes
8922.description: Part of a cultural celebration of life, these shoes aren't just a good-looking potential piece of your outfit! They're also used in a major dance festival in the Indian region of - you guessed it - Ladakh!

8924.name: Harvest Moon Charm
8924.description: Mystic moonlight seeps from this charm, tipping your fields toward balance. As a result, while you wear it, your crops will be blessed with a higher chance of dropping Balance Mooncakes during the harvest!

8942.name: Dual Crescent Blade
8942.description: Forged in swirling desert sands, these ancient blades carry a hint of the siroccos in which they were made!

8944.name: Sun Blade
8944.description: Bane of vampires and mole people, the glorious Sun Blade casts a brilliant glow when held aloft! As a side bonus, it also provides its wielder with their daily recommended dose of Vitamin D.

8946.name: Storm Breaker
8946.description: As wielders of an ancient elemental power, those who hold this sky-shaking weapon will inspire awe in all who view them. Lo, the clouds shall part with a mighty crash of thunder, heralding your arrival!

8948.name: Speeder
8948.description: Perfect for zipping around an endless desert under the baleful glare of twin suns!

8950.name: Sniper Rifle
8950.description: Able to knock the wings off a fly at a thousand paces, this perfectly-calibrated rifle is an insect's greatest fear! Wait, you weren't planning on using it against anything else, were you??

8952.name: Monster Truck
8952.description: Full of fangs, fuel, and positraction, this beastly truck proves you don't need horsepower - not when you have MONSTERPOWER!

8954.name: Healing Tome
8954.description: A floating book filled with healthy tips and lost surgical arts! It'll follow you wherever you go, bringing good health to all. Well, except goats - it HATES goats (we think one tried to eat it).

8956.name: Ghost Mobile
8956.description: Haunted by the spirit of a legendary stunt driver, this car can go from zero to spectral in 0.6 seconds!

8958.name: Ghost Rider Bike
8958.description: Pulled from the underworld and wrapped in the flames of damnation, this bike is one scorchin' hot ride! Ow! Better wear some thicker pants!

8960.name: Spring-Loaded Fists
8960.description: Superb punching power - on springs! For those times when you REALLY want to punch someone and they're ALLL the way on the other side of the room!

8962.name: Ring of Night
8962.description: Binds its wielder to the darkness and makes them one with the night! You won't need the hated touch of light to illuminate the dark with this imposing artifact on your finger...

8972.name: Steampunk Goggles
8972.description: Fogged with the heat of your latest madcap mechanical monstrosity and lined in soot, these goggles have seen you through more than one unplanned explosion!

8974.name: Colored Round Glasses
8974.description: Viewing the past with colored glasses might not be a great idea, but the present? That just makes you look cool!

8996.name: Anubis Mask
8996.description: The face of an AncieNt goD, forgottEn beneath tRackless desert sands, has fallEn into youR hands! Imagine what the eyes behind this strange mask Once saw...

8998.name: Anubis Seal
8998.description: Heavy plate to entomb the might of an Ancient god! How could This Have found its way across thE tRackless wastes to yOu? from what dark dangers did it protect its former owner...?

9000.name: Anubis Mail
9000.description: Overlapping plates and sunForged chain to proTect an ancient god! WHen did Anubis losE this? Or perhaps he Found something Even stronger...

9002.name: Anubis Greaves
9002.description: Scoured by the desert sands, like a Jewel, these greaves cUt through towering dunes in the Service of Their enIgmatiC ownEr!

9004.name: Anubis Boots
9004.description: Even strange And mystical godS of the ancient world Knew the benefit of good footwear. these boots can Help you defy the dEsert heat Without losing your cool!

9006.name: Spirit of Anubis
9006.description: Drawn back from the endless deserts of the afterlife, the power of Anubis flows through you! By combining his relics, you have summoned his spirit from across the gulf of time, and in thanks for freeing him from the embrace of the void, he has agreed to lend a portion of his might to you in your adventures!

9008.name: Cursed Spirit Pendant - Red
9008.description: Howling with repugnant red energy and generally bad vibes, this pendant was found locked in an iron trunk in the basement of a dark castle. THEN it was buried with its former owner (who died of mysterious causes) before being stolen by graverobbers. THEN it was sold to an evil general before being lost on a wartorn battlefield. AND THEN... it found its way to you. Quake in terror, mortal, for this is surely the most haunted object to be found in Growtopia... so far!

9010.name: Cursed Spirit Pendant - Green
