9010.description: Howling with gruesome green energy and generally bad vibes, this pendant was found locked in an iron trunk in the basement of a dark castle. THEN it was buried with its former owner (who died of mysterious causes) before being stolen by graverobbers. THEN it was sold to an evil general before being lost on a wartorn battlefield. AND THEN... it found its way to you. Quake in terror, mortal, for this is surely the most haunted object to be found in Growtopia... so far!

9012.name: Cursed Spirit Pendant - Purple
9012.description: Howling with pulsing purple energy and generally bad vibes, this pendant was found locked in an iron trunk in the basement of a dark castle. THEN it was buried with its former owner (who died of mysterious causes) before being stolen by graverobbers. THEN it was sold to an evil general before being lost on a wartorn battlefield. AND THEN... it found its way to you. Quake in terror, mortal, for this is surely the most haunted object to be found in Growtopia... so far!

9014.name: Cursed Spirit Pendant - Blue
9014.description: Howling with blasted blue energy and generally bad vibes, this pendant was found locked in an iron trunk in the basement of a dark castle. THEN it was buried with its former owner (who died of mysterious causes) before being stolen by graverobbers. THEN it was sold to an evil general before being lost on a wartorn battlefield. AND THEN... it found its way to you. Quake in terror, mortal, for this is surely the most haunted object to be found in Growtopia... so far!

9016.name: Superfly Hat
9016.description: The sweetest hat for the smoothest of Growtopians, this is what you should be slipping on when you want the coolest style possible! Chosen by FarmWizard, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for September, 2019!

9032.name: Scythe of the Underworld
9032.description: Dripping with dark magic, the blade of this horrific scythe is capable of cutting through the veil of life and death itself! Wrenched into the mortal plane by dire sorcery, it's now free to wreak havoc among the living!

9034.name: Tarantula Legs
9034.description: Skitter, skitter, goes the spider. Long legs and longer shadows reach out from their monstrous owner... you.

9036.name: Horns of Growganoth
9036.description: The Dark One walks among us! You have been cursed (or blessed, depending on your level of evil) with the dire sign of Growganoth itself! These horns are a sure sign you've taken one step too far across the line between good and ghastly! `2Buff:`` Bonus 250 XP for consuming a Dark Ticket for the Tomb of Growganoth!

9038.name: Supernaturally Speedy Black High Heels
9038.description: Super-fast and super-stylish, these heels will get you where you need to be in a flash! Only problem is that they're really, REALLY uncomfortable, especially once you hit Mach 2...

9048.name: Dark Fairy Pendant
9048.description: This fairy used to be full of goodness, gumdrops, and light, but a few bad decisions, one too many hits of pixie dust, and hanging around with the wrong crowd led her down the path to darkness!

9050.name: Totally Harmless Doll Head
9050.description: What's scarier? A totally harmless doll that stays in one place until you look away... or a Growtopian wearing its head?!

9052.name: Totally Harmless Doll Shirt
9052.description: What's scarier? A totally harmless doll that stays in one place until you look away... or a Growtopian wearing its shirt?!

9054.name: Totally Harmless Doll Pants
9054.description: What's scarier? A totally harmless doll that stays in one place until you look away... or a Growtopian wearing its pants?!

9056.name: Demon Night Stallion
9056.description: Now THIS is a horse that'll make you say neigh! If you dare to ride it, make sure you have plenty of evil sugar cubes and cursed carrots to tempt it into not stomping you flat!

9058.name: Cursed Katana
9058.description: A once-honorable blade, this katana was renowned as a slayer of evil, but the void stares back, as they say, and centuries of carnage have twisted it to the ways of darkness! Beware this blade, for those who wield it... are forever cursed!

9060.name: Hilarious Honker
9060.description: Some people are scared of clowns, but who could be afraid of this cute little guy? Summoned by the whimsical toots of his magical horn, Binky is here to amuse and play!

9062.name: Chimera's Call
9062.description: A bizarre creature out of myth! The chimera may be a mash-up of many animals, but every last part is filled with an equal amount of friendship for you!

9064.name: Rainbow Crystal Cloak
9064.description: Rainbow cloth studded with shimmering crystals! The multicolored majesty of this cloak will carry you aloft, where all can gaze upon your prismatic wonder!

9066.name: Claw Of Growganoth
9066.description: A creeping being from the darkest depths of the void! Summoned by the fractured claw of its master, is this monstrous thing truly a creation of Growganoth... or something darker?

9068.name: Nano Nurse Bot
9068.description: Filled with helpful nanobots to improve your surgery successes (and maybe keep you from losing an item or two)!

9070.name: Battle Boots
9070.description: Stomp your foes... but not your wallet! These boots are made for victories, so put 'em on and get to winning!

9072.name: Alpha's Shawl
9072.description: For those who refuse to heed the call of the pack, this shawl will show everyone you'll never follow - only lead! AwooooOOOOOOoooo!

9074.name: Mega-Hooky Vest
9074.description: A big fish needs a bigger hook, and this vest has plenty to spare! Toss this on and cast off for a fishy victory!

9076.name: Superb Chef's Super Spatula
9076.description: Get your flip on! This spatula will flip any objects with a single slap! Use it on chairs, beds, and anything else you find facing the wrong way! Best of all, it's made of patented GrowTech spatulanium, guaranteed to stay firm even after a thousand slaps!

9078.name: Slippery Chemical Coat
9078.description: Coated in frictionless chemicals! This coat is utterly spattered with the most nonstick, inertia-preserving, super-lubricated slip-n'-slide mix, so if you're wearing it, make sure you're not near anything sharp!

9082.name: Rocket-Powered Warhammer
9082.description: Forget using your puny human muscles to swing this hammer! It's so big and bashy, it uses ROCKET POWER to crack the skies and shatter the earth! Look out!

9084.name: Tainted Cheese
9084.description: The rat summoned by this cheese is very friendly, but also very ill! Why would you want this plagued vermin for a pet? Well, getting a rare malady isn't always a bad thing, assuming you have a good doctor to help cure it!

9086.name: Friendship Dragon Claw
9086.description: There are many dragons out there - dragons of fire and disaster, dragons of home and hearth, and even dragons from beyond the stars - but NONE are so friendly as this one! Known as Hugalovensnugglor (Hugsy to his closest friends), this dragon is only too happy to shower the world (and you) with hearts!

9088.name: Spectral Mantle
9088.description: Writhing chains from the Other Side! These spirit-forged links are meant to capture the most terrible of ghosts, but since you're not, y'know, DEAD, they just look very cool (and maybe a little creepy).

9092.name: Captain's Log
9092.description: A high-tech diary to record your latest findings! The incredible efficiency possible through careful record-keeping may even give you a chance of not using up a Star Tool during a Star Mission! Wow!

9094.name: Dark Doctor's Cloak
9094.description: Not all doctors are concerned with their patients! For some, like those who bear this dire cloak, they only live for the challenge of the most vicious of diseases, and wearing this cloak will increase their odds of getting them from Vile Vials! Yikes!

9096.name: Loot Detector
9096.description: Perfect for treasure-seekers! This detector will increase your odds of finding maps and map fragments in Treasure Blasts, which is weird, considering they're not made of metal. Hey, how does this thing work, anyway?!

9098.name: Ghostking's Command
9098.description: A rod of command stripped from the forces of the Other Side! This spectral scepter won't necessarily make ghosts any happier to see you, but it WILL decrease the odds that a Spirit Storage Unit will detonate at lower, less-lucrative levels in worlds you own!

9100.name: Guild Challenge Crown
9100.description: Congratulations! Your guild was #1 in a Guild Daily Challenge! Show off your accomplishment with a shiny crown. Ooh, so shiny!

9114.name: Nightmare Teeny Devil Wings
9114.description: Now with extra nightmares to terrify you and everyone else! You wanna float?

9116.name: Red Laser Scimitar
9116.description: Carve the very air itself with energy-edged annihilation! Designed to exacting standards by GrowTech's Department of Slicing & Dicing, this blazing red blade will show your foes that when it comes to bleeding-edge weaponry, you can't beat an edge made of LASERS!

9118.name: Green Laser Scimitar
9118.description: Carve the very air itself with energy-edged annihilation! Designed to exacting standards by GrowTech's Department of Slicing & Dicing, this blazing green blade will show your foes that when it comes to bleeding-edge weaponry, you can't beat an edge made of LASERS!

9120.name: Blue Laser Scimitar
9120.description: Carve the very air itself with energy-edged annihilation! Designed to exacting standards by GrowTech's Department of Slicing & Dicing, this blazing blue blade will show your foes that when it comes to bleeding-edge weaponry, you can't beat an edge made of LASERS!

9122.name: Purple Laser Scimitar
9122.description: Carve the very air itself with energy-edged annihilation! Designed to exacting standards by GrowTech's Department of Slicing & Dicing, this blazing purple blade will show your foes that when it comes to bleeding-edge weaponry, you can't beat an edge made of LASERS!

9124.name: Wolfy Tank Top
9124.description: AwoooOOOOooo! Lovers of lupine layers, take note: your fashion icon has arrived! Chosen by RDK, this howlingly handsome tank top is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for October, 2019!

9132.name: Turkey Hat
9132.description: Very few turkeys make for good headgear, and even fewer are stronger enough to lift a full-grown Growtopian, so count yourself lucky you've found this mighty beast!

9134.name: Riding Bell
9134.description: We truly live in a future our ancestors could only have dreamed of, a vast land of possibility where bells aren't just for announcing dinner or generating ambience, but where they come with plush seats and 500 horsepower, capable of carrying us to and fro, all thanks to GrowTech!

9136.name: Dueling Star Fighter - Rebel Raider
9136.description: Splash your name across the stars in this high-flying, laser-firing, rebellion-building beauty of a star fighter! There's a cold and devious empire out there that needs toppling, and you're just the pilot to do it!

9138.name: Dueling Star Fighter - Imperial Enforcer
9138.description: Stand for the glory of the Emperor in this turbo-powered, rebel-crushing, empire-stabilizing stunner of a spacecraft! There's an ill-planned and dangerous rebellion out there that needs crushing, and you're just the pilot to do it!

9144.name: Defiant Jester's Mask
9144.description: Not all jesters are funny! This mask is for a court entertainer with deadly serious skills! Maybe they were a bodyguard for the King...? Chosen by inflames19, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for November, 2019!

9172.name: Armored WinterBot - Back
9172.description: One of five legendary pieces of the great WinterBot, guardian of the Winter Fortress. Turns out its great for relieving back pain.

9174.name: Armored WinterBot - Feet
9174.description: One of five legendary pieces of the great WinterBot, guardian of the Winter Fortress. You can't tell if you are running incredibly fast, or constantly sliding. Either way, these shoes make you faster.

9176.name: Armored WinterBot - Fists
9176.description: One of five legendary pieces of the great WinterBot, guardian of the Winter Fortress. Ice shards envelope your hand, punching with this might do some damage.

9178.name: Armored WinterBot - Mail
9178.description: One of five legendary pieces of the great WinterBot, guardian of the Winter Fortress. I hope you're used to the cold, its only getting colder from here. Perhaps this isn't the best thing to wear without a jacket.

9180.name: Armored WinterBot - Greaves
9180.description: One of five legendary pieces of the great WinterBot, guardian of the Winter Fortress. Gives you an icy stance, not sure if it's the resolve of guarding the fortress for eternity or just that you've lost all feeling in your legs.

9182.name: Frosty Wings
9182.description: These Frosty Wings are made out of ice so they can't fly, but perhaps if you try hard enough... Nope, you can double jump.

9184.name: Riding Eagle Owl
9184.description: This strange little bird can't make up its mind if it's an eagle or an owl! Either way it can easily lift you into the air none the less.

9188.name: Elf Hoodie
9188.description: Just because you dress up like an elf doesn't mean you are one, but at least you shouldn't be getting any coal this year.

9190.name: Cloak of Fire and Ice
9190.description: We had to add ice to the cape, otherwise it would have back-fired.

9192.name: Yeti Leash
9192.description: This terrifying little beast of the arctic wastes, just wants a hug. Maybe it thinks you're its mommy with those big feet!

9194.name: Hammer Of Winter
9194.description: It seems to be a stick with a huge ice block on the end. Whenever you swing this, the ice block flies off at incredible speeds. Bet it could do some serious damage.

9206.name: Tacky Holiday Hair
9206.description: You infused your hair with so much 'spirit of giving', it became a Giving Tree!

9208.name: Cute Riding Polar Bear
9208.description: It's like a horse... except it's soft, fuzzy, large, and predatory. It possibly wants to eat you! It would never hurt you though, it's too adorable.

9210.name: Winter Radiance Aura
9210.description: Cold seems to radiate from you, swirling into careless snowflakes. Somehow this grants you the ability to double jump, don't ask how.

9238.name: Flower Pot
9238.description: This delicate little flower is just too precious to put down! Good thing it likes to be held by kind Growtopians like yourself! Chosen by DeusV, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for December, 2019!

9250.name: Superstar Shades
9250.description: They say wisdom comes with age, but they didn't say anything about style like this! These are the shades of superstardom, reserved for the greatest of Growtopians! With these equipped, YOU will become the very definition of cool. As for wisdom, well... that's up to you.

9252.name: Confetti Rocket Shoes
9252.description: Look, if sticking confetti-filled rockets to the bottom of shoes is crazy, then I don't want to be sane.

9254.name: Euphoric Dragon
9254.description: Of all the many dragons you could encounter, this is perhaps the most dangerous... if you don't like FUN! Utterly uncompromising in its quest for the biggest and best parties, this dragon is all about a good time, and it's utterly thrilled to be at your side as you adventure into the wilds of Growtopia!

9256.name: Party Bubble Blaster
9256.description: The ultimate in party contributions, this bubble blaster will turn any scene into a beautiful whirlwind of bubbly fun! Pop-pop!

9258.name: Raver Hoodie
9258.description: Express your taste for neon-drenched fun with this psychedelically-colorful raver hoodie.

9260.name: Raver Pants
9260.description: Dang! Those are some bright n' colorful pants, sure to help you stand out in any scene! (Well, aside from the raver scene - you'll blend right in with them!)

9262.name: Raver Hair
9262.description: Amp up the party with this amped-up hairdo! Everyone's sure to be impressed, and if they're not, well, they're probably deeply uncool, so who cares?

9272.name: Draconic Claw
9272.description: Used as a symbol of strength and power in parts of China, the Feilong dragon is so powerful it doesn't even need wings to fly. Way to flex on those other dragons, dude. There are only 1100 in existence!

9280.name: Jin Chan Leash
9280.description: This mythical creature is said to appear in the presence of good news or great fortune. Lucky you! Now that you have tied it to your wrist you should ALWAYS have good fortune... right? Punching with this equipped allows you to launch a devastating fireball at your foes. Make it burn!

9282.name: Huli Jing Scarf
9282.description: According to legend, the Huli Jing can be a force of good or evil - and nothing in between. Let's hope you got the good one.

9292.name: Year of the Rat Mask
9292.description: The rat is the first of the zodiac animals. According to myth, the Jade Emperor stated the order of the zodiac would be decided by a race. The rat was clever and tricked the Ox into giving him a ride, then, at the finish line the rat jumped down and landed in front, becoming first. Limited only to Year of the Rat!

9294.name: Emperor's Jacket
9294.description: One of traditions of Lunar New Year is to celebrate new beginnings and a clean slate. Start off the New Year right with this traditionally-styled jacket! Comes in one color, red, which also happens to be the best color.

9304.name: Brutal Hand Fans
9304.description: Conjure the force of a hurricane through these deceptively dangerous fans. With one devastating flap, they'll channel your inner chi and send out a stunning strike. You wouldn't want to be on the other end of this!

9312.name: Love Lips
9312.description: Wild smoochy colors for a wild smoochy face!

9314.name: Charmer Smile
9314.description: Nobody can resist a winning smile! It's even better when it's actually attached to someone's face, though, so put this on and start winning hearts!

9316.name: Beefy Biceps
9316.description: Swole as can be! These biceps are the sign of a true athlete, a dedicated fitness freak who keeps their body in tip-top shape! ...and now they're yours. Uh, where did you even get these?

9318.name: Snuggly Kitty Scarf
9318.description: Full of love and fuzzy affection, this superb scarfcat has only one wish: to spend its days draped around your neck and absorbing as many snuzzles as possible! Mew!

9320.name: Cloud Nine Cape
9320.description: Woven from the warmest, fluffiest clouds funneled down from the highest heights, this cape is light as can be, softer than you can imagine, and all set to take you up, up, and away!

9322.name: Golden Sunset Cape
9322.description: Practically glowing with the eye-popping colors of a perfect sunset, this once-cloudy cape has been transformed into a stunning piece of radiant cloth! Don this beauty, and everyone will treat you like a sky set ablaze with all the majesty of a setting sun - they won't be able to look away!

9324.name: Heartthrob Helm
9324.description: Armor for a valiant Knight of the Heart, this helm will keep your noggin safe from slashing steel and sorrowful heartbreak alike!

9326.name: Golden Heartthrob Helm
9326.description: Only the most elite Champions of Heart have worn a helm such as this! Polished to a brilliant shine, it's hard to tell if this helm is shimmering from the elegance of its design or the incredible heart of its bearer, but either way, all who look on it will be awed by its beauty.

9332.name: Dating Dandy's Suit
9332.description: Hit the dating scene in style with this charismatic suit!

9334.name: Dating Dandy's Hair
9334.description: Hit the dating scene in style with this slick and stupendous hair!

9336.name: Dating Vixen's Dress
9336.description: Hit the dating scene in style with this irresistible dress!

9338.name: Dating Vixen's Hair
9338.description: Hit the dating scene in style with this stunning hairstyle!

9340.name: Datemaster's Rose
9340.description: Perfect for making your affectionate intentions known, this rose will let everyone know you're a date-goin' Growtopian without peer! Toss one now and get your dating done right!

9342.name: Datemaster's Bling
9342.description: Forget putting a ring on it - toss a GIGANTIC ring AT it and they'll never forget you!

9344.name: Datemaster's Heart Locket
9344.description: All the secrets of the perfect date have been fused with the sparkling strength of a golden heart to create this nexus of affection! Be the quickest to anyone's heart when you don this delightful locket!

9348.name: Medusa's Crown
9348.description: Crafted by the Great Gorgon herself, this incredible crown of magic and malice will strike fear into the hearts of all who look upon it. With the power of its gaze, you'll be able to turn your enemies (and hey, even your friends!) to stone! Note: The Curse of the Gorgon only works in worlds that arn't punch jammed. Magic is weird like that.

9352.name: Pink Teeny Angel Wings
9352.description: Even as tiny as they are, these cute pink wings allow you to jump in mid-air!

9354.name: Walking Cane
9354.description: An exquisitely crafted walking cane made of the finest mahogany with gold trim. Great for peaceful walks in the garden or keeping you looking classy in your old age! Chosen by TBUO, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for January, 2020!

9356.name: Magic Stones
9356.description: Carrying these magical stones will light up even the darkest areas, although, the magic seems unstable. These magic stones burn out at unpredictable moments so make sure to carry several.

9360.name: Armored Riding Troll
9360.description: A tamed monstrosity of the deep caverns of the world. Throws dirt at your foes and moves with surprising speed for its size.

9364.name: Dwarven Mining Helm
9364.description: Tired of carrying your candle in your hand? Some clever dwarf discovered you can stick it to your helm to free up your hands for digging.

9366.name: Shield of Mining
9366.description: Protects from falling debris. Also quite handy in a fight.

9370.name: Strange Eyes
9370.description: Born from the inky black of the deep caves, these eyes look a little odd to anyone not familiar with the deep caverns.

9372.name: Mining Pauldrons
9372.description: Protects from falling debris. Arm yourself for the dangers that lie in the deep places of the world.

9374.name: Mining Chestplate
9374.description: Protects from falling debris. Arm yourself for the dangers that lie in the deep places of the world.

9376.name: Mining Mech
9376.description: Forged from the magic ore of the deep caverns, it's magic drill will break through deep caverns with ease.

9378.name: Lightning Gauntlets
9378.description: Stores magic energy and then releases it in a bolt of lightning from your fingertips. Like a sith lord but cooler.

9394.name: Balrog Wings
9394.description: Born of fire and shadow. These wings burn but somehow are never consumed.

9396.name: Balrog's Tail
9396.description: A sword forged from the tail of a mighty demon.

9408.name: Galaxy Aura
9408.description: A swirling galaxy engulfs you, pulling everything you touch towards you (well only growtopians!).

9410.name: Radiant Doom Staff
9410.description: A floating staff radiating with dark energy and deep dread! For some reason it seems to like you and will do what you say (for now). It'll follow you wherever you go, and strike fear in the hearts of your enemies. Best not to make it angry though.

9416.name: Irish Top Hat
9416.description: A lovely top of the morning top hat! Only found in Blarney 1 and 4.

9418.name: Green Trenchcoat
9418.description: It's Green... it's  a coat, its an awesome Green Trenchcoat! Note: this is a "chest item", like a necklace, so you can wear any shirts and back items you want underneath it.

9424.name: Giant Falling Shamrock
9424.description: Shamrocks are lucky.... lucky it doesnt fall like a rock! Hold the jump button while falling to cushion your fall. Only found in Blarney 5, 7 and 9.

9426.name: Dala Horsie
9426.description: Get rocking and rolling on this speedy horse!

9428.name: Money Aura
9428.description: Money can't buy you everything but it sure looks cool swirling around you!

9430.name: Pooka Hood
9430.description: Look like a proper pooka with the pooka hood!

9434.name: Mobility Scooter
9434.description: Get around with the latest and greatest in Mobility Scooters. Chosen by Kulchvyach, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for February, 2020!

9442.name: Chick Tricycle
9442.description: Always wanted to be driven around? Now's your chance with the new Chick Tricycle! Hiring a chauffeur has never been this cheep! Although, you might want to chick its credentials.

9444.name: Nest Hat
9444.description: Some little chicks snooze in this nest hat. How they managed to form a nest on the top of your head is pretty impressive. The more you move, the more agitated they seem to get, better slow down and not upset your new friends.

9446.name: Egg Champion Cape
9446.description: First chauffeurs, now flying cape services? Is there anything these chicks can't do?

9448.name: Egg Ammo Belt
9448.description: FOOD FIGHT! Be ready for battle with the egg ammo belt, nothing is worse than getting splatted by a volley of eggs. Just don't hard boil any of them. That would cause some serious damage.

9450.name: Hot Cross Bun Launcher
9450.description: Served hot and fresh - straight to your face. Careful, flaming buns may cause burns, cool before eating!

9452.name: Loafers
9452.description: Keep your feet toasty all year round with these loafers, there is nothing butter than wearing bread on your feet!

9454.name: Carrot on a Stick
9454.description: Always hungry but never productive? Finally a solution for you! Get stuff done under the illusion of chasing food! Don't judge, it works for some people.

9462.name: Boastful Brawler Hair
9462.description: A boastful hairstyle that's punching above its weight! Bleached platinum white for perfect preparation to apply hair dye and personalise to your heart's desire.

9464.name: Powerful Ponytail Hair
9464.description: A powerful hairstyle that's punching above its weight! Bleached platinum white for perfect preparation to apply hair dye and personalise to your heart's desire.

9468.name: Cooking Recipe - Chocolate Easter Bilby
9468.description: Apparently many people can't seem to tell the difference between this cute little marsupial mouse and a rabbit so if you try to cook one without this recipe you will end up with a chocolate bunny instead. To cook this recipe you will need the following:<CR><CR>You must hold this recipe in your hand.<CR>Ingredients:<CR>   - Easter Egg - Growtopia<CR>   - Baking Chocolate<CR>   - Chocolate Sprinkles Block<CR>   - Marshmallow<CR><CR>Seasoning:<CR>   - Sugar<CR><CR>Process:<CR>Add Easter Egg - Growtopia to an oven on Low heat. While the Easter Egg - Growtopia is still cold, add Baking Chocolate. Add the seasonings and wait until cooked all the way through. Then add Chocolate Sprinkles Block and Marshmallow and remove from the oven when perfectly cooked.<CR><CR>Timings may vary so you will need to experiment.

9470.name: Wacky Rocket Sled
9470.description: Strap on because you're in for a wacky ride! A high octane rocket sled, it might not look safe but it's fun! Beep Beep!

9478.name: Chilled Smile Mask
9478.description: When you're tired of using all those crazy facial muscles, this mask is here to help! Hide your tired growtopian face with this reliable, totally-not-creepy chilled smile instead!. Chosen by XMenkel, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for March, 2020!

9606.name: Doomsday Warhammer
9606.description: Wield the Warhammer of Doom and rain fiery death down on all around you! This warhammer is so hot it even tears the ground up as you lug its heavy weight behind you.

9608.name: Chip-and-Dip
9608.description: Keep your supply of hot salsa and cool guac close with you at all times with this hat. Its guacca be the best hat ever!

9610.name: Mexican Hot Sauce Rocket Pack
9610.description: This rocket pack will take the heat up to Scotch Bonnet level as you blast to the skies powered by Mexico's finest chilli sauce.

9612.name: Mexican Pointy Boots
9612.description: Pointy as a arrow, sharp as knife, speedy as a super speedy jumping bean being particulary speedy! Complete with your own gang of jumping beans to follow you around!

9618.name: Bongo Drum
9618.description: March to the beat of your own drum with the snazzy Mexican Bongo! Hot and Spicy beats for all!

9620.name: Trumpet
9620.description: Toot Toot Tootin' Mexican Trumpet! Some sweet chiily pepper trumpet vibes for all to hear!

9632.name: Chichen-Itza Shirt
9632.description: If you Myan over what to wear, choose this! Its Chichen what-cha want to wear.

9634.name: Chichen-Itza Hat
9634.description: A temple to wear over your temples! Itza brilliant!

9642.name: Rose Hairpin
9642.description: A regal rose to brighten up your hair! Chosen by Bojoing, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for April, 2020!

9648.name: Go Anywhere Surfboard
9648.description: A Surfboard with your very own personal wave! Travel over land and sea in style, comfort and awesomeness!

9650.name: Pineapple Plough
9650.description: Ever wanted a plough made from a ravenous pineapple? Of course you have and here it is! This pineapple has a taste for trees and it's really hungry right now!

9652.name: Pineapple Robes
9652.description: Pineapple palm robes fit for a Pineapple Prince or Princess or for anyone wanting the cool breeze that comes with wearing leaves!

9654.name: Pineapple Superhero
9654.description: Is it a bird? Is it a plane? No! It's a cool flying pineapple shooting lasers! That's way cooler!

9656.name: Pineapple Coronet
9656.description: What does every wannabe Pineapple Prince or Princess need? A Pineapple Coronet of course! Prickly on the head but worth it!

9660.name: Pineapple Headphones
9660.description: Sweet beats for when you're scoffing pineapple treats! Dance along to some funky tunes looking totally awesome in these!

9670.name: Pineapple Boardshorts
9670.description: Whether you're surfing, chilling on the beach or kicking back eating a fresh pineapple, these shorts are just the perfect fit!

9672.name: Pineapple Trooper Helmet
9672.description: In space no one can hear you scream.... but they can see you coming a mile off in all your pineapple glory with this space helmet!

9692.name: Exo Suit Helmet
9692.description: Look like a total space boss with Exo Suit Helmet! Makes you look tough and stylish all at once!

9694.name: Exo Suit Body
9694.description: Look like a total space boss with Exo Suit Body! Makes you look tough and stylish all at once!

9696.name: Exo Suit Pants
9696.description: Look like a total space boss with Exo Suit Pants! Makes you look tough and stylish all at once!

9698.name: Arm Blaster
9698.description: That Blaster is Mega! Fire a blinding red laser from your arm and live out all your 16bit dreams!

9702.name: Escapee's Collar
9702.description: Like a necklace but way more dangerous!! Show off your stealth escaping skills with this reminder of life in space jail!

9704.name: Hikers Dressing Gown
9704.description: If you're travelling around the galaxy without a spaceship, this dressing gown will look the part when hailing a ride from a stranger!

9706.name: Space Opera Mask
9706.description: Live out your own literal space opera with this Space Opera Mask! Maybe you could be the Phantom Menance of the Opera with it on!

9710.name: Space Tattoo
9710.description: Nothing says I live on an other planet and am part of a motley crew of space raiders than a facial tattoo! Tatooinely what you need to scare your Aunt and Uncle!

9712.name: Crystal Aura
9712.description: An enchanted crystal aura surrounds you, emitting light from the purest of crystal form! Don't look directly into it's light its too mesmerising.

9714.name: My Pet Sputnik
9714.description: A pet Sputnik for all your space adventuring needs! Careful though those radiowaves its emitting look deadly!

9716.name: Crystal Infused Sword
9716.description: A sword of true beauty and of true power! Each swing of it's blade is infused with the power of crystals forged eons ago by unknown hands!

9728.name: Dark Watcher's Mask
9728.description: Worn by the mysterious group that watch from the dark. Chosen by Armourfnafs, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for May, 2020!

9730.name: Phoenix Scarf
9730.description: The spirit of the Phoenix will rise above you and be with you always when you wear this scarf of extreme beauty and rarity! These are so rare you had better look after it! No more than 500 of these exist in Growtopia!

9732.name: Greg, The Octopus
9732.description: A friendly octopus buddy who clings to you wherever you go! With 8 legs and a bulbous head he's got an inky surprise for anyone who gets in your way!

9734.name: Starfish Leash
9734.description: Did you wish upon a star...fish? Because you got a little pointy friend! They may look cute but don't get too close as they are also quite spikey to touch!

9736.name: Floatie Crown
9736.description: When is a crown not a crown? When it's also an inflatable duck! Give your attacks some much needed quack with this Floatie Crown!

9738.name: Staff of the Deep
9738.description: It's splishy! It's fishy! It's splashy! And it will send you into a fish frenzy! Be the master of land and sea with this most awesome staff!

9742.name: Flamingo Wings
9742.description: Majestically soar in the sky with these wings.... wait, that's not right! Flap wildly like a crazy Flamingo with these equipped!

9744.name: Fruity Trousers
9744.description: The perfect pear of trousers for a summer's day. Some say the fruit pattern is so realistic it even attracts wasps!

9746.name: Clownfish Shirt
9746.description: If you've ever wanted to dress like a Clownfish before, then your dreams have just come true! Perfect to wear when you're out finding other lost Clownfish!

9758.name: Neptune's Trident
9758.description: Legend says this Trident once belonged to the God of the sea himself, Neptune! The power of the waves become yours to behold with this watery weapon! The first of the new Neptune's set! Only 500 of this item will ever be available!

9760.name: Pegasus Wings
9760.description: With these wings, you can soar with eagles and other flying horses! They grant you the ability to double jump with a majestic burst of feathers and magic!

10006.name: Cow Mask
10006.description: Something about this mask is udderly hilarious. Chosen by CowCrash, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for June, 2020!

10024.name: Troll Mask
10024.description: A great mask for troll'ing and lol'ing in equal measure! Chosen by Slenor, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for July, 2020!

10026.name: Axolotl Scarf
10026.description: Nothing keeps you both warm and stylish like a living breathing Axolotl scarf! So cute, so warm, which is weird as Axolotl's are actually cold blooded!

10028.name: Axolotl Hood
10028.description: The perfect item for when you wake up in the morning and think, "I really want to dress like an Axolotl today, especially my head"!

10030.name: Axolotl Onesie
10030.description: The perfect item for when you wake up in the morning and think, "I really want to dress like an Axolotl today".

10032.name: Axolotl Slippers
10032.description: Cute slippers for when you want your feet to look like Axolotl's! Don't go stepping on real Axolotl's by mistake though!

10034.name: Axolotl Hoodie
10034.description: For when your brain says dress practical but your heart says dress like a cute amphibian! With this hoodie you get the best of both worlds.

10036.name: Waist Tied Sweater - Green
10036.description: A sweater tied around your waist like a little cape for your butt!

10038.name: Waist Tied Sweater - Red
10038.description: A sweater tied around your waist like a little cape for your butt!

10040.name: Waist Tied Sweater - Blue
10040.description: A sweater tied around your waist like a little cape for your butt!

10042.name: Waist Tied Sweater - Yellow
10042.description: A sweater tied around your waist like a little cape for your butt!

10044.name: Golem's Gift
10044.description: A cool pair of shoes that give you the golem's gift to manipulate the very earth around you!

10046.name: Growboy
10046.description: Bask in the nostalgic green screened goodness of the Growboy! A portable gaming device that packs a punch. Now you're playing with GrowPower!

10048.name: Tactical Stealth Espionage Device
10048.description: This is Growtech's latest innovation on tactical espionage! Using the latest in scientific breakthroughs, this device allows you to seamlessly disguise yourself as...a cardboard box!

10050.name: Really Dangerous Pet Llama
10050.description: This Llama is ready for anything Growtopia throws at it! Armed with a silo of Growtech Missiles, experimental Growtech hardened steel armor and a rather snazzy helmet (Llama's own) this Llama is Dangerous with a capital D!

10052.name: Eldritch Crossbow
10052.description: A mysterious Eldritch flame binds itself to each and every arrow loaded into this crossbow. Some say the flame will burn forever, some claim it's actually powered by AA batteries but who really knows!

10054.name: Zodiac Wings
10054.description: The power of the Zodiac fills your body. The 12 signs align perfectly and allow you to not only reach for the stars but jump amongst them as well!

10064.name: Capuchin Leash
10064.description: An adorable pet Capuchin armed to the back teeth with enough bananas to feed an entire planet of apes! Remember what to say if they try to steal your coffee... Capuchin-no!

10066.name: Riding Gorilla
10066.description: A tamed great ape; both majestic and powerful! Command him to throw great clumps of earth as you speed through the world together on your adventures!

10068.name: Pet Sock
10068.description: Ever wondered what happens to all those socks that get lost in the washing machine? Well they appear in Growtopia! Honestly! This friendly little sock is happy he's found a friend in you!

10070.name: Buffalo Leash
10070.description: This little Buffalo is the perfect companion for wandering the vast open plains of Growtopia!

10080.name: Tied-up Buns
10080.description: Tightly tied hair buns fresh from the oven! Delicious with hot butter and hair gel! Probably best to wear and not eat actually!

10082.name: Tousled Hair
10082.description: Step out of the shower, shake your head and you are ready to go with this effortless natural tousled hair style!

10084.name: Anime Male Hair
10084.description: Be the star of screen and comic with this awesome hair style!

10086.name: Anime Female Hair
10086.description: Be the star of screen and comic with this awesome hair style!

10088.name: Long Nose
10088.description: Be the Growtopian with the long nose who knows! Just don't go sticking it into other peoples business!

10090.name: Handlebar Mustache
10090.description: Probably the best mustache named after the part you hold onto on a bicycle!

10092.name: Big Chin
10092.description: This is a rugged chin! Good for scratching when you're out of ideas and other things that a giant chin is good for!

10094.name: Puppy Dog Eyes
10094.description: No one will be able to resist these puppy dog eyes! The perfect balance between sad and OMG CUTE!!

10096.name: Rosy Cheeks
10096.description: A healthy, rosy glow for your Growtopian. Add a little colour to your face with these.

10098.name: Walrus Mustache
10098.description: A mustache that doesn't really look like a Walrus but would probably look great on one... as well as yourself!

10100.name: Showman's Mustache
10100.description: Roll Up! Roll Up! Come and see the greatest facial hair on the planet! Never knowingly undersold, this mustache is for the showman in all of us!

10102.name: Golden Cuff Beard
10102.description: Pharaoh's style beard complete with a golden cuff to give that air of greatness that anyone with this sort of beard deserves!

10104.name: Omegalul
10104.description: A face for when you really, really, really gotta LOL!

10106.name: Growmoji Wow Mask
10106.description: A totally non creepy mask to give those facial muscles a rest when you want everyone to know you are feeling totally WOW!

10108.name: Growmoji Lol Mask
10108.description: A totally non creepy mask to give those facial muscles a rest when you want everyone to know you are feeling totally LOL!

10110.name: Growmoji Cool Shades Mask
10110.description: A totally non creepy mask to give those facial muscles a rest when you want everyone to know you are feeling like totally Cool Shades all day!

10112.name: Growmoji Sick Mask
10112.description: A totally non creepy mask to give those facial muscles a rest when you want everyone to know you are feeling totally sick... maybe best keep the mask on until you feel better or even better put your feetup and rest!

10128.name: Mechanical Butler
10128.description: The Teabot 3000 Mechanical Butler is perfect for all your buttling needs! This ever faithful companion is always on hand for when you need a refreshing cup of tea or wish to throw said refreshing cup of tea over a friend... or foe!

10130.name: Sun Shooter Bow
10130.description: This bow is too hot to handle! Each arrow is propelled forward with the force of a 1000 suns guiding them to their destiny! A truly carbon neutral energy source for a weapon!

10132.name: Yin Yang Pendant
10132.description: A pendant that Yin's just as much as it Yang's! Wearing this will keep you in perfect balance with nature, while making you run so fast you'll be missing most of it!

10134.name: Peace Mooncake Hat
10134.description: What better to wear when hunting for Mooncakes than a Mooncake hat! There's one for each Mooncake type so keep a look out for all of them.

10136.name: Longevity Mooncake Hat
10136.description: What better to wear when hunting for Mooncakes than a Mooncake hat! There's one for each Mooncake type so keep a look out for all of them.

10138.name: Prosperity Mooncake Hat
10138.description: What better to wear when hunting for Mooncakes than a Mooncake hat! There's one for each Mooncake type so keep a look out for all of them.

10140.name: Balance Mooncake Hat
10140.description: What better to wear when hunting for Mooncakes than a Mooncake hat! There's one for each Mooncake type so keep a look out for all of them.

10142.name: Mooncake Shoes
10142.description: New Balance Mooncake shoes! Good on all terrain, hard wearing and also yummy! Seriously, don't eat them! Who knows what you have stepped in!

10144.name: Moon Watcher Mask
10144.description: Watch the Moon in style with this mask which also makes you look a little like an awesome super hero!

10146.name: Harmony Mooncake Hat
10146.description: What better to wear when hunting for Mooncakes than a Mooncake hat! There's one for each Mooncake type so keep a look out for all of them.

10148.name: Harvest Shawl
10148.description: A cape made of golden autumn leaves sprinkled with a little harvest magic! This cape goes wherever the wind blows.

10150.name: Purity Mooncake Hat
10150.description: What better to wear when hunting for Mooncakes than a Mooncake hat! There's one for each Mooncake type so keep a look out for all of them.

10158.name: Mooncake Magnificence
10158.description: A Magnificent Mooncake Pendant! When equipped, this magical pendant emits a balanced glow that responds in harmony with Balance Mooncakes. Whenever a Balance Mooncake is found it has a chance of multiplying the quantity but also breaking. However it repels Peace, Harmony, Prosperity and Longevity Mooncakes making them less likely to be found when harvesting trees.

10160.name: Owl Mask
10160.description: Get suited and "hooted" and dress like an owl! Feathery finery for the discerning owl-ficionado!

10162.name: Owl Suit
10162.description: Get suited and "hooted" and dress like an owl! Feathery finery for the discerning owl-ficionado!

10164.name: Ancestor Mooncake Hat
10164.description: What better to wear when hunting for Mooncakes than a Mooncake hat! There's one for each Mooncake type so keep a look out for all of them.

10166.name: Haunted Jack O' Lantern
10166.description: Some spooky Growtopia magic is at play here! When equipped, your head is totally transformed into a floating, flaming, haunted pumpkin! Thankfully, it follows you wherever you go! Perfect for the spooky season!

10168.name: Bling Wings
10168.description: A pair of blingingly awesome wings! The glitz and glamor of these are exemplified by a trail of gems... these are not real gems by the way, that would be just silly! To avoid refund fraud, this item has been made untradeable until February 7th, 2021.

10170.name: Aqua Wings
10170.description: Cause a splash with these Aqua Wings! They are so realistic, even a few fish have managed to sneak into them... they are flying fish now!

10172.name: Neon Wings
10172.description: Light up the town in style! Don't question how neon lights make you fly, just go with the glow and touch the sky!

10174.name: Raccoon Hat
10174.description: There's something good to be said about a furry Raccoon for your head! Chosen by NVISIBLE, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for August, 2020!

10178.name: Growtopia Fried Wings
10178.description: Wings to make your tummy rumble! These deep fried wings are literally straight from the oven! Covered in a golden breadcrumb made with a secret mix of Growtopia herbs and spices, cooked to create the perfect balance between flavor and aerodynamics!

10180.name: Party Plume Wings
10180.description: A wing with some serious plumage! Surprise and dazzle Growtopians with this vibrant display of color and feathers. The Peacock has to be one of nature's biggest show offs, now you can be as well as you take to the dancefloor with your party plume!

10182.name: Musical Wings
10182.description: Musical wings for marauding Maestros! Wrench yourself to set a tune with these equipped, then walk along to play back the tune! It's how Beethoven would have composed music if Growtopia had existed all those years ago... probably.

10184.name: Dark Sunset Cape
10184.description: A cape made from threads of a million dying suns! I bet you didn't know that suns were made of thread did you!

10186.name: Darkest Skull Parasol
10186.description: A Parasol for those with only the darkest of souls! A dark combination of rocket powered skulls to thrust you high into the chilly night air!

10188.name: Ghoulish Wings
10188.description: Get your Ghoul on! A mystery gas surrounds you and elevates you skyward... not sure where this gas comes from?!

10194.name: Shady Sales Shades
10194.description: Super Pumpkin Party ready shades! Perfect for any Halloween party or any other occasion actually!

10204.name: Creepy Baby Suit
10204.description: If you ever need to dress as a creepy baby then you're in luck! This item is perfect for all occasion's.

10206.name: Demogorgon Mask
10206.description: Perfect Spelunking while looking a bit scary at the same time! Light up the darkest in spooky style.

10210.name: Cloak of Equilibrium
10210.description: A perfectly balanced cloak! Half infused with power by the sun and half by the moon!

10212.name: Infested Hair
10212.description: Eugh! Time to buy some new shampoo! Infested and probably rather also rather smelly... perfect for Halloween!

10214.name: Lost Startopian Helmet
10214.description: Perfect for celebrating the spooky season while also commanding a spaceship!

10216.name: Frankenstein's Monster Mask
10216.description: Scare the villagers away with this perfectly spooky mask! Slightly reduces items required for Farmer Role quests!

10222.name: Druid's Crown
10222.description: A dark, dark crown for a dark, dark Druid! For when you are in one of those, "leave me alone" moods!

10224.name: Druid's Mask
10224.description: A dark, dark mask for a dark, dark Druid! For when you are in one of those, "leave me alone" moods!

10226.name: Druid's Robes
10226.description: A dark, dark robe for a dark, dark Druid! For when you are in one of those, "leave me alone" moods!

10230.name: Cyber Punk Mask
10230.description: A futuristic Cyber Punk mask, perfect for wearing everyday! Chosen by macmacxd22, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for September, 2020!

10232.name: Reanimated Howly Hat
10232.description: Awooo! The mad scientists at Growtech have reanimated this beast! It's pretty angry what with having to be carried around on your head all day long!

10236.name: Zombie Horse
10236.description: A zombified flaming horse to terrorize the town with! With hooves of flame, this fiery steed is perfect for the spooky season!

10246.name: Celestial Dragon Charm
10246.description: An ancient and valuable charm, passed between Dragons and their masters for as long as time remembers. Wearing it will invoke the spirit and power of the revered Celestial Dragon! A Dragon of legend who had the power to control the sun, the moon and the stars!

10248.name: Riding RV
10248.description: A rapid, revving, recreation vehicle! Sit atop this automotive icon and cruise from coast to coast in comfort and style!

10250.name: Ultra Sportsball Bat
10250.description: A bat with some serious power! Imagine the scene... it's the last ball of the game. A Growtopian steps up to bat... what's that? It's an enormous floating shiny metal bat! He hits a HOME RUN and sends the ball into ORBIT and wins the game!

10252.name: American Sports Ball Jersey
10252.description: Call the plays, be the Quarterback, get involved in some serious contact sport with this Jersey! Earn some Quarterback's money with this equipped. You are the MVP, maybe even the GOAT... but not the Llama!

10256.name: Presidential Beard
10256.description: A truly presidential piece of facial hair! This beard has passed more bills than someone passing by the world's largest gathering of people named William!

10260.name: All You Can Eat Bib
10260.description: Did somebody say FOOD FIGHT?! It's an "all you can eat" and also an "all you can throw" bib! It automatically cleans itself too. So, it's very eco-friendly!

10262.name: Thanksgiving Dinner Fishing Rod
10262.description: A rod of such great finery!

10274.name: Crown of Enlightenment
10274.description: A copper crown, turned green with time! Symbolizes liberty and enlightenment... also looks awesome! Feels like it's part of a set somehow?

10276.name: Dress of Enlightenment
10276.description: A copper dress turned green with time! Symbolizes liberty and enlightenment... doesn't look like it would be too easy to move about in! Feels like it's part of a set somehow?

10278.name: Torch of Enlightenment
10278.description: A copper torch turned green with time! Symbolizes liberty and enlightenment... also, basically, a cool flame thrower! Feels like it's part of a set somehow?

10282.name: Presidential Wig
10282.description: Very much a wig for big wigs! Imagine running a county wearing this? I think the people would laugh and make lots of jokes on the internet about you!

10284.name: Burger Suit
10284.description: If you've ever had the burning desire to dress as a juicy, flamed grilled burger, dripping in the perfect combination of ketchup, mustard, crispy lettuce and a lightly toasted bun... then this is for you! Now I'm hungry!

10288.name: JackBowe's Koala
10288.description: They are very cute until they get angry! This little furry guy stands as tribute to all of those who lost their lives in Australian Wild Fires. They will always be remembered. Sponsored by JackBowe for completing all epic quests!

10290.name: Growch Bod
10290.description: A perfect replica of Growch's beautiful Bod!

10292.name: Turkey Sucker
10292.description: Growtech's latest innovation in Turkey capture, containment and cooking! Use the suction beam to collect and cook Turkeys. `4WARNING:`` This item is still experimental, so, it can break. Although, when it does, sometimes you get something special.

10296.name: Neon Oni Mask
10296.description: Keep safe with this stylish face mask. Chosen by AppleJuz, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for October, 2020!

10330.name: Shadow Crown
10330.description: A Black Friday exclusive Crown! Some kind of evil dark spirit must have infested this crown... on the upside, it does look awesome and it gives you some special powers.

10332.name: Matrix Aura
10332.description: A Black Friday exclusive aura! Numbers falling, time collapsing into itself, just another day in Growtopia then!

10334.name: Black Balrog's Tail
10334.description: A sword forged from the tail of a mighty demon... only this version is a Black Friday exclusive!

10336.name: Black Burning Eyes
10336.description: Need some eyedrops for those? This is a Black Friday exclusive version!

10338.name: Black Egg Champion Cape
10338.description: First chauffeurs, now flying cape services? Is there anything these chicks can't do? This is a Black Friday exclusive version.

10340.name: Tie Dye Hoodie
10340.description: A Black Friday exclusive hoodie! Looks really comfortable, perfect for lounging around and grabbing a bargain in the sales.

10342.name: Black Neon Hightops
10342.description: A Black Friday exclusive pair of hightops! Black and neon is pretty much the perfect combo isn't it?

10344.name: Vortex Shirt
10344.description: A Black Friday exclusive shirt! If you've ever wanted a shirt with a sort of vortex effect on it, then you're in luck!

10346.name: Slouch Beanie
10346.description: A Black Friday exclusive beanie! It's like a regular beanie but too big, so it slouches at the back... or maybe that's how you wanted it?

10348.name: Gradient Trenchcoat
10348.description: A Black Friday exclusive trenchcoat! A couture trench coat, perfect for the catwalk or walking a cat! Look stylish all the time, everytime!

10388.name: Swordfish Sword
10388.description: If you're angling for a sharp pointy fish to use as a sword, then, this is the one for you! The only thing mightier is the Penfish!

10390.name: Jet Ski Chariot
10390.description: For when you really want to show off! Skim across land and sea, performing tricks and stunts to amaze onlookers!

10392.name: Water Gun Hat
10392.description: Two water pistols mounted to each side of this hat, will provide more than enough water power to cool off anyone or anything!

10402.name: Christmas Tree Sword
10402.description: Oh Christmas tree, oh Christmas tree, how deadly are thy branches!

10404.name: Sledding Penguin
10404.description: The ultimate in giant Penguin transportation!

10406.name: Staff of Deepest Winter
10406.description: Wow this staff is cold! Made of the deepest, most wintry snow, and sprinkled with a little Winter magic.

10408.name: Krampus Crampons
10408.description: Some Crampons which are so cold they even freeze acid... a bit!

10412.name: Diamond Dust
10412.description: This locket filled with Diamond dust has the power to transform all who wear it! Tradable since April 25th, 2021.

10414.name: Sleepy Santa Hat
10414.description: An olden days hat for sleeping, because, for some reason you wore a hat to bed back then!

10416.name: Light Up Antlers
10416.description: Rudolph the red nosed reindeer might have had a very shiny nose, but you've got light up antlers... so you win!

10418.name: Growch's Nose
10418.description: A perfect replica of Growch's nose! Well, it would be a bit mean if it was his real one, wouldn't it!

10420.name: Light Up Pants
10420.description: Party Pants! These flash, flashing, pants are perfect for a Winterfest party!

10422.name: Nick's Belly
10422.description: Someone's been eating all the mince pies! Who? You!

10424.name: Rift Cape
10424.description: Rip a hole in the fabric of reality with this amazing Cape! Create two unique looks and use a rift in time and space to change between them. Wrench yourself to customise the Cape. This item is available to buy for 2 days only and then will become available from a new Winterfest system afterwards. To avoid refund fraud, this item has been made untradeable until May 1st, 2021.

10426.name: Mystic Snow Fox
10426.description: There are many tales about this many tailed fox! Wearing the tail allows you to change your form into that of the mystic fox of legend itself!

10428.name: Water Balloon Bandolier
10428.description: Wear your balloons with pride! Show your fellow Growtopians your love of Balloon Warz and, indeed, water balloons!

10430.name: Team Tied Jersey - Punch
10430.description: Wear your team colors proudly with this snazzy Jersey.

10432.name: Team Tied Jersey - Grow
10432.description: Wear your team colors proudly with this snazzy Jersey.

10434.name: Team Tied Jersey - Build
10434.description: Wear your team colors proudly with this snazzy Jersey.

10436.name: Dungarees
10436.description: I'm sure you'll agree that these are a wonderful pair of Dungarees. Chosen by Nabsplays, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for November, 2020.

10438.name: Snow Leopard Shawl
10438.description: Made of the finest Faux Snow Leopard Fur. This Shawl is infused with the spirit of a mighty Snow Leopard!

10440.name: Winter Swept Hair
10440.description: Wherever you go, you'll always be rocking the windswept look!

10442.name: Winter Light Launcher
10442.description: Get ready to spread some winter cheer! You'll be spreading cheer and lights with some vigor with this launcher equipped! Perfect for last minute decorations!

10454.name: Diamond Dog
10454.description: This is one luxury Pooch! Although not overly fluffy, it more than makes up for it with its diamond shine!

10492.name: Radical Rollers
10492.description: Get radical! These light up roller skates put the party in every step you take and add the disco to every move you make! Great for a /dance.

10494.name: Walktopian
10494.description: Listen to some banging tunes while you walk... man!

10496.name: Crown of the Cosmos
10496.description: This crown allows you to harness the power of the Cosmos! Putting you right at the center of everything!

10498.name: Candy Cane Scythe
10498.description: Probably the deadliest Candy Cane ever made! Fling some festive cheer and razor sharp candy... what better way to celebrate the Holidays!

10500.name: Snow Aura
10500.description: Your very own personal snow cloud! Take Winter with you, wherever you go. If you wait long enough, you might even see a snowman.

10502.name: Neon Tree Aura
10502.description: Get the Winterfest Party started with the Neon Tree Aura! Perfect for a night out on the frozen tiles.

10504.name: Zamgrowni
10504.description: To be Frank, this ice resurfacing machine has a cool name! Although, this one doesn't resurface ice, it does harvest trees!

10506.name: Spruce Goose
10506.description: Nothing like a spruce green goose to get you in the holiday mood! Honk! Honk!

10510.name: Gingerbread Sweater
10510.description: Kind of ugly. Kind of cool. Made of gingerbread... and wool.

10520.name: Gingerbread Man Onesie
10520.description: A one stop shop for looking a bit like a Gingerbread Man... if that's what you want!

10522.name: Gingerbread Man Mask
10522.description: Weird, creepy and slightly sinister! It's perfect to wear with a Gingerbread Man Onesie!

10524.name: Winter Colonel Beard
10524.description: Perfect for wearing when creating a secret mix of winter herbs and spices!

10526.name: Electric Guitar
10526.description: You can't punch when holding this, you're too busy ROCKING OUT! Punch anywhere to play music. If you punch to your left or right, you can bend the note higher or lower. Punch in your own column to play the same notes that Sheet Music: Piano Note plays.

10534.name: Confetti Jump Pack
10534.description: This retro jump pack will propel you to euphoric heights!

10542.name: Playful Pitchfork
10542.description: Be careful who you poke with it! Chosen by ReddMA, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for December, 2020.

10548.name: Retro Jacket
10548.description: Retro chic goodness. Denim will never go out of fashion!

10550.name: Retro Leg Warmers
10550.description: Good for partying and keeping your legs warm at the same time!

10562.name: Rainbow Tutu
10562.description: Choo Choo! With this Tutu you can board to party train to Disco Town! Calling at Party Central, Dancefloor Downs and Diva District!

10564.name: White Suit Jacket
10564.description: Strut your stuff in this 1980's inspired look. The perfect day/night combination!

10566.name: Tetra T-Shirt
10566.description: The most stylish and disco-like of fish make for the perfect T-shirt!

10570.name: Rave Safe Mask
10570.description: Rave long, rave hard, rave safe!

10576.name: Draconic Soul Aura
10576.description: The flames of a Draconic presence imbue you with power! The flames burn into your very soul, you are starting to become one with the Draconic kind! There are only 1000 in existence!

10578.name: Mystic Battle Lance
10578.description: A traditional and ancient weapon. Cast of molten steel, this fiery lance, from a fiery furnace, wreaks fiery fury with every attack! There are only 500 in existence!

10580.name: Year of the Ox Mask
10580.description: The ox is the second of the zodiac animals. Limited only to the year of the ox! Myth has it, that order of the Zodiac animals, was determined by a race. The mighty ox, adept on land and water, was leading until a sneaky rat jumped from its back as they crossed the line, unfairly, winning the race!

10586.name: Oxen Battle Helm
10586.description: Strong, hardy and reliable! This item has all the attributes of those who are born under the sign of the Zodiac Ox!

10588.name: Oxen Battle Shirt
10588.description: Strong, hardy and reliable! This item has all the attributes of those who are born under the sign of the Zodiac Ox!

10590.name: Oxen Battle Pants
10590.description: Strong, hardy and reliable! This item has all the attributes of those who are born under the sign of the Zodiac Ox!

10592.name: Oxen Battle Boots
10592.description: Strong, hardy and reliable! This item has all the attributes of those who are born under the sign of the Zodiac Ox!

10594.name: Golden Ox Pendant
10594.description: A mystic golden charm. Both ancient and ageless, this is said to instill the work ethic of the Ox in whoever should wear it!

10600.name: 2014 - Zodiac Year of the Horse
10600.description: A very special year was the Year of the Horse! Growtopians born in this year as said to be warm-hearted, enthusiastic, and positive. The horse can be seen as the symbol of independence and freedom! Harvesting Fortune Cookie & Lucky Fortune Cookie trees with this item equipped gives a chance of twice the yield.

10602.name: 2015 - Zodiac Year of the Goat
10602.description: Growtopians born in the Year of the Goat are be believed to be gentle, mild-mannered, shy, stable, sympathetic and amicable. They are said to have delicate thoughts, strong creativity, and perseverance! Harvesting Fortune Cookie & Lucky Fortune Cookie trees with this item equipped gives a chance of twice the yield.

10604.name: 2016 - Zodiac Year of the Monkey
10604.description: Growtopians born in the Year of the Monkey have magnetic personalities and are witty and intelligent! They can also be mischievous and are masters of the practical joke! Cheeky Monkey! Harvesting Fortune Cookie & Lucky Fortune Cookie trees with this item equipped gives a chance of twice the yield.

10606.name: 2017 - Zodiac Year of the Rooster
10606.description: Growtopians born in the Year of the Rooster are observant and hardworking. They are resourceful, courageous, and talented. Harvesting Fortune Cookie & Lucky Fortune Cookie trees with this item equipped gives a chance of twice the yield.

10608.name: 2018 - Zodiac Year of the Dog
10608.description: Growtopians born in the Year of the Dog are loyal and honest, amiable and kind, cautious and prudent. They have a strong sense of loyalty and sincerity. Harvesting Fortune Cookie & Lucky Fortune Cookie trees with this item equipped gives a chance of twice the yield.

10610.name: 2019 - Zodiac Year of the Pig
10610.description: Growtopians born in the Year of the Pig are diligent, compassionate, and realistic! They devote energy to achieving goals and like to see things through to completion. Harvesting Fortune Cookie & Lucky Fortune Cookie trees with this item equipped gives a chance of twice the yield.

10612.name: 2020 - Zodiac Year of the Rat
10612.description: Growtopians born in the Year of the Rat are clever and quick thinkers! They can be strong-willed, and ambitious as well. Harvesting Fortune Cookie & Lucky Fortune Cookie trees with this item equipped gives a chance of twice the yield.

10614.name: 2021 - Zodiac Year of the Ox
10614.description: Growtopians born in the Year of the Ox are strong, reliable, fair and conscientious, inspiring confidence in others. They believe in themselves and can be stubborn... as an ox! Harvesting Fortune Cookie & Lucky Fortune Cookie trees with this item equipped gives a chance of twice the yield.

10618.name: Perilous Pirate Ship
10618.description: Set forth on your buccaneering adventures on this, most magnificent of vessels, The Flying Growtopian! Your personal pirate ship will accompany you everywhere. Some kind of unknown marauding magic allows it to transform in size and shape as you command! Pretty nifty if you ask me!

10622.name: Stylish Draped Trench Coat
10622.description: The most sylish way to wear your trench coat... To not actually wear it but instead, drape it over your shoulder like you're a coat rack. Chosen by Dispersing, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for January, 2021!

10624.name: King of Hearts
10624.description: They're going to lose their heads, for painting the roses red...

10626.name: Rose Rifle
10626.description: A shot straight to the heart.

10632.name: Silk Scarf
10632.description: The finest silk was once weaved for a great goddess but now it adorns your shoulders.

10634.name: Golden Silk Scarf
10634.description: The finest silk was once weaved for a great goddess but now it adorns your shoulders. Imbued with the goddess' power, this scarf will lift you through the air and make your feet glide lightly wherever they fall.

10638.name: Love Eyes
10638.description: All you can see is love, love, love...

10640.name: Heart Antennae Headband
10640.description: My loving senses are tingling... there must be someone nearby that needs some loving. Better go give them a hug! Can be transformed into a hat by combining 1 Heart Antennae Headband, 1 Transmog Crystal, and 10 Candy Hearts in a Chemical Combiner.

10644.name: Golden Heart Aura
10644.description: This aura marks you with love and adoration, healing you quickly with the power of the heart and propelling you through the air!

10666.name: Grow Air Balloon
10666.description: Go anywhere the wind takes you with your very own hot air balloon! The balloon style changes when you equip it. So, may you find the balloon that's just right for you!

10670.name: Bow of the Rainbow
10670.description: The most rainbow'y rainbow bow of all the rainbow bows ever created by the rainbow bowyer! If you like rainbows, then this bow is the rainbow bow for you!

10674.name: Crown of Seasons
10674.description: A crown which grants you the power to change the seasons at will! With this crown, wild things will surely happen! Wrench yourself to modify this item's properties. To avoid refund fraud, this item has been made untradeable until August 1st, 2021.

10676.name: Shamrock Shuriken
10676.description: Perfect for a wannabe Shamrock Ninja! Better take "clover", these are sharp!

10678.name: Hooves of Cernunnos
10678.description: Will the wild in every step you take! Roots form and wither at your command!

10680.name: Finias' Red Javelin
10680.description: One of the Four Treasures of the Tuatha Dé Danann! This Javelin was said to never miss its target! Is it myth? Is it legend? Well, what are you waiting for? Throw the thing!

10684.name: Mothman Wings
10684.description: Urban Myth? Legend? Monster created from our condition to fear the unknown? Or just super awesome moth wings... you decide!

10686.name: Shady Agent Shades
10686.description: Is it me, or is that UFO following me? Wait... am I the alien?

10688.name: Cardboard Nessie
10688.description: Some say that the Loch Ness Monster is real. Others, that it's a hoax and was actually a cardboard cut out. We say, Cardboard Nessie for the win!

10690.name: Swamp Monster Onesie
10690.description: A myth and legend the world over! As old as time itself but even more slimy! Wearing the full suit leaves a mysterious trail of slime behind you!

10692.name: Swamp Monster Head
10692.description: A myth and legend the world over! As old as time itself but even more slimy! Wearing the full suit leaves a mysterious trail of slime behind you!

10694.name: Mini Minokawa
10694.description: A Mini Minokawa! A mythical, and very much legendary, bird from the Philippines! People believed the creature was so big that it ate the sun and caused eclipses. This one isn't so big but it's still pretty cool!

10706.name: Wax Jacket
10706.description: The perfect jacket for taking a stroll in the country. Either yomping over dale with your trusty companion or atop a hill surveying your land, this is the look for you.

10712.name: Feathered Pauldrons
10712.description: An ornate set of pauldrons adorned with feathers and emblazoned with a ruby in the center. Chosen by Atatip, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for February, 2021!

10714.name: Steampunk Arm
10714.description: Turn the hands of time with this hand of time.

10718.name: Grow X Rocket Wings
10718.description: Take off on a mission to Mars, or wherever your imagination takes you! These rocket wings use the latest in renewable energy, are kind to the environment, and approved for commercial space flight!

10720.name: Easter Jeepney
10720.description: This popular form of public transport has been given an Easter makeover! All aboard for adventure! Disclaimer... this only actually carries one person but hey it's you, so, you win!

10722.name: Bunny Ear Magnifying Glass
10722.description: A little bit of detective noir given the Growtopia treatment! Perfect for solving crimes and finding eggs! Careful where you point it as those sun rays are hot!

10724.name: Lil Growpeep's Baaaa Blaster
10724.description: The latest in undercover sheep herding technology! The latest innovation from Growtech. The culmination of decades of research in safe sheep propulsion! No sheep are harmed in the use of this item!

10726.name: Bloom Aura
10726.description: Celebrate spring in style, with this blooming good aura!

10728.name: Home Made Butter Lamb
10728.description: When your expectations don't quite match your skill level... but all the cuter for it! Be proud of the things you've achieved.

10738.name: Sheep Hood
10738.description: If you've been wishing for a sheep hood, then you're in luck, as this is a sheep hood! Perfect when combined with a Sheep Onesie!

10740.name: Sheep Onesie
10740.description: A real wool onesie, probably really warm but thats the price you pay for the chic sheep look you're rocking when you wear it.

10748.name: One Winged Angel
10748.description: This single wing is a symbol for all those who strive to overcome adversity, no matter what the odds. To avoid refund fraud, this item has been made untradeable until August 25th, 2021.

10750.name: Golden Leprechaun Hat
10750.description: You've taken the Leprechaun look up to maximum level! This golden hat, when worn with the Golden Leprechaun Suit item, will give a chance at receiving an extra bonus item when you kiss the Blarney Stone.

10752.name: Golden Leprechaun Suit
10752.description: You've taken the Leprechaun look up to maximum level! This golden suit, when worn with the Golden Leprechaun Hat item, will give a chance at receiving an extra bonus item when you kiss the Blarney Stone.

10754.name: Helping Hand
10754.description: Nobody knows how or why this helpful little hand does what it does but for some reason its grown a liking for you. It will help in every way possible with a helpful serving of attitude on the side.

10770.name: Easter Witches Hood
10770.description: Celebrate Easter the Finnish Way! Virvon, Varvon, for a fresh and healthy coming year!

10772.name: Easter Witches Cape
10772.description: Celebrate Easter the Finnish Way! Virvon, Varvon, for a fresh and healthy coming year!

10774.name: Field Medics Mecha Med Scarf
10774.description: Not sure if this concoction is fully approved, but it sure increases your recovery speed!

10778.name: Care Pear
10778.description: This little guy just wants a hug!

10780.name: Giving Growaxe
10780.description: Display your generosity for all to see while you earn those big gems!

10782.name: Backwards Ballcap
10782.description: Wear you cap backwards! All the cool kids are doing it.

10796.name: Grow4Good Ambassador's Sash of Honor
10796.description: A great honor, bestowed on the leading Grow4Good Ambassador's!

10798.name: Dashing Dolphin Hat

When fully cooked, add Lettuce and immediately remove from the oven.<CR><CR>Timings may vary so you will need to experiment.
